16.11.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
iti proktā tadā devi vismayotphullalocanā ..
romāṃcakañcukā subhrūḥ punaḥ papraccha bhūsurāḥ ..1..
16.11.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
इति प्रोक्ता तदा देवि विस्मयोत्फुल्ललोचना ..
रोमांचकञ्चुका सुभ्रूः पुनः पप्रच्छ भूसुराः ..1..
16.11.m: Sūta said: / Addressed thus at that time, O brahmins, the goddess, her eyes wide with wonder / and her body bristling with horripilation, with beautiful brows, asked again:

16.11.s:
.. devyuvāca .. ..
dhanyā'haṃ kṛtapuṇyā'haṃ tapaḥ sucaritaṃ mayā ..
yadeṣa kṣetra mahimā mahādevānmayā śrutaḥ ..2..
16.11.d:
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
धन्याऽहं कृतपुण्याऽहं तपः सुचरितं मया ..
यदेष क्षेत्र महिमा महादेवान्मया श्रुतः ..2..
16.11.m: The goddess said: / I am blessed, I have acquired merit, my austerities have been well performed, / since I have heard this majesty of the sacred field from Mahādeva.

16.11.s:
bhagavandevadeveśa saṃsārārṇavatāraka ..
pṛṣṭaṃ tu yanmayā pūrvaṃ tatsarvaṃ kathitaṃ hara .. 3 ..
16.11.d:
भगवन्देवदेवेश संसारार्णवतारक ..
पृष्टं तु यन्मया पूर्वं तत्सर्वं कथितं हर .. 3 ..
16.11.m: O Lord, ruler of the gods of gods, ferryman across the ocean of transmigration! / Everything that was previously asked by me has been told by you, O Hara.

16.11.s:
punaśca devadeveśa tvadvākyāmṛtaraṃjitā ..
na tṛptimadhigacchāmi devadeva maheśvara .. 4 ..
16.11.d:
पुनश्च देवदेवेश त्वद्वाक्यामृतरंजिता ..
न तृप्तिमधिगच्छामि देवदेव महेश्वर .. 4 ..
16.11.m: And once again, O ruler of the gods of gods, delighted by the nectar of your words, / I do not reach satiety, O god of gods, Maheśvara!

16.11.s:
kiṃcitpraṣṭumanāścāsmi prabhāsakṣetravistaram ..
tanme kathaya kāmeśa dayāṃ kṛtvā jagatprabho .. .. 5 ..
16.11.d:
किंचित्प्रष्टुमनाश्चास्मि प्रभासक्षेत्रविस्तरम् ..
तन्मे कथय कामेश दयां कृत्वा जगत्प्रभो .. .. 5 ..
16.11.m: I also desire to ask something regarding the extent of the sacred field of Prabhāsa. / Tell that to me, O lord of desire, taking pity [on me], O Lord of the universe!

16.11.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
pṛthivyā madhyagarbhasthaṃ jaṃbūdvīpamiti smṛtam ..
tacca vai navadhā bhinnaṃ varṣabhedena sundari..6..
16.11.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
पृथिव्या मध्यगर्भस्थं जंबूद्वीपमिति स्मृतम् ..
तच्च वै नवधा भिन्नं वर्षभेदेन सुन्दरि..6..
16.11.m: Īśvara said: / What is situated in the inner core of the earth is known as Jambudvīpa. / And that, indeed, is divided ninefold according to the division of realms, O fair woman.

16.11.s:
tasyādyaṃ bhārataṃ varṣaṃ taccāpi navadhā smṛtam ..
navayojanasāhasraṃ dakṣiṇottaramānataḥ .. 7 ..
16.11.d:
तस्याद्यं भारतं वर्षं तच्चापि नवधा स्मृतम् ..
नवयोजनसाहस्रं दक्षिणोत्तरमानतः .. 7 ..
16.11.m: The first of these is the realm of Bhārata, and that too is taught to be ninefold. / It measures nine thousand yojanas from south to north.

16.11.s:
aśītiśca sahasrāṇi pūrvapaścāyataṃ smṛtam ..
uttare himavānasti kṣīrodo dakṣiṇe smṛtaḥ .. 8 ..
16.11.d:
अशीतिश्च सहस्राणि पूर्वपश्चायतं स्मृतम् ..
उत्तरे हिमवानस्ति क्षीरोदो दक्षिणे स्मृतः .. 8 ..
16.11.m: And it is known to extend eighty thousand [yojanas] from east to west. / In the north is Himavān, and the milk-ocean is recorded in the south.

16.11.s:
etasminnaṃtare devi bhārataṃ kṣetramuttamam ..
kṛtaṃ tretā dvāparaṃ ca tiṣyaṃ yugacatuṣṭayam .. 9 ..
16.11.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे देवि भारतं क्षेत्रमुत्तमम् ..
कृतं त्रेता द्वापरं च तिष्यं युगचतुष्टयम् .. 9 ..
16.11.m: Between these, O goddess, lies the excellent sacred field of Bhārata. / The four yugas are Kṛta, Tretā, Dvāpara, and Tiṣya (Kali).

16.11.s:
atraivaiṣā yugāvasthā caturvarṇaśca vai janaḥ ..
catvāri trīṇi ca dve ca tathaivaika śaracchatam .. 7.1.11.10 ..
16.11.d:
अत्रैवैषा युगावस्था चतुर्वर्णश्च वै जनः ..
चत्वारि त्रीणि च द्वे च तथैवैक शरच्छतम् .. 7.1.11.10 ..
16.11.m: Here alone is this condition of the yugas, and people of the four classes. / Four, three, two, and likewise one hundred autumns

16.11.s:
jīvantyatra narā devi kṛtatretādiṣu kramāt ..
yadetatpārthivaṃ padmaṃ catuṣpatraṃ mayoditam .. 11 ..
16.11.d:
जीवन्त्यत्र नरा देवि कृतत्रेतादिषु क्रमात् ..
यदेतत्पार्थिवं पद्मं चतुष्पत्रं मयोदितम् .. 11 ..
16.11.m: do men live here, O goddess, successively in Kṛta, Tretā, and the other [yugas]. / This earthly lotus with four petals that has been described by me—

16.11.s:
varṣāṇi bhāratādyāni patrāṇyasya caturddiśam..
bhārataṃ ketumālaṃ ca kuru bhadrāśvameva ca..12..
16.11.d:
वर्षाणि भारताद्यानि पत्राण्यस्य चतुर्द्दिशम्..
भारतं केतुमालं च कुरु भद्राश्वमेव च..12..
16.11.m: its petals in the four directions are the realms beginning with Bhārata: / Bhārata, Ketumāla, Kuru, and Bhadrāśva.

16.11.s:
bhārataṃ nāma yadvarṣaṃ dākṣiṇātyaṃ mayoditam..
dakṣiṇāparato yasya pūrveṇa ca mahodadhiḥ ..
himavānuttareṇāsya kārmukasya yathā guṇaḥ .. 13..
16.11.d:
भारतं नाम यद्वर्षं दाक्षिणात्यं मयोदितम्..
दक्षिणापरतो यस्य पूर्वेण च महोदधिः ..
हिमवानुत्तरेणास्य कार्मुकस्य यथा गुणः .. 13..
16.11.m: The realm named Bhārata, which has been stated by me to be southern, / to its south, west, and east is the great ocean; / Himavān is to its north, like the string of a bow.

16.11.s:
tadetadbhārataṃ varṣaṃ sarvabījaṃ varānane ..
tatkarmabhūmirnānyatra saṃprāptiḥ puṇyapāpayoḥ .. 14 ..
16.11.d:
तदेतद्भारतं वर्षं सर्वबीजं वरानने ..
तत्कर्मभूमिर्नान्यत्र संप्राप्तिः पुण्यपापयोः .. 14 ..
16.11.m: This very realm of Bhārata is the seed of all, O fair-faced woman! / It is the land of action; nowhere else is there the attainment of merit and sin.

16.11.s:
devānāmapi deveśi sadaivaiṣa manorathaḥ ..
api mānuṣyamāpsyāmo bhārate pratyuta kṣitau .. 15 ..
16.11.d:
देवानामपि देवेशि सदैवैष मनोरथः ..
अपि मानुष्यमाप्स्यामो भारते प्रत्युत क्षितौ .. 15 ..
16.11.m: Even of the gods, O ruler of the gods, this is always the wish: / 'May we indeed attain human birth on the earth in Bhārata!'

16.11.s:
bhadrāśve'śvaśirā viṣṇurbhārate kūrmasaṃsthitaḥ ..
varāhaḥ ketumāle ca matsyarūpastathottare .. 16 ..
16.11.d:
भद्राश्वेऽश्वशिरा विष्णुर्भारते कूर्मसंस्थितः ..
वराहः केतुमाले च मत्स्यरूपस्तथोत्तरे .. 16 ..
16.11.m: In Bhadrāśva, Viṣṇu has the head of a horse; in Bhārata, he is situated as the Tortoise; / in Ketumāla, as the Boar; and in the north, in the form of the Fish.

16.11.s:
teṣu nakṣatravinyāsādviṣayāḥ samavasthitāḥ ..
caturṣvapi mahādevi vigraho nava pādakaḥ .. 17 ..
16.11.d:
तेषु नक्षत्रविन्यासाद्विषयाः समवस्थिताः ..
चतुर्ष्वपि महादेवि विग्रहो नव पादकः .. 17 ..
16.11.m: In these, regions are established by the arrangement of the lunar asterisms. / Even across the four [realms], O great goddess, the form has nine divisions.

16.11.s:
bhārato yo mahādevi kūrmarūpeṇa saṃsthitaḥ ..
nakṣatragrahavinyāsaṃ tasya te kathayāmyaham .. 18 ..
16.11.d:
भारतो यो महादेवि कूर्मरूपेण संस्थितः ..
नक्षत्रग्रहविन्यासं तस्य ते कथयाम्यहम् .. 18 ..
16.11.m: He who is situated in the form of the Tortoise in Bhārata, O great goddess— / I will describe to you the arrangement of his lunar asterisms and planets.

16.11.s:
prāṅmukho bhagavāndevo kūrmarūpī vyavasthitaḥ ..
ākramya bhārataṃ varṣaṃ navabhedamidaṃ priye .. 19 ..
16.11.d:
प्राङ्मुखो भगवान्देवो कूर्मरूपी व्यवस्थितः ..
आक्रम्य भारतं वर्षं नवभेदमिदं प्रिये .. 19 ..
16.11.m: Facing east, the divine Lord stands in the form of the Tortoise, / having covered this realm of Bhārata of nine divisions, O beloved.

16.11.s:
navadhā saṃsthitasyāsya nakṣatrāṇi nibodha me ..
kṛttikā rohiṇī saumyaṃ tṛtīyaṃ kūrmapṛṣṭhigam .. 7.1.11.20 ..
16.11.d:
नवधा संस्थितस्यास्य नक्षत्राणि निबोध मे ..
कृत्तिका रोहिणी सौम्यं तृतीयं कूर्मपृष्ठिगम् .. 7.1.11.20 ..
16.11.m: Learn from me the lunar asterisms of this one situated ninefold: / Kṛttikā, Rohiṇī, and Saumya (Mṛgaśīrṣa) form the third, situated upon the Tortoise's back.

16.11.s:
raudraṃ punarvasuḥ puṣyaṃ nakṣatratritayaṃ mukhe ..
āśleṣākhyaṃ tathā paitraṃ phālgunī prathamā priye .. 21 ..
16.11.d:
रौद्रं पुनर्वसुः पुष्यं नक्षत्रत्रितयं मुखे ..
आश्लेषाख्यं तथा पैत्रं फाल्गुनी प्रथमा प्रिये .. 21 ..
16.11.m: Raudra (Ārdrā), Punarvasu, and Puṣya: the triad of asterisms in the face. / The one named Āśleṣā, Paitra (Maghā), and the first Phālgunī (Pūrvaphalgunī), O beloved—

16.11.s:
nakṣatratritayaṃ pādamāśritaṃ pūrvadakṣiṇam ..
phālgunī cottarā hastaṃ citrā carkṣatrayaṃ smṛtam .. 22 ..
16.11.d:
नक्षत्रत्रितयं पादमाश्रितं पूर्वदक्षिणम् ..
फाल्गुनी चोत्तरा हस्तं चित्रा चर्क्षत्रयं स्मृतम् .. 22 ..
16.11.m: this triad of asterisms rests on the southeastern foot. / Uttaraphālgunī, Hasta, and Citrā are recorded as the triad of asterisms

16.11.s:
kūrmasya dakṣiṇe kukṣau carkṣapādaṃ tathā'param ..
svātī viśākhā maitraṃ ca nairṛte tritayaṃ smṛtam .. 23 ..
16.11.d:
कूर्मस्य दक्षिणे कुक्षौ चर्क्षपादं तथाऽपरम् ..
स्वाती विशाखा मैत्रं च नैरृते त्रितयं स्मृतम् .. 23 ..
16.11.m: in the right flank of the Tortoise; and another quarter-asterism [belongs there]. / Svātī, Viśākhā, and Maitra (Anurādhā) are recorded as the triad in the southwest.

16.11.s:
aiṃdraṃ mūlaṃ tathāṣāḍhā pṛṣṭhe tu tritayaṃ smṛtam ..
āṣāḍhā śravaṇaṃ caiva dhaniṣṭhā cātra śabditā .. 24 ..
16.11.d:
ऐंद्रं मूलं तथाषाढा पृष्ठे तु त्रितयं स्मृतम् ..
आषाढा श्रवणं चैव धनिष्ठा चात्र शब्दिता .. 24 ..
16.11.m: Aindra (Jyeṣṭhā), Mūla, and Āṣāḍhā (Pūrvāṣāḍhā) are recorded as the triad on the tail. / Āṣāḍhā (Uttarāṣāḍhā), Śravaṇa, and Dhaniṣṭhā are spoken of here

16.11.s:
nakṣatritayaṃ pāde vāyavye tu yaśasvini ..
vāruṇaṃ caiva nakṣatraṃ tathā proṣṭhapadādvayam .. 25 ..
16.11.d:
नक्षत्रितयं पादे वायव्ये तु यशस्विनि ..
वारुणं चैव नक्षत्रं तथा प्रोष्ठपदाद्वयम् .. 25 ..
16.11.m: as the triad of asterisms on the northwestern foot, O illustrious lady! / And the asterism Vāruṇa (Śatabhiṣaj), and likewise the two Proṣṭhapadās (Pūrvabhādrapadā and Uttarabhādrapadā)—

16.11.s:
kūrmasya vāmakukṣau tu tritayaṃ saṃsthitaṃ priye ..
revatī cāśvidaivatyaṃ yāmyaṃ carkṣamiti trayam ..
īśapāde samākhyātaṃ śubhāśubhaphalaṃ śṛṇu .. 26 ..
16.11.d:
कूर्मस्य वामकुक्षौ तु त्रितयं संस्थितं प्रिये ..
रेवती चाश्विदैवत्यं याम्यं चर्क्षमिति त्रयम् ..
ईशपादे समाख्यातं शुभाशुभफलं शृणु .. 26 ..
16.11.m: the triad is situated on the left flank of the Tortoise, O beloved. / Revatī, that whose deity is the Aśvins (Aśvinī), and Yāmya (Bharaṇī)—this triad of asterisms / is declared on the northeastern foot. Hear the auspicious and inauspicious fruits:

16.11.s:
yasyarkṣasya patiryo vai grahastaddhainyato bhayam ..
taddeśasya mahādevi tathotkarṣe śubhāgamaḥ .. 27 ..
16.11.d:
यस्यर्क्षस्य पतिर्यो वै ग्रहस्तद्धैन्यतो भयम् ..
तद्देशस्य महादेवि तथोत्कर्षे शुभागमः .. 27 ..
16.11.m: The planet that is the ruler of an asterism, from its debility comes fear / for that region, O great goddess; likewise, upon its exaltation, there is the advent of good fortune.

16.11.s:
eṣa kūrmo mayākhyāto bhārate bhagavāniha ..
nārāyaṇo hyaciṃtyātmā yatra sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam .. 28 ..
16.11.d:
एष कूर्मो मयाख्यातो भारते भगवानिह ..
नारायणो ह्यचिंत्यात्मा यत्र सर्वं प्रतिष्ठितम् .. 28 ..
16.11.m: This divine Tortoise has been declared by me here in Bhārata: / Nārāyaṇa of inconceivable nature, in whom all is established.

16.11.s:
meṣavṛṣau hṛdo madhye mukhe ca mithunādikau ..
prāgdakṣiṇe tathā pāde karkasiṃhau vyavasthitau .. 29 ..
16.11.d:
मेषवृषौ हृदो मध्ये मुखे च मिथुनादिकौ ..
प्राग्दक्षिणे तथा पादे कर्कसिंहौ व्यवस्थितौ .. 29 ..
16.11.m: Aries and Taurus are in the middle of the heart, and Gemini and the following are in the face. / On the southeastern foot are situated Cancer and Leo.

16.11.s:
siṃhakanyātulāścaiva kukṣau rāśitrayaṃ smṛtam ..
dhaṭo'dha vṛścikāścobhau pāde dakṣiṇapaścime .. 7.1.11.30 ..
16.11.d:
सिंहकन्यातुलाश्चैव कुक्षौ राशित्रयं स्मृतम् ..
धटोऽध वृश्चिकाश्चोभौ पादे दक्षिणपश्चिमे .. 7.1.11.30 ..
16.11.m: Leo, Virgo, and Libra are recorded as the triad of signs in the flank. / The lower Balance (Libra) and Scorpio are both on the southwestern foot.

16.11.s:
pucche tu vṛścikaścaiva sadhanuśca vyavasthitaḥ ..
vāyavye vāmapāde ca dhanurgrāhādikaṃ trayam .. 31 ..
16.11.d:
पुच्छे तु वृश्चिकश्चैव सधनुश्च व्यवस्थितः ..
वायव्ये वामपादे च धनुर्ग्राहादिकं त्रयम् .. 31 ..
16.11.m: And on the tail is situated Scorpio together with Sagittarius. / On the left foot in the northwest is the triad beginning with Sagittarius and Capricorn.

16.11.s:
kumbha mīnau tathā cāsya uttarāṃ kukṣimāśritau ..
mīnameṣau mahādevi pāde pūrvottare sthitau .. 32 ..
16.11.d:
कुम्भ मीनौ तथा चास्य उत्तरां कुक्षिमाश्रितौ ..
मीनमेषौ महादेवि पादे पूर्वोत्तरे स्थितौ .. 32 ..
16.11.m: Aquarius and Pisces occupy his northern flank. / Pisces and Aries, O great goddess, are situated on the northeastern foot.

16.11.s:
kūrmmadeśāṃstatharkṣāṇi deśeṣveteṣu vai priye ..
rāśayaśca tatharkṣeṣu grahā rāśivyavasthitāḥ .. 33 ..
16.11.d:
कूर्म्मदेशांस्तथर्क्षाणि देशेष्वेतेषु वै प्रिये ..
राशयश्च तथर्क्षेषु ग्रहा राशिव्यवस्थिताः .. 33 ..
16.11.m: The regions of the Tortoise and the asterisms are in these regions, O beloved; / and the zodiacal signs are in the asterisms, and the planets are situated in the signs.

16.11.s:
tasmādgraharkṣapīḍāsu deśapīḍāṃ vinirdiśet ..
tatra snānaṃ prakurvaṃti dānaṃ homādikaṃ tathā .. 34 ..
16.11.d:
तस्माद्ग्रहर्क्षपीडासु देशपीडां विनिर्दिशेत् ..
तत्र स्नानं प्रकुर्वंति दानं होमादिकं तथा .. 34 ..
16.11.m: Therefore, in afflictions to planets and asterisms, one should predict affliction to regions. / There [in remedy], people perform ritual ablution, gifts, oblations, and the like.

16.11.s:
sa eṣa vaiṣṇavaḥ pādo devi madhye graho'sya yaḥ ..
nārāyaṇākhyo'ciṃtyātmā kāraṇaṃ jagataḥ prabhuḥ .. 35 ..
16.11.d:
स एष वैष्णवः पादो देवि मध्ये ग्रहोऽस्य यः ..
नारायणाख्योऽचिंत्यात्मा कारणं जगतः प्रभुः .. 35 ..
16.11.m: That foot of Viṣṇu, O goddess, in the middle of which is his planet, / is named Nārāyaṇa, of inconceivable nature, the cause, the Lord of the world.

16.11.s:
bhaumaśukrabudheṃdvarkabudhaśukramahīsutāḥ ..
gurumaṃdāsurācāryā meṣādīnāmadhīśvarāḥ .. 36 ..
16.11.d:
भौमशुक्रबुधेंद्वर्कबुधशुक्रमहीसुताः ..
गुरुमंदासुराचार्या मेषादीनामधीश्वराः .. 36 ..
16.11.m: Mars, Venus, Mercury, Moon, Sun, Mercury, Venus, the son of the Earth (Mars), / Jupiter, Saturn, and the teacher of the Asuras (Venus) are the rulers of the signs starting with Aries.

16.11.s:
evaṃvidho mahādevi kūrmarūpī janārddanaḥ ..
tasya naiṛtapāde tu saurāṣṭra iti viśrutaḥ .. 37 ..
16.11.d:
एवंविधो महादेवि कूर्मरूपी जनार्द्दनः ..
तस्य नैऋतपादे तु सौराष्ट्र इति विश्रुतः .. 37 ..
16.11.m: Such is Janārdana in the form of the Tortoise, O great goddess. / On his southwestern foot is the celebrated Saurāṣṭra.

16.11.s:
sa caivaṃ navadhā bhinnaḥ purabhedena suṃdari ..
tasya yo navamo bhāgaḥ sāgarasya ca sannidhau .. 38 ..
16.11.d:
स चैवं नवधा भिन्नः पुरभेदेन सुंदरि ..
तस्य यो नवमो भागः सागरस्य च सन्निधौ .. 38 ..
16.11.m: And that is divided ninefold according to the division of cities, O fair lady. / The ninth part of it, in the vicinity of the ocean,

16.11.s:
prabhāsa iti vikhyāto mama devi priyaḥ sadā ..
yojanānāṃ daśadve ca vistīrṇaḥ parimaṇḍalam .. 39 ..
16.11.d:
प्रभास इति विख्यातो मम देवि प्रियः सदा ..
योजनानां दशद्वे च विस्तीर्णः परिमण्डलम् .. 39 ..
16.11.m: is celebrated as Prabhāsa, always dear to me, O goddess. / It extends twelve yojanas in circumference.

16.11.s:
madhyesya pīṭhikā proktā paṃcayojanavistṛtā ..
tanmadhye madgrahaṃ devi tiṣṭhatyudadhisaṃnidhau .. .. 7.1.11.40 ..
16.11.d:
मध्येस्य पीठिका प्रोक्ता पंचयोजनविस्तृता ..
तन्मध्ये मद्ग्रहं देवि तिष्ठत्युदधिसंनिधौ .. .. 7.1.11.40 ..
16.11.m: In its middle is declared a pedestal five yojanas broad. / In the middle of that, O goddess, stands my abode near the ocean.

16.11.s: tasya madhye mahādevi liṃgarūpo vasāmyaham .. 41 ..
16.11.d: तस्य मध्ये महादेवि लिंगरूपो वसाम्यहम् .. 41 ..
16.11.m: In the middle of that, O great goddess, I dwell in the form of a liṅga.

16.11.s:
kṛtasmarātpaścimato dhanuṣāṃ ca śatatraye ..
vasāmi tatra deveśi tvayā saha varānane .. 42 ..
16.11.d:
कृतस्मरात्पश्चिमतो धनुषां च शतत्रये ..
वसामि तत्र देवेशि त्वया सह वरानने .. 42 ..
16.11.m: Three hundred bows to the west of Kṛtasmara, / I dwell there, O ruler of the gods, along with you, O fair-faced woman!

16.11.s:
tanme sthānaṃ mahādevi kailāsādapi vallabham ..
gocarmamātraṃ tatrāpi mahāgopyaṃ varānane .. 43 ..
16.11.d:
तन्मे स्थानं महादेवि कैलासादपि वल्लभम् ..
गोचर्ममात्रं तत्रापि महागोप्यं वरानने .. 43 ..
16.11.m: That place of mine, O great goddess, is dearer [to me] even than Kailāsa; / even there, a space of only a cow's hide is most secret, O fair-faced woman!

16.11.s:
akathyaṃ devadeveśi tava snehātprakāśitam ..
etatprābhāsikaṃ kṣetraṃ prabhayā dīpitaṃ mama .. 44 ..
16.11.d:
अकथ्यं देवदेवेशि तव स्नेहात्प्रकाशितम् ..
एतत्प्राभासिकं क्षेत्रं प्रभया दीपितं मम .. 44 ..
16.11.m: It should not be spoken of, O goddess of gods, yet revealed out of love for you: / this sacred field of Prabhāsa is illumined by my radiance.

16.11.s:
tena prabhāsamityuktamādikalpe varānane ..
dvitīye tu prabhā labdhā sarvairdevaiḥ savāsavaiḥ .. 45 ..
16.11.d:
तेन प्रभासमित्युक्तमादिकल्पे वरानने ..
द्वितीये तु प्रभा लब्धा सर्वैर्देवैः सवासवैः .. 45 ..
16.11.m: Therefore, O fair-faced lady, in the first kalpa it was called Prabhāsa; / in the second [kalpa], however, radiance was obtained [here] by all the gods headed by Indra.

16.11.s:
mama prabhābhā deveśi tena prābhāsikaṃ smṛtam ..
prabhāvavanto deveśi yatra saṃti mahāsurāḥ .. 46 ..
16.11.d:
मम प्रभाभा देवेशि तेन प्राभासिकं स्मृतम् ..
प्रभाववन्तो देवेशि यत्र संति महासुराः .. 46 ..
16.11.m: My splendor shines [here], O ruler of the gods; therefore it is remembered as Prabhāsa. / Where there are mighty asuras, O goddess of gods,

16.11.s:
athavā tena lokeṣu prabhāsamiti kīrtyate ..
prathamaṃ bhāsate devi sarveṣāṃ bhuvi tejasām ..
tīrthānāmāditīrthaṃ yatprabhāsaṃ tena kīrttitam .. ... 47 ..
16.11.d:
अथवा तेन लोकेषु प्रभासमिति कीर्त्यते ..
प्रथमं भासते देवि सर्वेषां भुवि तेजसाम् ..
तीर्थानामादितीर्थं यत्प्रभासं तेन कीर्त्तितम् .. ... 47 ..
16.11.m: or because of that, it is celebrated among the worlds as Prabhāsa. / Because it shines first on earth among all radiant lights, O goddess, / and is the first tīrtha among tīrthas, for that reason it is celebrated as Prabhāsa.

16.11.s:
prakṛṣṭaṃ bhānurathavā bhāsito viśvakarmaṇā ..
yatra sākṣātprabhāpāto jātaḥ prābhāsikaṃ tataḥ .. 48 ..
16.11.d:
प्रकृष्टं भानुरथवा भासितो विश्वकर्मणा ..
यत्र साक्षात्प्रभापातो जातः प्राभासिकं ततः .. 48 ..
16.11.m: Or else the sun was made to shine intensely by Viśvakarman; / because the actual falling of radiance took place here, it is therefore called Prabhāsa.

16.11.s:
athavā dakṣasaṃśaptenendunā niṣprabheṇaca ..
tatra devi prabhā labdhā tena prābhāsikaṃ smṛtam ..
proddadhe bhāratī devī hyaurvāgniṃ vaḍavānalam .. 49 ..
16.11.d:
अथवा दक्षसंशप्तेनेन्दुना निष्प्रभेणच ..
तत्र देवि प्रभा लब्धा तेन प्राभासिकं स्मृतम् ..
प्रोद्दधे भारती देवी ह्यौर्वाग्निं वडवानलम् .. 49 ..
16.11.m: Or else, because the moon, cursed by Dakṣa and devoid of radiance, / obtained radiance there, O goddess, it is remembered as Prabhāsa. / The goddess Sarasvatī carried the Aurva fire, the submarine blaze [to this place];

16.11.s:
athavā tena deveśi prabhāsamiti kīrtyate ..
prakṛṣṭā bhāratī brāhmī viproktā śrūyate'dhvani ..
sadā yatra mahādevi prabhāsaṃ tena kīrtitam .. 7.1.11.50 ..
16.11.d:
अथवा तेन देवेशि प्रभासमिति कीर्त्यते ..
प्रकृष्टा भारती ब्राह्मी विप्रोक्ता श्रूयतेऽध्वनि ..
सदा यत्र महादेवि प्रभासं तेन कीर्तितम् .. 7.1.11.50 ..
16.11.m: or because of that, O goddess of the gods, it is celebrated as Prabhāsa. / Because the excellent speech of Brahmā, uttered by brahmins, is constantly heard on the path / there, O great goddess, it is proclaimed as Prabhāsa.

16.11.s:
prollasadvīcibhirbhāti sarvadā sāgaraḥ priye ..
tena prabhāsa nāmeti triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam .. 51 ..
16.11.d:
प्रोल्लसद्वीचिभिर्भाति सर्वदा सागरः प्रिये ..
तेन प्रभास नामेति त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतम् .. 51 ..
16.11.m: Because the ocean always shines with surging waves, my beloved, / its name ‘Prabhāsa’ has become famous across the three worlds.

16.11.s:
pratyakṣaṃ bhāskaro yatra sadā tiṣṭhati bhāmini ..
tena prabhāsa nāmeti prasiddhimagamatkṣitau .. 52 ..
16.11.d:
प्रत्यक्षं भास्करो यत्र सदा तिष्ठति भामिनि ..
तेन प्रभास नामेति प्रसिद्धिमगमत्क्षितौ .. 52 ..
16.11.m: Because the sun visibly stays there always, O passionate lady, / it has become renowned on earth under the name ‘Prabhāsa’.

16.11.s:
prakṛṣṭaṃ bhāvināṃ sarvaṃ kāmaṃ tatra dadāmyaham ..
tena prabhāsanāmeti tīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam .. 53 ..
16.11.d:
प्रकृष्टं भाविनां सर्वं कामं तत्र ददाम्यहम् ..
तेन प्रभासनामेति तीर्थं त्रैलोक्यविश्रुतम् .. 53 ..
16.11.m: I grant every splendid desire to future beings there; / therefore this tīrtha is renowned across the three worlds by the name of Prabhāsa.

16.11.s:
kalpabhedena nāmāni tathaiva surasundari ..
niruktabhedairbahudhā bhidyaṃte kāraṇaiḥ priye ..
prabhāsamiti yannāma dātavyaṃ niścalaṃ smṛtam .. 54 ..
16.11.d:
कल्पभेदेन नामानि तथैव सुरसुन्दरि ..
निरुक्तभेदैर्बहुधा भिद्यंते कारणैः प्रिये ..
प्रभासमिति यन्नाम दातव्यं निश्चलं स्मृतम् .. 54 ..
16.11.m: Names vary according to kalpas, O beautiful lady of the gods; / through various etymological explanations, O beloved, they differ according to causes. / The name ‘Prabhāsa’ that is to be given is considered constant.

16.11.s:
aptattve saṃsthitaṃ devi viṣṇorādyakalevare ..
iti te kathitaṃ devi saṃkṣepātkṣetrakāraṇam .. 55 ..
16.11.d:
अप्तत्त्वे संस्थितं देवि विष्णोराद्यकलेवरे ..
इति ते कथितं देवि संक्षेपात्क्षेत्रकारणम् .. 55 ..
16.11.m: It rests on the water-principle, O goddess, in the primal body of Viṣṇu. / Thus, O goddess, has the origin of the sacred field been briefly told to you.

16.11.s:
punaste kathayāmyadya yatpṛcchasi varānane ..
tadbrūhi śīghraṃ kalyāṇi yatte manasi vartate .. 56 ..
16.11.d:
पुनस्ते कथयाम्यद्य यत्पृच्छसि वरानने ..
तद्ब्रूहि शीघ्रं कल्याणि यत्ते मनसि वर्तते .. 56 ..
16.11.m: I shall tell you again today whatever you ask, O fair-faced lady; / speak quickly, O auspicious one, what is in your heart.

16.11.s:
.. devyuvāca .. ..
asminkalpe yathā jātaṃ kṣetraṃ prābhāsikaṃ hara ..
tanme vistarato brūhi utpattiṃ kāraṇaṃ tathā .. 57 ..
16.11.d:
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
अस्मिन्कल्पे यथा जातं क्षेत्रं प्राभासिकं हर ..
तन्मे विस्तरतो ब्रूहि उत्पत्तिं कारणं तथा .. 57 ..
16.11.m: The goddess said: / As the sacred field of Prabhāsa arose in this kalpa, O Hara, / explain to me that at length—its origin and cause.

16.11.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi yathāvatkṣetrakāraṇam ..
yacchrutvā mānavo bhaktyā mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ.. 58 ..
16.11.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
शृणु देवि प्रवक्ष्यामि यथावत्क्षेत्रकारणम् ..
यच्छ्रुत्वा मानवो भक्त्या मुच्यते सर्वपातकैः.. 58 ..
16.11.m: Īśvara said: / Listen, O goddess, and I will accurately proclaim the cause of the sacred field, / hearing which with devotion, a mortal is freed from all sins.

16.11.s:
ādikṣetrasya māhātmyaṃ rahasyaṃ pāpanāśanam ..
kathayiṣye varārohe tava snehena bhāmini .. 59 ..
16.11.d:
आदिक्षेत्रस्य माहात्म्यं रहस्यं पापनाशनम् ..
कथयिष्ये वरारोहे तव स्नेहेन भामिनि .. 59 ..
16.11.m: The māhātmya of the primal sacred field is a secret that destroys sin; / I shall recount it out of love for you, O lady of fair hips, O passionate one.

16.11.s:
asminkalpe tu yaddevi ādāveva varānane ..
svāyaṃbhuve manau tatra brahmaṇaḥ sṛjataḥ purā .. 7.1.11.60 ..
16.11.d:
अस्मिन्कल्पे तु यद्देवि आदावेव वरानने ..
स्वायंभुवे मनौ तत्र ब्रह्मणः सृजतः पुरा .. 7.1.11.60 ..
16.11.m: In this kalpa, O fair-faced lady, right at the beginning, / in the age of the Svāyambhuva Manu, when Brahmā was creating long ago, O goddess,

16.11.s:
dakṣiṇāllocanājjātaḥ pūrvaṃ sūrya iti priye ..
tataḥ kālāntare tasya bhārye dve ca babhūvatuḥ .. 61 ..
16.11.d:
दक्षिणाल्लोचनाज्जातः पूर्वं सूर्य इति प्रिये ..
ततः कालान्तरे तस्य भार्ये द्वे च बभूवतुः .. 61 ..
16.11.m: the sun was born first from his right eye, O beloved. / Then, in course of time, he had two wives.

16.11.s:
tayostu rājñī dyaurjñeyā nikṣubhā pṛthivī smṛtā ..
saumyamāsasya saptamyāṃ dyauḥ sūryeṇa ca yujyate .. 62 ..
16.11.d:
तयोस्तु राज्ञी द्यौर्ज्ञेया निक्षुभा पृथिवी स्मृता ..
सौम्यमासस्य सप्तम्यां द्यौः सूर्येण च युज्यते .. 62 ..
16.11.m: Of the two, the sky is known as Rājñī, and the earth is remembered as Nikṣubhā. / On the seventh day of the bright half of the month, the sky is united with the sun.

16.11.s:
māghamāse tu saptamyāṃ mahyā saha bhavedraviḥ..
bhūścādityaśca bhagavāngacchate saṃgamaṃ tadā.. 63 ..
16.11.d:
माघमासे तु सप्तम्यां मह्या सह भवेद्रविः..
भूश्चादित्यश्च भगवान्गच्छते संगमं तदा.. 63 ..
16.11.m: And on the seventh day in the month of Māgha, the sun unites with the earth; / then the earth and the lord Sun enter into conjunction.

16.11.s:
ṛtusnātā mahī tatra garbhaṃ gṛhṇāti bhāskarāt ..
dyaurjalaṃ sūyate garbhaṃ varṣāsvāsviha bhūtale ..64..
16.11.d:
ऋतुस्नाता मही तत्र गर्भं गृह्णाति भास्करात् ..
द्यौर्जलं सूयते गर्भं वर्षास्वास्विह भूतले ..64..
16.11.m: Having bathed after her menstrual period, the earth then receives an embryo from the sun; / the sky brings forth an embryo of water on the surface of the earth during these rainy seasons.

16.11.s:
tatastrailokyavṛttyarthaṃ mahī sasyāni sūyate ..
sasyopayogātsaṃhṛṣṭā juhvatyāhutibhirdvijāḥ .. 65 ..
16.11.d:
ततस्त्रैलोक्यवृत्त्यर्थं मही सस्यानि सूयते ..
सस्योपयोगात्संहृष्टा जुह्वत्याहुतिभिर्द्विजाः .. 65 ..
16.11.m: Then, for the sustenance of the three worlds, the earth brings forth crops. / Rejoicing through the use of crops, twice-born brahmins make oblations with offerings;

16.11.s:
svāhākārasvadhākārairyajaṃti pitṛdevatāḥ ..
niḥkṣudhaḥ kurute yasmādgarbhauṣadhisudhā'mṛtaiḥ .1 66 ..
16.11.d:
स्वाहाकारस्वधाकारैर्यजंति पितृदेवताः ..
निःक्षुधः कुरुते यस्माद्गर्भौषधिसुधाऽमृतैः .1 66 ..
16.11.m: they worship ancestors and deities with the utterances ‘Svāhā’ and ‘Svadhā’. / Because she renders devoid of hunger (niḥkṣudhā) with embryos, herbs, nectar, and ambrosia

16.11.s:
martyānpitṝṃśca devāṃśca tena bhūrnikṣubhā smṛtā ..
yathā rājñī ca saṃjātā yasya ceyaṃ sutā matā .. .. 67 ..
16.11.d:
मर्त्यान्पितॄंश्च देवांश्च तेन भूर्निक्षुभा स्मृता ..
यथा राज्ञी च संजाता यस्य चेयं सुता मता .. .. 67 ..
16.11.m: mortals, ancestors, and gods, the earth is remembered as Nikṣubhā. / Just as Rājñī was born, and whose daughter she is considered to be,

16.11.s:
apatyāni ca yānyasyāstāni vakṣyāmyaśeṣataḥ ..
marīcirbrahmaṇaḥ putro mārīcaḥ kaśyapaḥ smṛtaḥ .. 68 ..
16.11.d:
अपत्यानि च यान्यस्यास्तानि वक्ष्याम्यशेषतः ..
मरीचिर्ब्रह्मणः पुत्रो मारीचः कश्यपः स्मृतः .. 68 ..
16.11.m: and the offspring she had, all that I will tell without omission. / Marīci was the son of Brahmā, and Kaśyapa is remembered as the son of Marīci.

16.11.s:
tasmāddhiraṇyakaśipuḥ prahrādastasya cātmajaḥ ..
prahrādasya suto nāmnā virocana iti smṛtaḥ .. 69 ..
16.11.d:
तस्माद्धिरण्यकशिपुः प्रह्रादस्तस्य चात्मजः ..
प्रह्रादस्य सुतो नाम्ना विरोचन इति स्मृतः .. 69 ..
16.11.m: From him came Hiraṇyakaśipu, and Prahrāda was his son. / The son of Prahrāda was remembered by the name Virocana.

16.11.s:
virocanasya bhaginī saṃjñā yā jananī tu sā ..
hiraṇyakaśipoḥ pautrī diteḥ putrasya sā smṛtā .. 7.1.11.70 ..
16.11.d:
विरोचनस्य भगिनी संज्ञा या जननी तु सा ..
हिरण्यकशिपोः पौत्री दितेः पुत्रस्य सा स्मृता .. 7.1.11.70 ..
16.11.m: The sister of Virocana was Saṃjñā, who was the mother [of Yama]; / she is remembered as the granddaughter of Hiraṇyakaśipu, the son of Diti.

16.11.s: sā viśvakarmaṇaḥ patnī prāhlādī procyate budhaiḥ .. 71 ..
16.11.d: सा विश्वकर्मणः पत्नी प्राह्लादी प्रोच्यते बुधैः .. 71 ..
16.11.m: She, the descendant of Prahrāda, is declared by the wise to be the wife of Viśvakarman.

16.11.s:
atha nāmnātirūpeti marīciduhitā śubhā ..
patnī hyaṃgirasaḥ sā tu jananī ca bṛhaspateḥ .. 72 ..
16.11.d:
अथ नाम्नातिरूपेति मरीचिदुहिता शुभा ..
पत्नी ह्यंगिरसः सा तु जननी च बृहस्पतेः .. 72 ..
16.11.m: Now, the auspicious daughter of Marīci was named Atirūpā; / she was indeed the wife of Aṅgiras and the mother of Bṛhaspati.

16.11.s:
bṛhaspatestu bhaginī viśrutā brahmavādinī ..
prabhāsasya tu sā patnī vasūnāmaṣṭamasya vai .. 73 ..
16.11.d:
बृहस्पतेस्तु भगिनी विश्रुता ब्रह्मवादिनी ..
प्रभासस्य तु सा पत्नी वसूनामष्टमस्य वै .. 73 ..
16.11.m: The renowned sister of Bṛhaspati was an expounder of the Veda; / she was the wife of Prabhāsa, the eighth of the Vasus.

16.11.s:
prasūtā viśvakarmāṇaṃ sarvaśilpavatāṃ varam ..
sa caiva nāmnā tvaṣṭā tu punastridaśavārddhakiḥ .. 74 ..
16.11.d:
प्रसूता विश्वकर्माणं सर्वशिल्पवतां वरम् ..
स चैव नाम्ना त्वष्टा तु पुनस्त्रिदशवार्द्धकिः .. 74 ..
16.11.m: She gave birth to Viśvakarman, the best among all craftsmen; / he is also known by the name Tvaṣṭṛ, the carpenter of the thirty gods.

16.11.s:
devācāryasya tasyeyaṃ duhitā viśvakarmaṇaḥ ..
sureṇuriti vikhyātā triṣu lokeṣu bhāminī .. 75 ..
16.11.d:
देवाचार्यस्य तस्येयं दुहिता विश्वकर्मणः ..
सुरेणुरिति विख्याता त्रिषु लोकेषु भामिनी .. 75 ..
16.11.m: This passionate lady, the daughter of that Viśvakarman, the teacher of the gods, / is celebrated in the three worlds as Sureṇu.

16.11.s:
prahrādaputrī yā proktā bhāryā vaṣṭustu sā smṛtā ..
tasyāṃ sa janayāmāsa putrīstā lokamātaraḥ .. 76 ..
16.11.d:
प्रह्रादपुत्री या प्रोक्ता भार्या वष्टुस्तु सा स्मृता ..
तस्यां स जनयामास पुत्रीस्ता लोकमातरः .. 76 ..
16.11.m: She who was described as the daughter of Prahrāda is remembered as the wife of Tvaṣṭṛ; / upon her he begot daughters who are mothers of the world:

16.11.s:
rājñī saṃjñā ca dyaustvaṣṭrī prabhā saiva vibhāvyate ..
tasyāstu valayā chāyā nikṣubhā sā mahīyasī .. 77 ..
16.11.d:
राज्ञी संज्ञा च द्यौस्त्वष्ट्री प्रभा सैव विभाव्यते ..
तस्यास्तु वलया छाया निक्षुभा सा महीयसी .. 77 ..
16.11.m: Rājñī, Saṃjñā, the sky, and Tvaṣṭrī; she is also conceived as Prabhā. / Her shadow (chāyā), Valayā, is the exalted Nikṣubhā.

16.11.s:
sā tu bhāryā bhagavatī mārtaṃḍasya mahātmanaḥ ..
sādhvī pativratā devī rūpayauvanaśālinī .. 78 ..
16.11.d:
सा तु भार्या भगवती मार्तंडस्य महात्मनः ..
साध्वी पतिव्रता देवी रूपयौवनशालिनी .. 78 ..
16.11.m: She was the divine wife of the great Mārtaṇḍa, / a virtuous lady, devoted to her husband, endowed with beauty and youth.

16.11.s:
na tu tāṃ nararūpeṇa bhāryāṃ bhajati vai purā ..
ādityasyeha taptatvaṃ mahatā svena tejasā .. 79..
16.11.d:
न तु तां नररूपेण भार्यां भजति वै पुरा ..
आदित्यस्येह तप्तत्वं महता स्वेन तेजसा .. 79..
16.11.m: Formerly, however, he did not approach his wife in human form; / the scorching heat of the sun in this world was due to his own great brilliance.

16.11.s:
gātreṣvapratirūpeṣu māsikāṃtamivābhavat ..
saṃjñā ca raviṇā dṛṣṭā nimīlayati locane ..
yatastataḥ saroṣo'rkaḥ saṃjñāṃ vacanamabravīt .. 7.1.11.80 ..
16.11.d:
गात्रेष्वप्रतिरूपेषु मासिकांतमिवाभवत् ..
संज्ञा च रविणा दृष्टा निमीलयति लोचने ..
यतस्ततः सरोषोऽर्कः संज्ञां वचनमब्रवीत् .. 7.1.11.80 ..
16.11.m: Upon her incomparable limbs, [his embrace] seemed to cause distress. / And Saṃjñā, seen by the sun, closed her eyes; / because of that, the sun, filled with wrath, addressed words to Saṃjñā:

16.11.s:
.. raviruvāca .. ..
mayi dṛṣṭe sadā yasmātkuruṣe netrasaṃkṣayam ..
tasmājjaniṣyase mūḍhe prajāsaṃyamanaṃ yamam .. 81 ..
16.11.d:
.. रविरुवाच .. ..
मयि दृष्टे सदा यस्मात्कुरुषे नेत्रसंक्षयम् ..
तस्माज्जनिष्यसे मूढे प्रजासंयमनं यमम् .. 81 ..
16.11.m: The sun said: / Because whenever I am seen you shut your eyes, / therefore, O foolish woman, you shall give birth to Yama, the restrainer of creatures.

16.11.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tataḥ sā capalā dṛṣṭiṃ devī cakre bhayākulā ..
vilolitadṛśaṃ dṛṣṭvā punarāha ca tāṃ raviḥ .. 82 ..
16.11.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततः सा चपला दृष्टिं देवी चक्रे भयाकुला ..
विलोलितदृशं दृष्ट्वा पुनराह च तां रविः .. 82 ..
16.11.m: Īśvara said: / Then the goddess, overcome with fear, cast an unsteady glance; / seeing her unsteady look, the sun spoke to her again:

16.11.s:
.. raviruvāca .. ..
yasmādvilolitā dṛṣṭirmayi dṛṣṭe tvayā punaḥ ..
tasmādvilolāṃ tanayāṃ nadīṃ tvaṃ prasaviṣyasi .. .. 83 ..
16.11.d:
.. रविरुवाच .. ..
यस्माद्विलोलिता दृष्टिर्मयि दृष्टे त्वया पुनः ..
तस्माद्विलोलां तनयां नदीं त्वं प्रसविष्यसि .. .. 83 ..
16.11.m: The sun said: / Because an unsteady glance was cast by you when looking at me again, / therefore you will bring forth an unsteady daughter, a river.

16.11.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tatastasyāstu saṃjajñe bhartṛśāpena tena vai ..
yamaśca yamunā ceyaṃ prakhyātā sumahānadī ..
tṛtīyaṃ ca sutaṃ jajñe śrāddhadevaṃ manuṃ śubham .. 84 ..
16.11.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततस्तस्यास्तु संजज्ञे भर्तृशापेन तेन वै ..
यमश्च यमुना चेयं प्रख्याता सुमहानदी ..
तृतीयं च सुतं जज्ञे श्राद्धदेवं मनुं शुभम् .. 84 ..
16.11.m: Īśvara said: / Then, on account of that curse of her husband, / Yama was born to her, as well as Yamunā, who is renowned as a very great river; / and as a third son she bore the auspicious Manu Śrāddhadeva.

16.11.s:
sāpi saṃjñā ravestejo golākāraṃ mahāprabham ..
asahantī ca sā citte cintayāmāsa vai tadā .. 85 ..
16.11.d:
सापि संज्ञा रवेस्तेजो गोलाकारं महाप्रभम् ..
असहन्ती च सा चित्ते चिन्तयामास वै तदा .. 85 ..
16.11.m: Unable to bear the sun’s spherical, immensely brilliant radiance, / Saṃjñā then thought in her heart:

16.11.s:
kiṃ karomi kva yāsyāmi kva gatāyāśca nirvṛtiḥ ..
bhavenmama kathaṃ bhartā kopamarkkaśca neṣyati .. 86 ..
16.11.d:
किं करोमि क्व यास्यामि क्व गतायाश्च निर्वृतिः ..
भवेन्मम कथं भर्ता कोपमर्क्कश्च नेष्यति .. 86 ..
16.11.m: “What shall I do? Where shall I go? Where going could I find relief? / How will my husband, the sun, not bring his wrath [upon me]?”

16.11.s:
iti saṃcintya bahudhā prajāpatisutā tadā ..
bahu mene mahābhāgā pitṛsaṃśrayameva ca .. 87 ..
16.11.d:
इति संचिन्त्य बहुधा प्रजापतिसुता तदा ..
बहु मेने महाभागा पितृसंश्रयमेव च .. 87 ..
16.11.m: Thinking thus in many ways, the Prajāpati's daughter then, / highly fortunate, regarded taking shelter with her father as best.

16.11.s:
tataḥ pitṛgṛhaṃ gantuṃ kṛtabuddhiryaśasvinī ..
chāyāmayīmātmatanuṃ pratyaṃgamiva nirmitām .. 88 ..
16.11.d:
ततः पितृगृहं गन्तुं कृतबुद्धिर्यशस्विनी ..
छायामयीमात्मतनुं प्रत्यंगमिव निर्मिताम् .. 88 ..
16.11.m: Then, having resolved to go to her father's house, the illustrious woman, / [creating] a form made of shadow like her own body, fashioned limb for limb,

16.11.s: sammukhaṃ prekṣya tāṃ devīṃ svāṃ chāyāṃ vākyamabravīt .. 89 ..
16.11.d: सम्मुखं प्रेक्ष्य तां देवीं स्वां छायां वाक्यमब्रवीत् .. 89 ..
16.11.m: looking face to face at that goddess, her own shadow, spoke these words:

16.11.s:
.. saṃjñovāca .. ..
ahaṃ yāsyāmi bhadraṃ te svakaṃ ca bhavanaṃ pituḥ ..
nirvikāraṃ tvayā tvatra stheyaṃ macchāsanācchubhe .. 7.1.11.90 ..
16.11.d:
.. संज्ञोवाच .. ..
अहं यास्यामि भद्रं ते स्वकं च भवनं पितुः ..
निर्विकारं त्वया त्वत्र स्थेयं मच्छासनाच्छुभे .. 7.1.11.90 ..
16.11.m: Saṃjñā said: / “May you be blessed! I shall go to my own father's dwelling. / You, auspicious one, must remain here without alteration according to my command.

16.11.s:
imau ca bālakau mahyaṃ kanyā ca varavarṇinī ..
saṃbhāvyā naiva cākhyeyamidaṃ bhagavate tvayā .. 91 ..
16.11.d:
इमौ च बालकौ मह्यं कन्या च वरवर्णिनी ..
संभाव्या नैव चाख्येयमिदं भगवते त्वया .. 91 ..
16.11.m: These two young boys of mine and this fair-complexioned girl / are to be cherished, and this is not to be disclosed by you to the lord.

16.11.s:
pṛṣṭayāpi na vācyaṃ te tathaitadgamanaṃ mama ..
tenāsmi nāmasaṃjñeti vācyase tatpratiṣṭhayā .. 92 ..
16.11.d:
पृष्टयापि न वाच्यं ते तथैतद्गमनं मम ..
तेनास्मि नामसंज्ञेति वाच्यसे तत्प्रतिष्ठया .. 92 ..
16.11.m: Even if questioned, my departure must not be spoken of by you. / For that reason, I am named Saṃjñā, and you shall be addressed by establishing yourself as that.”

16.11.s:
.. chāyovāca .. ..
ā keśagrahaṇāddevi ā śāpānnaiva karhicit ..
ākhyāsyāmi mataṃ tubhyaṃ gamyatāṃ yatra vāṃchitam .. 93 ..
16.11.d:
.. छायोवाच .. ..
आ केशग्रहणाद्देवि आ शापान्नैव कर्हिचित् ..
आख्यास्यामि मतं तुभ्यं गम्यतां यत्र वांछितम् .. 93 ..
16.11.m: Chāyā said: / “Short of having my hair seized, O goddess, and short of a curse, / I will never reveal what you intend. Go where you desire!”

16.11.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
ityuktā sā tadā devī jagāma bhavanaṃ pituḥ ..
dadarśa tatra tvaṣṭāraṃ tapasā dhūtakalmaṣam .. 94 ..
16.11.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
इत्युक्ता सा तदा देवी जगाम भवनं पितुः ..
ददर्श तत्र त्वष्टारं तपसा धूतकल्मषम् .. 94 ..
16.11.m: Īśvara said: / Having been addressed thus, the goddess then went to her father's dwelling. / There she saw Tvaṣṭṛ, whose sins had been washed away by austerity.

16.11.s:
bahumānācca tenāpi pūjitā viśvakarmaṇā ..
varṣāṇāṃ ca sahasraṃ tu vasamānā piturgṛhe ..
tasthau pitṛgṛhe sā tu kiṃcitkālamaniṃditā .. 95 ..
16.11.d:
बहुमानाच्च तेनापि पूजिता विश्वकर्मणा ..
वर्षाणां च सहस्रं तु वसमाना पितुर्गृहे ..
तस्थौ पितृगृहे सा तु किंचित्कालमनिंदिता .. 95 ..
16.11.m: She was also welcomed with great respect by Viśvakarman. / Living in her father's house, / the blameless woman dwelt in her father's house for some time [as if] for a thousand years.

16.11.s:
tatastāṃ prāha cārvaṃgīṃ pitā nāticiroṣitām ..
stutvā tu tanayāṃ premṇā bahumānapuraḥsaram .. 96 ..
16.11.d:
ततस्तां प्राह चार्वंगीं पिता नातिचिरोषिताम् ..
स्तुत्वा तु तनयां प्रेम्णा बहुमानपुरःसरम् .. 96 ..
16.11.m: Then her father, after praising his daughter with love and respect, / said to the lovely-limbed woman who had not stayed too long:

16.11.s:
.. viśvakarmovāca .. ..
tvāmeva paśyato vatse dināni subahūnyapi ..
muhūrtārddhasamāni syuḥ kiṃ tu dharmo vilupyate .. 97 ..
16.11.d:
.. विश्वकर्मोवाच .. ..
त्वामेव पश्यतो वत्से दिनानि सुबहून्यपि ..
मुहूर्तार्द्धसमानि स्युः किं तु धर्मो विलुप्यते .. 97 ..
16.11.m: Viśvakarman said: / “O child, even very many days seem like half a muhūrta / to me merely looking at you; yet dharma is violated.

16.11.s:
bāṃdhaveṣu ciraṃ vāso nārīṇāṃ na yaśaskaraḥ ..
manorathā bāṃdhavānāṃ nāryā bhartṛgṛhe sthitiḥ .. 98 ..
16.11.d:
बांधवेषु चिरं वासो नारीणां न यशस्करः ..
मनोरथा बांधवानां नार्या भर्तृगृहे स्थितिः .. 98 ..
16.11.m: A long stay among relatives does not bring renown to women. / The desire of relatives is a woman's stay in her husband's home.

16.11.s:
sā tvaṃ trailokyanāthena bhartrā sūryeṇa saṃyutā ..
piturgṛhe ciraṃ kālaṃ vastuṃ nārhasi putrike .. 99 ..
16.11.d:
सा त्वं त्रैलोक्यनाथेन भर्त्रा सूर्येण संयुता ..
पितुर्गृहे चिरं कालं वस्तुं नार्हसि पुत्रिके .. 99 ..
16.11.m: Joined with such a husband as the sun, the lord of the three worlds, / you ought not to dwell in your father's home for a long time, dear daughter.

16.11.s:
tattvaṃ bhartṛgṛhaṃ gaccha dṛṣṭo'haṃ pūjitāsi me ..
punarāgamanaṃ kāryaṃ darśanāya śucismite .. 7.1.11.100 ..
16.11.d:
तत्त्वं भर्तृगृहं गच्छ दृष्टोऽहं पूजितासि मे ..
पुनरागमनं कार्यं दर्शनाय शुचिस्मिते .. 7.1.11.100 ..
16.11.m: Therefore, go to your husband's home. I have seen you, and you have been honored by me. / You should come again to see me, O pure-smiling one.”

16.11.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
ityuktā sā tadā pitrā gacchagaccheti sā punaḥ ..
saṃpūjayitvā pitaraṃ vaḍavārūpadhāriṇī .. 101 ..
16.11.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
इत्युक्ता सा तदा पित्रा गच्छगच्छेति सा पुनः ..
संपूजयित्वा पितरं वडवारूपधारिणी .. 101 ..
16.11.m: Īśvara said: / Addressed thus by her father, who repeatedly said, “Go, go,” / she worshiped her father and, assuming the form of a mare,

16.11.s:
meroruttaratastatra varṣaṃ yaddhanuṣākṛti ..
uttarāḥ kuravo loke prakhyātā ye yaśasvini .. 102 ..
16.11.d:
मेरोरुत्तरतस्तत्र वर्षं यद्धनुषाकृति ..
उत्तराः कुरवो लोके प्रख्याता ये यशस्विनि .. 102 ..
16.11.m: went to the region shaped like a bow to the north of Meru, / the Uttarakurus renowned in the world, O illustrious one.

16.11.s:
tatra tepe tapaḥ sādhvī nirāhārā'śvarūpiṇī ..
etasminnaṃtare devi tasyāśchāyā vivasvataḥ .. 103 ..
16.11.d:
तत्र तेपे तपः साध्वी निराहाराऽश्वरूपिणी ..
एतस्मिन्नंतरे देवि तस्याश्छाया विवस्वतः .. 103 ..
16.11.m: There the virtuous woman, taking no food, performed austerity in the form of a mare. / Meanwhile, O goddess, the shadow of that [Saṃjñā],

16.11.s:
samīpasthā tadā devī saṃjñāyā vākyatatparā ..
tasyāṃ ca bhagavānsūryo dvitīyāyāṃ divaspatiḥ .. 104 ..
16.11.d:
समीपस्था तदा देवी संज्ञाया वाक्यतत्परा ..
तस्यां च भगवान्सूर्यो द्वितीयायां दिवस्पतिः .. 104 ..
16.11.m: the goddess who was then staying near Vivasvat, intent on Saṃjñā’s instruction— / upon her, the second, the lord sun, ruler of heaven,

16.11.s:
saṃjñeyamiti manvāno rūpaudāryeṇa mohitaḥ ..
tasyāṃ ca janayāmāsa dvau putrau kanyakāṃ tathā .. 105 ..
16.11.d:
संज्ञेयमिति मन्वानो रूपौदार्येण मोहितः ..
तस्यां च जनयामास द्वौ पुत्रौ कन्यकां तथा .. 105 ..
16.11.m: thinking, “This is Saṃjñā,” captivated by her beauty and generosity, / begot two sons and likewise a daughter.

16.11.s:
pūrvaṃ yastu manostulyaḥ sāvarṇistena so'bhavat ..
yaḥ sūryātprathamaṃ jātaḥ putrayoḥ surasundari .. 106 ..
16.11.d:
पूर्वं यस्तु मनोस्तुल्यः सावर्णिस्तेन सोऽभवत् ..
यः सूर्यात्प्रथमं जातः पुत्रयोः सुरसुन्दरि .. 106 ..
16.11.m: He who was equal to the former Manu became known because of that as Sāvarṇi, / the first among the two sons born from the sun, O beauty of the gods.

16.11.s:
dvitīyo yo'bhavaccānyaḥ sa graho'bhūcchanaiścaraḥ ..
kanyā 'bhūttapatī yā tāṃ vavre saṃvaraṇo nṛpaḥ .. 107 ..
16.11.d:
द्वितीयो योऽभवच्चान्यः स ग्रहोऽभूच्छनैश्चरः ..
कन्या ऽभूत्तपती या तां वव्रे संवरणो नृपः .. 107 ..
16.11.m: The other who was born second became the planet Śanaiścara. / The daughter was Tapatī, whom King Saṃvaraṇa chose.

16.11.s:
tāpīnāma nadī ceyaṃ viṃdhyamūlādviniḥsṛtā ..
nityaṃ puṇyajalā snāne paścimodadhigāminī ..108..
16.11.d:
तापीनाम नदी चेयं विंध्यमूलाद्विनिःसृता ..
नित्यं पुण्यजला स्नाने पश्चिमोदधिगामिनी ..108..
16.11.m: And this river named Tāpī flowed forth from the foot of the Vindhya [mountains], / possessing water ever holy for ritual ablution, flowing to the western ocean.

16.11.s:
anyā caiva tathā bhadrā jātā putrī mahāprabhā ..
saṃjñā tu pārthivī chāyā ātmajānāṃ yathākarot .. 109 ..
16.11.d:
अन्या चैव तथा भद्रा जाता पुत्री महाप्रभा ..
संज्ञा तु पार्थिवी छाया आत्मजानां यथाकरोत् .. 109 ..
16.11.m: And another daughter, Bhadrā of great splendor, was also born. / But the earthly Chāyā, [acting] as Saṃjñā, showed toward her own offspring

16.11.s:
snehaṃ na pūrvajātānāṃ tathā kṛtavatī satī..
lālanādyupabhogeṣu viśeṣamanuvāsaram..7.1.11.110..
16.11.d:
स्नेहं न पूर्वजातानां तथा कृतवती सती..
लालनाद्युपभोगेषु विशेषमनुवासरम्..7.1.11.110..
16.11.m: affection, but the virtuous woman did not do so toward those born previously, / showing a difference day after day in pampering and luxuries.

16.11.s:
yathā sveṣvanuvarteta na tathānyeṣu bhāminī ..
manustu kṣāṃtavāṃstasyā bhaviṣyo yo hi pārvati ..111..
16.11.d:
यथा स्वेष्वनुवर्तेत न तथान्येषु भामिनी ..
मनुस्तु क्षांतवांस्तस्या भविष्यो यो हि पार्वति ..111..
16.11.m: The passionate woman did not conduct herself toward the others as she did toward her own. / But Manu, who is the future [Manu], O Pārvatī, was patient with her;

16.11.s:
merau tiṣṭhati so'dyāpi tapaḥ kurvanvarānane ..
sarvaṃ tatkṣāṃtavānmāturyamastasyā na cakṣame .. 112 ..
16.11.d:
मेरौ तिष्ठति सोऽद्यापि तपः कुर्वन्वरानने ..
सर्वं तत्क्षांतवान्मातुर्यमस्तस्या न चक्षमे .. 112 ..
16.11.m: he stays on Meru even today, performing austerity, O fair-faced one. / He endured all that from his mother, but Yama could not endure it.

16.11.s:
bahuśo yācamānastu chāyayā'tīva kopitaḥ ..
sa vai kopācca bālyācca bhāvino'rthasya vai balāt .. 113 ..
16.11.d:
बहुशो याचमानस्तु छाययाऽतीव कोपितः ..
स वै कोपाच्च बाल्याच्च भाविनोऽर्थस्य वै बलात् .. 113 ..
16.11.m: Asking repeatedly, he was greatly provoked by Chāyā. / Out of anger, and out of childishness, and indeed by the power of what was destined to be,

16.11.s:
tāḍanāya tataḥ kopātpādastena samudyataḥ ..
tathā punaḥ kṣāṃtimatā na tu dehe nipātitaḥ .. 114 ..
16.11.d:
ताडनाय ततः कोपात्पादस्तेन समुद्यतः ..
तथा पुनः क्षांतिमता न तु देहे निपातितः .. 114 ..
16.11.m: his foot was raised by him in anger to strike [her], / yet, because of his forbearance, it was not dropped upon her body.

16.11.s: padā saṃtarjayāmāsa chāyāṃ saṃjñāsuto yamaḥ .. 115 ..
16.11.d: पदा संतर्जयामास छायां संज्ञासुतो यमः .. 115 ..
16.11.m: With his foot Yama, the son of Saṃjñā, threatened Chāyā.

16.11.s:
taṃ śaśāpa tataśchāyā kruddhā sā pārthivī bhṛśam ..
kiṃcitprasphuramāṇoṣṭhī vicalatpāṇipallavā .. 116 ..
16.11.d:
तं शशाप ततश्छाया क्रुद्धा सा पार्थिवी भृशम् ..
किंचित्प्रस्फुरमाणोष्ठी विचलत्पाणिपल्लवा .. 116 ..
16.11.m: Then Chāyā, that earthly woman, exceedingly enraged, cursed him, / her lips trembling slightly and the sprout of her hand shaking:

16.11.s:
.. chāyovāca .. ..
pituḥ patnīmamaryāda yanmāṃ tarjayase padā ..
bhuvi tasmādayaṃ pādastavādyaiva patiṣyati.. 117 .. ..
16.11.d:
.. छायोवाच .. ..
पितुः पत्नीममर्याद यन्मां तर्जयसे पदा ..
भुवि तस्मादयं पादस्तवाद्यैव पतिष्यति.. 117 .. ..
16.11.m: Chāyā said: / “Since you insolently threaten me, your father's wife, with your foot, / therefore this foot of yours will fall to the earth this very day!”

16.11.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
yamastu tena śāpena bhṛśaṃ pīḍitamānasaḥ ..
manunā saha dharmātmā pitre sarvaṃ nyavedayat.. 118 ..
16.11.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
यमस्तु तेन शापेन भृशं पीडितमानसः ..
मनुना सह धर्मात्मा पित्रे सर्वं न्यवेदयत्.. 118 ..
16.11.m: Īśvara said: / Yama, his mind severely tormented by that curse, / righteous in nature, reported everything to his father along with Manu.

16.11.s:
.. yama uvāca .. ..
tātaitanmahadāścaryaṃ na dṛṣṭamiha kenacit ..
mātā vātsalyamutsṛjya śāpaṃ putre prayacchati ..119..
16.11.d:
.. यम उवाच .. ..
तातैतन्महदाश्चर्यं न दृष्टमिह केनचित् ..
माता वात्सल्यमुत्सृज्य शापं पुत्रे प्रयच्छति ..119..
16.11.m: Yama said: / “O father, this is a great wonder; it has not been seen by anyone here: / a mother, casting aside maternal love, confers a curse upon her son!

16.11.s:
snehena tulyamasmāsu mātādya naiva varttate ..
visṛjya jyāyaso yasmātkanīyaḥsu bubhūṣati .. 7.1.11.120 ..
16.11.d:
स्नेहेन तुल्यमस्मासु माताद्य नैव वर्त्तते ..
विसृज्य ज्यायसो यस्मात्कनीयःसु बुभूषति .. 7.1.11.120 ..
16.11.m: Our mother today does not behave with equal affection toward us, / since, neglecting the elders, she wishes to be [partial] to the younger ones.

16.11.s:
tasyā mayodyataḥ pādo na tu dehe nipātitaḥ ..
bālyādvā yadi vā mohāttadbhavānkṣaṃtumarhati ..121..
16.11.d:
तस्या मयोद्यतः पादो न तु देहे निपातितः ..
बाल्याद्वा यदि वा मोहात्तद्भवान्क्षंतुमर्हति ..121..
16.11.m: My foot was raised toward her, but it was not brought down upon her body. / Whether out of childishness or delusion, you ought to forgive it.

16.11.s:
śapto'haṃ tāta kopena tayā suta iti sphuṭam ..
ato na mahyaṃ jananī sā bhavedvadatāṃ vara .. 122 ..
16.11.d:
शप्तोऽहं तात कोपेन तया सुत इति स्फुटम् ..
अतो न मह्यं जननी सा भवेद्वदतां वर .. 122 ..
16.11.m: I was cursed in anger by her explicitly as a son, O father; / therefore she cannot be my mother, O best of speakers!

16.11.s:
nigurṇeṣvapi putreṣu na mātā nirguṇā bhavet ..
pādaste patatāṃ putra kathametattayoditam .. 123 ..
16.11.d:
निगुर्णेष्वपि पुत्रेषु न माता निर्गुणा भवेत् ..
पादस्ते पततां पुत्र कथमेतत्तयोदितम् .. 123 ..
16.11.m: Even when sons are without virtues, a mother does not become devoid of affection. / ‘May your foot fall, son!’—how could this be uttered by her?

16.11.s:
tava prasādāccaraṇo na patedbhagavanyathā ..
mātṛśāpādayaṃ me'dya tathā ciṃtaya gopate .. 124 ..
16.11.d:
तव प्रसादाच्चरणो न पतेद्भगवन्यथा ..
मातृशापादयं मेऽद्य तथा चिंतय गोपते .. 124 ..
16.11.m: Devise a way, O lord, O lord of rays, so that by your favor / this foot of mine does not fall today on account of my mother's curse.”

16.11.s:
.. raviruvāca .. ..
asaṃśayaṃ mahatputra bhaviṣyatyatra kāraṇam ..
yena te hyāviśatkrodho dharmajñasya mahātmanaḥ .. 126 ..
sarveṣāmeva śāpānāṃ pratighāto'pi vidyate ..
na tu mātrābhiśaptānāṃ kvacicchāpanivarttanam .. 126 ..
16.11.d:
.. रविरुवाच .. ..
असंशयं महत्पुत्र भविष्यत्यत्र कारणम् ..
येन ते ह्याविशत्क्रोधो धर्मज्ञस्य महात्मनः .. 126 ..
सर्वेषामेव शापानां प्रतिघातोऽपि विद्यते ..
न तु मात्राभिशप्तानां क्वचिच्छापनिवर्त्तनम् .. 126 ..
16.11.m:
The sun said: / “Without doubt, son, there must be a great reason in this matter, / because of which wrath entered you, a righteous and great-souled one.
For all curses a counteraction is found; / but for those cursed by a mother, the curse can never be averted anywhere. 126

16.11.s:
na yuktametanmithyā tu kartum̐ māturvacastava ..
kiṃcitte saṃvidhāsyāmi putrasnehādanugraham .. 127 ..
16.11.d:
न युक्तमेतन्मिथ्या तु कर्तुम्̐ मातुर्वचस्तव ..
किंचित्ते संविधास्यामि पुत्रस्नेहादनुग्रहम् .. 127 ..
16.11.m: It is not fitting that this word of your mother be made false; / yet out of love for my son, I will grant you a favor: 127

16.11.s:
kṛmayo māṃsamādāya prayāsyaṃti mahītalam ..
kṛtaṃ tasyā vacaḥ satyaṃ tvaṃ ca trāto bhaviṣyasi .. 128 ..
16.11.d:
कृमयो मांसमादाय प्रयास्यंति महीतलम् ..
कृतं तस्या वचः सत्यं त्वं च त्रातो भविष्यसि .. 128 ..
16.11.m: Worms will take flesh [from your foot] and go down to the surface of the earth. / Thus her word will be fulfilled as true, and you will be saved.” 128

16.11.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
ādityastvabravīcchāyāṃ kimarthaṃ tanayeṣu vai ..
tulyeṣvapyadhikaḥ sneha ekatra kriyate tvayā .. 129 ..
16.11.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
आदित्यस्त्वब्रवीच्छायां किमर्थं तनयेषु वै ..
तुल्येष्वप्यधिकः स्नेह एकत्र क्रियते त्वया .. 129 ..
16.11.m: Īśvara said: / Āditya then said to Chāyā: “Why, indeed, among sons / who are equal, is greater affection shown by you to one alone? 129

16.11.s:
nūnaṃ na caiṣāṃ jananī tvaṃ saṃjñā kvāpi sā gatā ..
vikaleṣvapyapatyeṣu na mātā śāpadā bhavet .. 7.1.11.130 ..
16.11.d:
नूनं न चैषां जननी त्वं संज्ञा क्वापि सा गता ..
विकलेष्वप्यपत्येषु न माता शापदा भवेत् .. 7.1.11.130 ..
16.11.m: Surely you are not their mother; you are Saṃjñā, who has gone somewhere. / Even toward defective children, a mother does not bestow a curse. 130

16.11.s:
api doṣasahasrāṇi yadi putraḥ samācaret ..
prāṇadrohe'pi nirato na mātā pāpamācaret ..
tasmātsatyaṃ mama brūhi mā śāpavaśagā bhava .. 131 .. ..
16.11.d:
अपि दोषसहस्राणि यदि पुत्रः समाचरेत् ..
प्राणद्रोहेऽपि निरतो न माता पापमाचरेत् ..
तस्मात्सत्यं मम ब्रूहि मा शापवशगा भव .. 131 .. ..
16.11.m: Even if a son should commit thousands of faults, / even if intent on destroying her life, a mother would not commit a sinful act. / Therefore, speak the truth to me; do not fall under the power of a curse!” 131

16.11.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
taṃ śaptumudyataṃ dṛṣṭvā chāyāsaṃjñā dinādhipam ..
bhayena kaṃpatī devī yathāvṛttaṃ mahāsatī .. 132 ..
16.11.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
तं शप्तुमुद्यतं दृष्ट्वा छायासंज्ञा दिनाधिपम् ..
भयेन कंपती देवी यथावृत्तं महासती .. 132 ..
16.11.m: Īśvara said: / Seeing him ready to curse, the goddess Chāyā-Saṃjñā, the great chaste lady, / trembling with fear before the lord of the day, [spoke of] what had happened. 132

16.11.s:
sā cāha tanayā tvaṣṭurahaṃ saṃjñā vibhāvaso ..
patnī tava tvayā patyā patiyuktā divākara .. 133 ..
16.11.d:
सा चाह तनया त्वष्टुरहं संज्ञा विभावसो ..
पत्नी तव त्वया पत्या पतियुक्ता दिवाकर .. 133 ..
16.11.m: And she said: “I am the daughter of Tvaṣṭṛ, Saṃjñā, O radiant one, / your wife, united with a husband, with you as my husband, O maker of the day!” 133

16.11.s:
itthaṃ vivasvataḥ sā tu bahuśaḥ pṛcchato'nyathā ..
na vācā bhāṣate kruddhaḥ śāpaṃ dātuṃ samudyataḥ .. 134 ..
16.11.d:
इत्थं विवस्वतः सा तु बहुशः पृच्छतोऽन्यथा ..
न वाचा भाषते क्रुद्धः शापं दातुं समुद्यतः .. 134 ..
16.11.m: Though questioned repeatedly in this way by Vivasvat, she did not speak otherwise / with her voice; and he, enraged, prepared to pronounce a curse. 134

16.11.s:
śāpodyatakaraṃ dṛṣṭvā sūryaṃ chāyā vivasvataḥ ..
kathayāmāsa tatsarvaṃ saṃjñāyāḥ suviceṣṭitam .. 135 ..
16.11.d:
शापोद्यतकरं दृष्ट्वा सूर्यं छाया विवस्वतः ..
कथयामास तत्सर्वं संज्ञायाः सुविचेष्टितम् .. 135 ..
16.11.m: Seeing Sūrya, the son of Vivasvat, with his hand raised to curse, / Chāyā related all that deed of Saṃjñā. 135

16.11.s:
tacchrutvā bhagavānsūryo jagāma tvaṣṭurālayam ..
tataḥ saṃpūjayāmāsa tadā trailokyapūjitam .. 136 ..
16.11.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा भगवान्सूर्यो जगाम त्वष्टुरालयम् ..
ततः संपूजयामास तदा त्रैलोक्यपूजितम् .. 136 ..
16.11.m: Hearing that, the blessed Sūrya went to the abode of Tvaṣṭṛ. / Then he worshipped the one worshipped by the three worlds. 136

16.11.s:
nirdagdhukāmaṃ roṣeṇa sāntvayāmāsa pārvati ..
bhāsvaṃtaṃ nijayā dīptyā nijagehamupāgatam ..
kva saṃjñeti ca pṛcchantaṃ kathayāmāsa viśvakṛt .. 137 ..
16.11.d:
निर्दग्धुकामं रोषेण सान्त्वयामास पार्वति ..
भास्वंतं निजया दीप्त्या निजगेहमुपागतम् ..
क्व संज्ञेति च पृच्छन्तं कथयामास विश्वकृत् .. 137 ..
16.11.m: O Pārvatī, he soothed the one who, glowing with his own brilliance, / had arrived at his own house, wishing to burn [it] up with rage. / And as he asked, “Where is Saṃjñā?”, the creator of the universe spoke: 137

16.11.s:
.. viśvakarmmovāca .. ..
āgataiva hi me veśma bhavatā śrūyatāṃ vacaḥ ..
vikhyātaṃ tejasā''ḍhyaṃ ta idaṃ rūpaṃ suduḥsaham .. 138 ..
16.11.d:
.. विश्वकर्म्मोवाच .. ..
आगतैव हि मे वेश्म भवता श्रूयतां वचः ..
विख्यातं तेजसा'ऽढ्यं त इदं रूपं सुदुःसहम् .. 138 ..
16.11.m: Viśvakarman said: / “She indeed came to my dwelling. May your words be heard: / this renowned form of yours, rich in fiery splendor, is very hard to bear. 138

16.11.s:
asahantī tataḥ saṃjñā vane carati vai tapaḥ ..
drakṣyase tāṃ bhavānadya svabhāryāṃ śubhacāriṇīm .. 139 ..
16.11.d:
असहन्ती ततः संज्ञा वने चरति वै तपः ..
द्रक्ष्यसे तां भवानद्य स्वभार्यां शुभचारिणीम् .. 139 ..
16.11.m: Unable to endure it, Saṃjñā is therefore practicing austerity in the forest. / Today you will see her, your wife of auspicious conduct. 139

16.11.s:
rūpārthaṃ carate'raṇyaṃ caraṃtī sumahattapaḥ ..
mataṃ me brahmaṇo vākyādyadi te deva rocate ..
rūpaṃ nirvarttayāmyadya tava kāṃtaṃ divaspate .. 7.1.11.140 ..
16.11.d:
रूपार्थं चरतेऽरण्यं चरंती सुमहत्तपः ..
मतं मे ब्रह्मणो वाक्याद्यदि ते देव रोचते ..
रूपं निर्वर्त्तयाम्यद्य तव कांतं दिवस्पते .. 7.1.11.140 ..
16.11.m: For the sake of your form, she wanders in the forest, performing very great austerity. / In my view, according to the word of Brahmā, if it pleases you, O god, / I will today fashion for you a pleasing form, O lord of the sky!” 140

16.11.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
yato hi bhāsvato rūpaṃ prāgāsītparimaṃḍalam ..
tatastatheti taṃ prāha tvaṣṭāraṃ bhagavānraviḥ .. 141 ..
16.11.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
यतो हि भास्वतो रूपं प्रागासीत्परिमंडलम् ..
ततस्तथेति तं प्राह त्वष्टारं भगवान्रविः .. 141 ..
16.11.m: Īśvara said: / Because the form of the radiant one was formerly circular, / the blessed Ravi therefore said to Tvaṣṭṛ, “So be it.” 141

16.11.s:
viśvakarmātvanujñātaḥ śākadvīpe vivasvatā ..
bhṛ(bhū?)mimāropya tattejaḥ śātanāyopacakrame ..142..
16.11.d:
विश्वकर्मात्वनुज्ञातः शाकद्वीपे विवस्वता ..
भृ(भू?)मिमारोप्य तत्तेजः शातनायोपचक्रमे ..142..
16.11.m: Permitted by Vivasvat in Śākadvīpa, / Viśvakarman placed him on the lathe and set about paring down that fiery splendor. 142

16.11.s:
bhramatā'śeṣajagatāmadhibhūtena bhāsvatā ..
samudrā draviṇopetāścukṣubhuśca samantataḥ .. 143 ..
16.11.d:
भ्रमताऽशेषजगतामधिभूतेन भास्वता ..
समुद्रा द्रविणोपेताश्चुक्षुभुश्च समन्ततः .. 143 ..
16.11.m: As the radiant one, the overlord of the entire universe, rotated, / the oceans, filled with riches, were agitated on every side. 143

16.11.s:
bhramatā khalu deveśi sacaṃdragrahatārakam..
adhogati mahābhāge babhūvākṣiptamākulam ..144..
16.11.d:
भ्रमता खलु देवेशि सचंद्रग्रहतारकम्..
अधोगति महाभागे बभूवाक्षिप्तमाकुलम् ..144..
16.11.m: O ruler of the gods, as he rotated, [the firmament] along with the moon, planets, and stars, / was hurled in downward motion, O highly fortunate lady, and tossed into turmoil. 144

16.11.s:
vikṣiptasalilāḥ sarve babhūvuśca tathā nadāḥ ..
vyabhidyaṃta tathā śailāḥ śīrṇasānunibaṃdhanāḥ .. 145 ..
16.11.d:
विक्षिप्तसलिलाः सर्वे बभूवुश्च तथा नदाः ..
व्यभिद्यंत तथा शैलाः शीर्णसानुनिबंधनाः .. 145 ..
16.11.m: All the rivers had their waters thrown out in every direction; / likewise, the mountains were split apart, their peak-foundations shattered. 145

16.11.s:
dhruvādhārāṇyaśeṣāṇi dhiṣṇyāni varavarṇini ..
bhrāmyadraśminibaddhāni adho jagmuḥ sahasraśaḥ .. 146 ..
16.11.d:
ध्रुवाधाराण्यशेषाणि धिष्ण्यानि वरवर्णिनि ..
भ्राम्यद्रश्मिनिबद्धानि अधो जग्मुः सहस्रशः .. 146 ..
16.11.m: All the heavenly bodies resting on Dhruva, O lady of excellent complexion, / tied to his spinning rays, fell downward by the thousands. 146

16.11.s:
vyaśīryaṃta mahāmeghā ghorārāvavirāviṇaḥ ..
bhāsvadbhramaṇavibhrāṃtabhūmyākāśamahītalam .. 147 ..
16.11.d:
व्यशीर्यंत महामेघा घोरारावविराविणः ..
भास्वद्भ्रमणविभ्रांतभूम्याकाशमहीतलम् .. 147 ..
16.11.m: Great clouds roaring with terrible sounds dispersed; / the earth, sky, and ground were thrown into confusion by the whirling of the radiant one. 147

16.11.s:
jagadākulamatyarthaṃ tadā''sīdvaravarṇini ..
trailokye sakale devi bhramamāṇe maharṣaryaḥ ..
devāśca brahmaṇā sārddhaṃ bhāsvaṃtamabhituṣṭuvuḥ..148..
16.11.d:
जगदाकुलमत्यर्थं तदा'ऽसीद्वरवर्णिनि ..
त्रैलोक्ये सकले देवि भ्रममाणे महर्षर्यः ..
देवाश्च ब्रह्मणा सार्द्धं भास्वंतमभितुष्टुवुः..148..
16.11.m: The world was exceedingly distressed at that time, O lady of fair complexion. / As the entire three worlds were whirling, O goddess, the great seers / and the gods along with Brahmā praised the radiant one. 148

16.11.s:
.. devā ūcuḥ.. ..
ādidevo'si devānāṃ jātametatsvayaṃ tava ..
sargasthityaṃtakāleṣu tridhā bhedena tiṣṭhasi .. 149 ..
svasti te'stu jagannātha gharmavarṣahimākara ..
iṃdra āgamya taṃ devaṃ likhyamānamathāstavīt ..
jaya deva jagatsvāmiñjaya deva jagatpate ..7.1.11.15...
16.11.d:
.. देवा ऊचुः.. ..
आदिदेवोऽसि देवानां जातमेतत्स्वयं तव ..
सर्गस्थित्यंतकालेषु त्रिधा भेदेन तिष्ठसि .. 149 ..
स्वस्ति तेऽस्तु जगन्नाथ घर्मवर्षहिमाकर ..
इंद्र आगम्य तं देवं लिख्यमानमथास्तवीत् ..
जय देव जगत्स्वामिञ्जय देव जगत्पते ..7.1.11.15...
16.11.m:
The gods said: / “You are the primal god of the gods; this [universe] arose from you yourself. / At the times of creation, preservation, and dissolution, you stand differentiated in threefold division. 149
May there be welfare for you, O lord of the universe, maker of heat, rain, and snow! / Indra, having approached the god as he was being trimmed, then praised him: / ‘Victory, O god, master of the universe! Victory, O god, lord of the universe!’ 150

16.11.s:
ṛṣayaśca tataḥ sapta vasiṣṭhātripurogamāḥ ..
tuṣṭuvurvividhaiḥ stotraiḥ svasti svastīti vādinaḥ ..
vedoktibhirathāgryābhirvālakhilyāśca tuṣṭuvuḥ .. 151 ..
16.11.d:
ऋषयश्च ततः सप्त वसिष्ठात्रिपुरोगमाः ..
तुष्टुवुर्विविधैः स्तोत्रैः स्वस्ति स्वस्तीति वादिनः ..
वेदोक्तिभिरथाग्र्याभिर्वालखिल्याश्च तुष्टुवुः .. 151 ..
16.11.m: And then the seven seers, headed by Vasiṣṭha and Atri, / praised him with various hymns, saying, ‘Hail, hail!’ / And the Vālakhilyas praised him with supreme Vedic utterances. 151

16.11.s:
.. vālakhilyā ūcuḥ .. ..
namasta ṛksvarūpāya sāmarūpāya te namaḥ ..
yajuḥsvarūparūpāya sāmnāṃ dhāmaga te namaḥ .. 152 ..
16.11.d:
.. वालखिल्या ऊचुः .. ..
नमस्त ऋक्स्वरूपाय सामरूपाय ते नमः ..
यजुःस्वरूपरूपाय साम्नां धामग ते नमः .. 152 ..
16.11.m: The Vālakhilyas said: / “Salutations to you whose essence is the Ṛg[veda], salutations to you whose essence is the Sāma[veda]! / Salutations to you who have the form whose essence is the Yajur[veda], O you who abide in the abode of the Sāman chants, salutations to you! 152

16.11.s:
jñānaikarūpadehāya nirdhūtatamase namaḥ ..
śuddhajyotiḥsvarūpāya trimūrtāyāmalātmane .. 153 ..
16.11.d:
ज्ञानैकरूपदेहाय निर्धूततमसे नमः ..
शुद्धज्योतिःस्वरूपाय त्रिमूर्तायामलात्मने .. 153 ..
16.11.m: Salutations to you whose body is solely the nature of knowledge, who have shaken off darkness; / to you whose essence is pure light, who have three forms, whose self is spotless! 153

16.11.s:
variṣṭhāya vareṇyāya sarvasmai paramātmane ..
namo'khilajagadvyāpirūpāyānaṃtamūrttaye .. 154 ..
16.11.d:
वरिष्ठाय वरेण्याय सर्वस्मै परमात्मने ..
नमोऽखिलजगद्व्यापिरूपायानंतमूर्त्तये .. 154 ..
16.11.m: To the highest, the most desirable, the supreme self who is all; / salutations to you whose form pervades the entire universe, whose forms are infinite! 154

16.11.s:
sarvakāraṇabhūtāya niṣṭhāya jñāna cetasām ..
namaḥ sūryasvarūpāya prakāśālakṣyarūpiṇe .. 155 ..
16.11.d:
सर्वकारणभूताय निष्ठाय ज्ञान चेतसाम् ..
नमः सूर्यस्वरूपाय प्रकाशालक्ष्यरूपिणे .. 155 ..
16.11.m: To the one who is the cause of all, the ultimate goal of minds that know; / salutations to you whose essence is Sūrya, whose form is imperceptible light! 155

16.11.s:
bhāskarāya namastubhyaṃ tathā dinakṛte namaḥ ..
sarvasmai hetave caiva saṃdhyājyo tsnākṛte namaḥ .. 156 ..
16.11.d:
भास्कराय नमस्तुभ्यं तथा दिनकृते नमः ..
सर्वस्मै हेतवे चैव संध्याज्यो त्स्नाकृते नमः .. 156 ..
16.11.m: Salutations to you, the maker of light, and salutations to the maker of day! / Salutations to the cause of everything, and to the maker of twilight and moonlight! 156

16.11.s:
tvaṃ sarvametadbhagavañjagacca bhramatā tvayā ..
bhramatyāviśvamakhilaṃ brahmāṃḍaṃ sacarācaram ..
tvadaṃśubhiridaṃ sarvaṃ spṛṣṭaṃ vai jāyate śuci .. 157 ..
16.11.d:
त्वं सर्वमेतद्भगवञ्जगच्च भ्रमता त्वया ..
भ्रमत्याविश्वमखिलं ब्रह्मांडं सचराचरम् ..
त्वदंशुभिरिदं सर्वं स्पृष्टं वै जायते शुचि .. 157 ..
16.11.m: You are all this universe, O Lord, and as you rotate, / this whole cosmic egg, with everything moving and unmoving, revolves. / Touched by your rays, all this indeed becomes pure. 157

16.11.s: kriyate tvatkarasparśairjalādīnāṃ pavitratā .. 158 ..
16.11.d: क्रियते त्वत्करस्पर्शैर्जलादीनां पवित्रता .. 158 ..
16.11.m: Purity of water and other elements is produced by the touches of your rays. 158

16.11.s:
homadānādiko dharmo nopakārāya jāyate ..
tāta yāvanna saṃyogi jagadetattvadaṃśubhiḥ .. 159 ..
16.11.d:
होमदानादिको धर्मो नोपकाराय जायते ..
तात यावन्न संयोगि जगदेतत्त्वदंशुभिः .. 159 ..
16.11.m: Dharma such as oblations and donations does not result in benefit, / O father, as long as this world is not united with your rays. 159

16.11.s:
ṛcaste sakalā hyetāstathā yāni yajūṃṣi ca ..
sakalāni ca sāmāni nipataṃti tvadaṃgataḥ .. 7.1.11.160 ..
16.11.d:
ऋचस्ते सकला ह्येतास्तथा यानि यजूंषि च ..
सकलानि च सामानि निपतंति त्वदंगतः .. 7.1.11.160 ..
16.11.m: All the Ṛg verses, and likewise all the Yajus verses, / and all the Sāman chants fall from your body. 160

16.11.s:
ṛṅmayastvaṃ jagannātha tvameva ca yajurmayaḥ ..
yataḥ sāmamayaścaiva tato nātha trayīmayaḥ .. 161 ..
16.11.d:
ऋङ्मयस्त्वं जगन्नाथ त्वमेव च यजुर्मयः ..
यतः साममयश्चैव ततो नाथ त्रयीमयः .. 161 ..
16.11.m: You are composed of the Ṛg, O lord of the universe, and you alone are composed of the Yajus; / and because you are also composed of the Sāman, therefore, O Lord, you consist of the triple Veda. 161

16.11.s:
tvameva brahmaṇo rūpaṃ paraṃ cāparameva ca ..
mūrttāmūrttaṃ tathā sūkṣmaṃ sthūlaṃ rūpeṇa saṃsthitaḥ .. 162 ..
16.11.d:
त्वमेव ब्रह्मणो रूपं परं चापरमेव च ..
मूर्त्तामूर्त्तं तथा सूक्ष्मं स्थूलं रूपेण संस्थितः .. 162 ..
16.11.m: You alone are the higher and the lower form of Brahman; / you exist in the form of the manifest and the unmanifest, the subtle and the gross. 162

16.11.s:
nimeṣakāṣṭhādimayaḥ kālarūpakṣaṇātmakaḥ..
prasīda svecchayā rūpaṃ svaṃ tejaḥ śamanaṃ kuru..
tvaṃ deva jagatāṃ hetorduḥkhaṃ sahasi duḥsaham.. 163..
16.11.d:
निमेषकाष्ठादिमयः कालरूपक्षणात्मकः..
प्रसीद स्वेच्छया रूपं स्वं तेजः शमनं कुरु..
त्वं देव जगतां हेतोर्दुःखं सहसि दुःसहम्.. 163..
16.11.m: You consist of moments and divisions of time, having the nature of time and its instants. / Be gracious! Of your own will, subdue your form and your own fiery energy! / O god, for the sake of the worlds you endure distress that is hard to bear. 163

16.11.s:
tvaṃ nātha mokṣiṇāṃ mokṣo dhyeyastvaṃ dhyāyatāṃ varaḥ..
tvaṃ gatiḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ karmakāṃḍanivartinām..164..
16.11.d:
त्वं नाथ मोक्षिणां मोक्षो ध्येयस्त्वं ध्यायतां वरः..
त्वं गतिः सर्वभूतानां कर्मकांडनिवर्तिनाम्..164..
16.11.m: O Lord, you are liberation for seekers of liberation; you are the supreme object of meditation for those who meditate; / you are the goal of all living beings who desist from ritual action. 164

16.11.s: śaṃ prajābhyo'stu deveśa śanno'stu jagatāṃpate..165..
16.11.d: शं प्रजाभ्योऽस्तु देवेश शन्नोऽस्तु जगतांपते..165..
16.11.m: May there be peace for the creatures, O ruler of the gods! May there be peace for us, O lord of the worlds!” 165

16.11.s:
tvaṃ dhātā visṛjasi viśvameka eva tvaṃ pātā sthitikaraṇāya saṃpravṛttaḥ..
tvayyaṃte layamakhilaṃ prayāti caitattvattonyo na hi tapanāsti sarvadātā .. 166 ..
16.11.d:
त्वं धाता विसृजसि विश्वमेक एव त्वं पाता स्थितिकरणाय संप्रवृत्तः..
त्वय्यंते लयमखिलं प्रयाति चैतत्त्वत्तोन्यो न हि तपनास्ति सर्वदाता .. 166 ..
16.11.m: You alone, the creator, create the universe; you, the protector, are engaged in preserving it. / And in you at the end all this dissolves; there is indeed no other giver of all things, O burning one, than you. (166)

16.11.s:
tvaṃ brahmā hariharasaṃjñitastvamindro vitteśaḥ pitṛpitaraṃbupaḥ samīraḥ ..
somo'gnirgaganamahādharādirūpaḥ kiṃ na tvaṃ sakalamanorathapradātā .. 167 ..
16.11.d:
त्वं ब्रह्मा हरिहरसंज्ञितस्त्वमिन्द्रो वित्तेशः पितृपितरंबुपः समीरः ..
सोमोऽग्निर्गगनमहाधरादिरूपः किं न त्वं सकलमनोरथप्रदाता .. 167 ..
16.11.m: You are Brahmā; you are called Hari and Hara; you are Indra, the lord of wealth, the lord of the fathers, the water-god, the wind, / the moon, fire, and have the forms of space, the great earth, and the like. Are you not the giver of all desires? (167)

16.11.s:
yajñaistvāmanudinamātmakarmmasaktāḥ stuvanto vividhapadairdvijā yajaṃti ..
dhyāyantaḥ savinayacetaso bhavantaṃ yogasthāḥ paramapadaṃ prayāṃti marttyā .. 168 ..
16.11.d:
यज्ञैस्त्वामनुदिनमात्मकर्म्मसक्ताः स्तुवन्तो विविधपदैर्द्विजा यजंति ..
ध्यायन्तः सविनयचेतसो भवन्तं योगस्थाः परमपदं प्रयांति मर्त्त्या .. 168 ..
16.11.m: Twice-born men devoted to their duties worship you daily with sacrifices, praising [you] with various verses. / Mortals, meditating upon you with humble minds and established in yoga, attain the highest state. (168)

16.11.s:
tapasi pacasi viśvaṃ pāsi bhasmīkaroṣi prakaṭayasi mayūkhairhlādayatasyaṃśugarbhaiḥ..
sṛjasi kamalajanmā pālayasyacyutākhyaḥ kṣapayasi ca yugāṃte rudrarūpastvamekaḥ..169..
īśvara uvāca..
likhamānastato bhānuṃ viśvakarmā prajāpatiḥ..
udbhūtapulakaḥ stotramidaṃcakre vivasvataḥ..7.1.11.17...
16.11.d:
तपसि पचसि विश्वं पासि भस्मीकरोषि प्रकटयसि मयूखैर्ह्लादयतस्यंशुगर्भैः..
सृजसि कमलजन्मा पालयस्यच्युताख्यः क्षपयसि च युगांते रुद्ररूपस्त्वमेकः..169..
ईश्वर उवाच..
लिखमानस्ततो भानुं विश्वकर्मा प्रजापतिः..
उद्भूतपुलकः स्तोत्रमिदंचक्रे विवस्वतः..7.1.11.17...
16.11.m:
You burn, you ripen the universe, you protect, you reduce to ashes, you reveal with your rays, and you delight with the sunbeams within you; / as the lotus-born [Brahmā] you create, called Acyuta you protect, and at the end of the yuga, having the form of Rudra, you alone destroy. (169)
Īśvara said: / Then Viśvakarman, the lord of creatures, while paring down the sun, / his hair bristling with joy, composed this hymn of praise to Vivasvat: (170)

16.11.s:
vivasvate praṇatajanānukampine mahātmane samajavasaptasaptaye ..
satejase kamalakulālibaṃdhave sadā tamaḥpaṭalapaṭāvapāṭine ..171..
16.11.d:
विवस्वते प्रणतजनानुकम्पिने महात्मने समजवसप्तसप्तये ..
सतेजसे कमलकुलालिबंधवे सदा तमःपटलपटावपाटिने ..171..
16.11.m: To Vivasvat, compassionate to those who bow to him, the great-souled one whose seven horses possess equal speed, / endowed with splendor, friend to the lotuses and bees, ever rending the screen that is the mass of darkness, (171)

16.11.s:
pāvanātiśayasarvacakṣuṣe naikakāmaviṣayapradāyine ..
bhāsurāmalamayūkhamāline sarvabhūtahitakāriṇe namaḥ ..172..
16.11.d:
पावनातिशयसर्वचक्षुषे नैककामविषयप्रदायिने ..
भासुरामलमयूखमालिने सर्वभूतहितकारिणे नमः ..172..
16.11.m: the exceedingly purifying eye of all, the grantor of multiple objects of desire, / garlanded with bright, stainless rays, the doer of good to all beings, homage! (172)

16.11.s:
ajāya lokatrayabhāvanāya bhūtātmane gopataye vṛṣāya ..
namo mahākāruṇikottamāya sūryāya vastuprabhavālayāya .. 173 ..
16.11.d:
अजाय लोकत्रयभावनाय भूतात्मने गोपतये वृषाय ..
नमो महाकारुणिकोत्तमाय सूर्याय वस्तुप्रभवालयाय .. 173 ..
16.11.m: To the unborn, the creator of the three worlds, the soul of beings, the lord of rays, the bull, / homage to the most supreme of the greatly compassionate, to the sun, the source and dissolution of all things! (173)

16.11.s:
vivasvate jñānabhṛte'ntarātmane jagatpratiṣṭhāya jagaddhitaiṣiṇe ..
svayaṃbhuve nirmalalokacakṣuṣe surottamāyāmitatejase namaḥ .. 174..
16.11.d:
विवस्वते ज्ञानभृतेऽन्तरात्मने जगत्प्रतिष्ठाय जगद्धितैषिणे ..
स्वयंभुवे निर्मललोकचक्षुषे सुरोत्तमायामिततेजसे नमः .. 174..
16.11.m: To Vivasvat who bears wisdom, the inner self, the foundation of the world, wishing the good of the world, / the self-manifest, the spotless eye of the world, the best of the gods, possessing boundless splendor, homage! (174)

16.11.s:
kṣaṇamudayācalabhālitārcciḥ suragaṇagītigariṣṭhagītaḥ ..
tvamuta mayūkhasahasravajjagati vikāsitapadmanābhaḥ ..175..
16.11.d:
क्षणमुदयाचलभालितार्च्चिः सुरगणगीतिगरिष्ठगीतः ..
त्वमुत मयूखसहस्रवज्जगति विकासितपद्मनाभः ..175..
16.11.m: For an instant your beams shine upon the mountain of sunrise; you are sung with the most exalted songs by the host of gods. / And you, having a thousand rays, make the lotus-navel [Viṣṇu] bloom in the world. (175)

16.11.s:
tava timirāsavapānamadādbhavati vilohitavigrahatā ..
mihiravibhāsatayā sutarāṃ tribhuvanabhāvanamātraparaḥ .. 176 ..
16.11.d:
तव तिमिरासवपानमदाद्भवति विलोहितविग्रहता ..
मिहिरविभासतया सुतरां त्रिभुवनभावनमात्रपरः .. 176 ..
16.11.m: From the intoxication of drinking the wine of darkness, your body becomes deeply crimson. / Through your brilliance as the sun, you are wholly intent on nothing other than the creation of the three worlds. (176)

16.11.s:
rathamāruhya samāvayavaṃ ruciravikalitadivyahayam..
satatamaribale bhagavaṃścarasi jagaddhitabaddharasaḥ .. 177 ..
16.11.d:
रथमारुह्य समावयवं रुचिरविकलितदिव्यहयम्..
सततमरिबले भगवंश्चरसि जगद्धितबद्धरसः .. 177 ..
16.11.m: Having mounted your chariot of harmonious parts, whose divine horses are dazzling and swift, / you constantly traverse [the sky] against the army of foes, O Lord, fixed in your delight in the world’s welfare. (177)

16.11.s:
amṛtamayena rasena samaṃ vibudhapitṝnapi tarppayase ..
arigaṇasūdana tena tava praṇatimupetya likhāmi vapuḥ .. .. 178 ..
16.11.d:
अमृतमयेन रसेन समं विबुधपितॄनपि तर्प्पयसे ..
अरिगणसूदन तेन तव प्रणतिमुपेत्य लिखामि वपुः .. .. 178 ..
16.11.m: With the nectarous essence you satisfy the gods and also the ancestors at the same time. / Therefore, O slayer of the host of foes, having bowed down to you, I pare down your body. (178)

16.11.s:
śubhasamavarṇamayaṃ racitaṃ tava padapāṃsupavitratamam ..
natajanavatsala māṃ praṇataṃ tribhuvanapāvana pāhi rave .. 179 ..
16.11.d:
शुभसमवर्णमयं रचितं तव पदपांसुपवित्रतमम् ..
नतजनवत्सल मां प्रणतं त्रिभुवनपावन पाहि रवे .. 179 ..
16.11.m: Crafted from auspicious, even color, most sanctified by the dust of your feet; / O you who are affectionate to those bowed [before you], protect me who am bowed down, O purifier of the three worlds, O Ravi! (179)

16.11.s:
iti sakalajagatprasūti bhūtaṃ tribhuvanabhāvanadhāmahetumekam ..
ravimakhilajagatpradīpabhūtaṃ tridaśavaraṃ praṇato'smi devadevam.. 7.1.11.180 ..
16.11.d:
इति सकलजगत्प्रसूति भूतं त्रिभुवनभावनधामहेतुमेकम् ..
रविमखिलजगत्प्रदीपभूतं त्रिदशवरं प्रणतोऽस्मि देवदेवम्.. 7.1.11.180 ..
16.11.m: Thus, to the sole source of the entire universe, the cause of the dwelling that sustains the three worlds, / to Ravi, the lamp of the whole world, the best among the thirty [gods], the god of gods, I bow down! (180)

16.11.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
hāhāhūhaśca gandharvo nāradastuṃbarustathā ..
upagātuṃ samārabdhā gāṃdharvakuśalā ravim.. 181 ..
16.11.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
हाहाहूहश्च गन्धर्वो नारदस्तुंबरुस्तथा ..
उपगातुं समारब्धा गांधर्वकुशला रविम्.. 181 ..
16.11.m: Īśvara said: / Then Hāhā and Hūhū, both Gandharvas, and Nārada and Tumburu, / skilled in the musical art of the Gandharvas, began to sing to Ravi, (181)

16.11.s:
ṣaḍjamadhyamagāṃdhāragrāmatrayaviśāradāḥ ..
mūrchanābhiśca tānaiśca suprayogaiḥ sukhapradam.. 182 ..
16.11.d:
षड्जमध्यमगांधारग्रामत्रयविशारदाः ..
मूर्छनाभिश्च तानैश्च सुप्रयोगैः सुखप्रदम्.. 182 ..
16.11.m: skilled in the three scales of ṣaḍja, madhyama, and gāndhāra, / [producing music] that brings delight with melodic movements, tonal extensions, and good applications, (182)

16.11.s:
saptasvaravinirvṛttaṃ yatitrayavibhūṣitam..
saptadhātusamāyuktaṃ ṣaḍjāti triguṇāśrayam .. 183 ..
16.11.d:
सप्तस्वरविनिर्वृत्तं यतित्रयविभूषितम्..
सप्तधातुसमायुक्तं षड्जाति त्रिगुणाश्रयम् .. 183 ..
16.11.m: completed with the seven musical notes, adorned with three pauses, / endowed with the seven compositional elements, six modal types, resting upon the three qualities, (183)

16.11.s:
caturgītasamāyuktaṃ catuvarṇasamutthitam ..
caturvarṇapratīkāraṃ saptālaṃkārabhūṣitam.. 184 ..
16.11.d:
चतुर्गीतसमायुक्तं चतुवर्णसमुत्थितम् ..
चतुर्वर्णप्रतीकारं सप्तालंकारभूषितम्.. 184 ..
16.11.m: joined with the four kinds of song, arisen from the four syllables, / counteracting the four castes, adorned with seven ornaments, (184)

16.11.s:
tristhānaśuddhaṃ trilayaṃ samyakkālavyavasthitam..
citte citte ca nṛtye ca raseṣu layasaṃyutam .. 185 ..
16.11.d:
त्रिस्थानशुद्धं त्रिलयं सम्यक्कालव्यवस्थितम्..
चित्ते चित्ते च नृत्ये च रसेषु लयसंयुतम् .. 185 ..
16.11.m: pure in the three voice-registers, with three tempos, properly established in rhythm, / united with tempo in every thought, dance, and aesthetic sentiment, (185)

16.11.s:
caturviṃśadguṇairyuktaṃ jagurgītaṃ ca gāyanāḥ ..
viśvārcī ca ghṛtācī ca urvaśyatha tilottamā .. 186 ..
16.11.d:
चतुर्विंशद्गुणैर्युक्तं जगुर्गीतं च गायनाः ..
विश्वार्ची च घृताची च उर्वश्यथ तिलोत्तमा .. 186 ..
16.11.m: endowed with twenty-four virtues; and the singers sang the song. / And Viśvācī, Ghṛtācī, Urvaśī, and Tilottamā, (186)

16.11.s:
menakā sahajanyā ca raṃbhā cāpsarasāṃ varā ..
caturvidhapadaṃ tālaṃ triprakāraṃ layatrayam .. 187 ..
16.11.d:
मेनका सहजन्या च रंभा चाप्सरसां वरा ..
चतुर्विधपदं तालं त्रिप्रकारं लयत्रयम् .. 187 ..
16.11.m: Menakā, Sahajanyā, and Rambhā, the best of the apsarases, / with fourfold words, threefold rhythm, and three tempos, (187)

16.11.s:
yatitrayaṃ tathā''todyaṃ nāṭyaṃ caiva caturvidham ..
nanṛturjagatāmīśe likhyamāne vibhāvasau .. 188 ..
16.11.d:
यतित्रयं तथा'ऽतोद्यं नाट्यं चैव चतुर्विधम् ..
ननृतुर्जगतामीशे लिख्यमाने विभावसौ .. 188 ..
16.11.m: with three pauses, instruments, and fourfold dramatic acting, / danced while the lord of the worlds, the sun, was being pared down, (188)

16.11.s:
bhāvānbhāvaviśāradyaḥ kurvantyo vidhivadbahūn ..
devadundubhayaḥ śaṃkhāḥ śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ .. 189 ..
16.11.d:
भावान्भावविशारद्यः कुर्वन्त्यो विधिवद्बहून् ..
देवदुन्दुभयः शंखाः शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः .. 189 ..
16.11.m: those skilled in emotions displaying many emotions according to rule. / Divine drums and conches by the hundreds and thousands, (189)

16.11.s:
anāhatā mahādevi nedire ghananisvanāḥ ..
gāyadbhiścaiva gaṃdharvairnṛtyadbhiścāpsarogaṇaiḥ .. 7.1.11.190 ..
16.11.d:
अनाहता महादेवि नेदिरे घननिस्वनाः ..
गायद्भिश्चैव गंधर्वैर्नृत्यद्भिश्चाप्सरोगणैः .. 7.1.11.190 ..
16.11.m: struck unceasingly, O great goddess, resounded with deep sounds, / as the Gandharvas sang and the hosts of apsarases danced. (190)

16.11.s:
avādyaṃta tatastatra veṇuvīṇādijharjharāḥ ..
paṇavāḥ puṣkarāścaiva mṛdaṃgapaṭahānakāḥ .. 191 ..
16.11.d:
अवाद्यंत ततस्तत्र वेणुवीणादिझर्झराः ..
पणवाः पुष्कराश्चैव मृदंगपटहानकाः .. 191 ..
16.11.m: Then flutes, vīṇās, jharjharas, / paṇavas, puṣkaras, mṛdaṅgas, paṭahas, and ānakas were played there; (191)

16.11.s:
tūryavāditraghoṣaiśca sarvaṃ kolāhalīkṛtam ..
tataḥ kṛtāṃjalipuṭā bhaktinamrātmamūrttayaḥ .. 192 ..
16.11.d:
तूर्यवादित्रघोषैश्च सर्वं कोलाहलीकृतम् ..
ततः कृतांजलिपुटा भक्तिनम्रात्ममूर्त्तयः .. 192 ..
16.11.m: and with the sounds of trumpets and musical instruments, everything became a tumult. / Then, with palms joined and bodies bowed in devotion, (192)

16.11.s:
tataḥ kalakale tasminsarvadevasamāgame ..
saṃvatsaraṃ bhramasthasya viśvakarmā ravestataḥ .. 193 ..
16.11.d:
ततः कलकले तस्मिन्सर्वदेवसमागमे ..
संवत्सरं भ्रमस्थस्य विश्वकर्मा रवेस्ततः .. 193 ..
16.11.m: in that clamor, at that gathering of all the gods, / Viśvakarman then, for a year, as Ravi remained on the lathe, (193)

16.11.s:
tejasaḥ śātanaṃ cakre stūyamānasya daivataiḥ ..
devaṃ cakre samāropya bhrāmayāmāsa sūtrabhṛt ..194..
16.11.d:
तेजसः शातनं चक्रे स्तूयमानस्य दैवतैः ..
देवं चक्रे समारोप्य भ्रामयामास सूत्रभृत् ..194..
16.11.m: effected the paring of the splendor [of him who was] being praised by the gods. / Having mounted the god upon the lathe, the master carpenter turned it (194)

16.11.s:
mṛtpiṃḍavatkulālasya saṃspṛśankṣuradhārayā ..
pataṃgasya stavaṃ kurvanviśvakarmā divaspateḥ.. 195 ..
16.11.d:
मृत्पिंडवत्कुलालस्य संस्पृशन्क्षुरधारया ..
पतंगस्य स्तवं कुर्वन्विश्वकर्मा दिवस्पतेः.. 195 ..
16.11.m: like a potter [turning] a lump of clay, touching [him] with the edge of a razor, / composing praise to the sun, the lord of the sky, Viśvakarman. (195)

16.11.s:
tejasaḥ ṣoḍaśaṃ bhāgaṃ maṇḍalasthamadhārayat ..
śātitaṃ tasya tattejo yāvatpādau varānane .. 196 ..
16.11.d:
तेजसः षोडशं भागं मण्डलस्थमधारयत् ..
शातितं तस्य तत्तेजो यावत्पादौ वरानने .. 196 ..
16.11.m: He retained a sixteenth part of the splendor residing in the solar orb. / That splendor of his was pared down as far as his feet, O fair-faced one. (196)

16.11.s:
yattasya ṛṅmayaṃ tejastatprabhāse'patatpriye ..
yajurmayena deveśi bhāvitā dyaurmahāprabhoḥ .. 197 ..
16.11.d:
यत्तस्य ऋङ्मयं तेजस्तत्प्रभासेऽपतत्प्रिये ..
यजुर्मयेन देवेशि भाविता द्यौर्महाप्रभोः .. 197 ..
16.11.m: That splendor of his which consisted of the Ṛgveda fell upon Prabhāsa, my dear; / by that which consisted of the Yajurveda, O ruler of gods, the sky of the great lord was formed; (197)

16.11.s:
svargaṃ sāmamayenāpi bhūrbhuvaḥsvaritisthitam ..
tatastaistejaso bhāgairdaśabhiḥ paṃcabhistathā.. 198 ..
16.11.d:
स्वर्गं साममयेनापि भूर्भुवःस्वरितिस्थितम् ..
ततस्तैस्तेजसो भागैर्दशभिः पंचभिस्तथा.. 198 ..
16.11.m: and heaven was made of the Sāmaveda, established as earth, atmosphere, and sky. / Then, with those fifteen parts of that splendor, (198)

16.11.s:
tena vai nirmitaṃ cakraṃ viṣṇoḥ śūlaṃ harasya ca ..
mahāprabhaṃ mahākāyaṃ śibikā dhanadasya ca .. 199 ..
16.11.d:
तेन वै निर्मितं चक्रं विष्णोः शूलं हरस्य च ..
महाप्रभं महाकायं शिबिका धनदस्य च .. 199 ..
16.11.m: the discus of Viṣṇu was fashioned by him, and the trident of Hara, / of great brilliance and immense size, and the palanquin of the giver of wealth, (199)

16.11.s:
daṇḍaḥ pretapateḥ śaktirdevasenāpatestathā ..
anyeṣāṃ ca surāṇāṃ ca astrāṇyuktāni yāni vai .. 7.1.11.200 ..
16.11.d:
दण्डः प्रेतपतेः शक्तिर्देवसेनापतेस्तथा ..
अन्येषां च सुराणां च अस्त्राण्युक्तानि यानि वै .. 7.1.11.200 ..
16.11.m: the staff of the lord of the dead, the spear of the commander of the gods’ army, / and whatever weapons have been mentioned of the other gods, (200)

16.11.s:
yakṣavidyādharāṇāṃ ca tāni cakre sa viśvakṛt ..
tataḥ ṣoḍaśamaṃ bhāgaṃ bibhartti bhagavānraviḥ.. ..
tattejo ravibhāgaśca khastho vicarati priye .. 201 ..
16.11.d:
यक्षविद्याधराणां च तानि चक्रे स विश्वकृत् ..
ततः षोडशमं भागं बिभर्त्ति भगवान्रविः.. ..
तत्तेजो रविभागश्च खस्थो विचरति प्रिये .. 201 ..
16.11.m: and of the Yakṣas and Vidyādharas, the maker of all fashioned them. / Then the lord Ravi bears the sixteenth part; / and that splendor, the part of Ravi, moves through the sky, my dear. (201)

16.11.s:
iti śātitatejāḥ sa śvaśureṇātiśobhanam ..
vapurdadhāra mārttaṃḍaḥ puṣpabāṇamanoramam .. 202 ..
16.11.d:
इति शातिततेजाः स श्वशुरेणातिशोभनम् ..
वपुर्दधार मार्त्तंडः पुष्पबाणमनोरमम् .. 202 ..
16.11.m: Thus, with his splendor pared down by his father-in-law, Mārtaṇḍa assumed / an exceedingly handsome body, charming as the god whose arrows are flowers. (202)

16.11.s:
tataḥ surūpa dhṛgbhānuruttarānagamatkurūn..
dadṛśe tatra saṃjñāṃ tu vaḍavārūpadhāriṇīm .1 203 ..
16.11.d:
ततः सुरूप धृग्भानुरुत्तरानगमत्कुरून्..
ददृशे तत्र संज्ञां तु वडवारूपधारिणीम् .1 203 ..
16.11.m: Then, assuming a handsome form, the sun went to the Northern Kurus; / and there he saw Saṃjñā, who bore the form of a mare. (203)

16.11.s:
apāpāṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ tapasā niyamena ca ..
sā ca dṛṣṭvā tamāyāṃtaṃ parapuṃso viśaṃkayā ..
jagāma saṃmukhaṃ tasya aśvarūpadharasya ca ..204..
16.11.d:
अपापां सर्वभूतानां तपसा नियमेन च ..
सा च दृष्ट्वा तमायांतं परपुंसो विशंकया ..
जगाम संमुखं तस्य अश्वरूपधरस्य च ..204..
16.11.m: She was free of sin among all beings, through austerity and self-restraint. / Seeing him coming, fearing he was another male, / she went to meet him, who also wore the form of a horse. (204)

16.11.s:
tataśca nāsikāyoge tayostatra sametayoḥ..
