nāsatyadasrau tanayāvaśvavaktrau vinirgatau ..205..
16.11.d:
ततश्च नासिकायोगे तयोस्तत्र समेतयोः..
नासत्यदस्रौ तनयावश्ववक्त्रौ विनिर्गतौ ..205..
16.11.m: Then, as their nostrils met when the two came together there, / two sons, the horse-faced Nāsatya and Dasra, came forth. (205)

16.11.s:
retasonte ca revantaḥ khaḍgī chatrī tanutrabhṛt ..
piturgṛhyottamaṃ so'śvaṃ jātamātraḥ palāyata .. 206 ..
16.11.d:
रेतसोन्ते च रेवन्तः खड्गी छत्री तनुत्रभृत् ..
पितुर्गृह्योत्तमं सोऽश्वं जातमात्रः पलायत .. 206 ..
16.11.m: And at the end of the semen came Revanta, bearing a sword, an umbrella, and armour; / as soon as he was born, seizing his father's excellent horse, he fled. (206)

16.11.s:
sa tasminsakṛdārūḍhastamaśvaṃ naiva muṃcati ..
tatorkeṇa samādiṣṭau daṃḍanāyakapiṃgalau ..207..
16.11.d:
स तस्मिन्सकृदारूढस्तमश्वं नैव मुंचति ..
ततोर्केण समादिष्टौ दंडनायकपिंगलौ ..207..
16.11.m: Having once mounted that horse, he would not release it at all. / Then Daṇḍanāyaka and Piṅgala were commanded by the Sun: (207)

16.11.s:
aśvaṃ pratyānayadhvaṃ me mā balācchidrato'syatu ..
pārśvasthau tiṣṭhatastasya aśvacchidrābhikāṃkṣiṇau..208..
16.11.d:
अश्वं प्रत्यानयध्वं मे मा बलाच्छिद्रतोऽस्यतु ..
पार्श्वस्थौ तिष्ठतस्तस्य अश्वच्छिद्राभिकांक्षिणौ..208..
16.11.m: “Bring back my horse; do not strike him with force, [take it] through a flaw [in his guard]!” / Standing at his sides, they waited, watching for a weakness in the horse. (208)

16.11.s:
na ca cchidraṃ labhete tau tasyādyāpi mahātmanaḥ..
agre gacchati revaṃte pṛṣṭhagau daṇḍapiṃgalau ..209..
uttarebhyaḥ kurubhyastu nirgatau vegavattarau ..
dakṣiṇaṃ bhārataṃ prāptau yatra kṣetra prabhāsikam ..7.1.11.21...
16.11.d:
न च च्छिद्रं लभेते तौ तस्याद्यापि महात्मनः..
अग्रे गच्छति रेवंते पृष्ठगौ दण्डपिंगलौ ..209..
उत्तरेभ्यः कुरुभ्यस्तु निर्गतौ वेगवत्तरौ ..
दक्षिणं भारतं प्राप्तौ यत्र क्षेत्र प्रभासिकम् ..7.1.11.21...
16.11.m:
Yet the two find no weakness in that great soul even today. / Revanta goes in front, and Daṇḍa and Piṅgala follow behind. (209)
Having set out from the northern Kurus, moving with tremendous speed, / they reached the southern Bhārata, where the sacred field of Prabhāsa lies. (210)

16.11.s:
atyarthaṃ vegakhinnau tau sa ca revaṃtako'pi hi ..
prasvinnagātraḥ socchvāso revaṃtastatra saṃsthitaḥ ..211..
16.11.d:
अत्यर्थं वेगखिन्नौ तौ स च रेवंतकोऽपि हि ..
प्रस्विन्नगात्रः सोच्छ्वासो रेवंतस्तत्र संस्थितः ..211..
16.11.m: The two were utterly exhausted from the speed, and Revantaka as well; / with limbs bathed in sweat, panting, Revanta halted there. (211)

16.11.s:
muhūrtena samākrāntaṃ lakṣayojanamaṃḍalam ..
uttarāddakṣiṇaṃ devi revatena mahātmanā .. 212 ..
16.11.d:
मुहूर्तेन समाक्रान्तं लक्षयोजनमंडलम् ..
उत्तराद्दक्षिणं देवि रेवतेन महात्मना .. 212 ..
16.11.m: In a single muhūrta, a circle of one hundred thousand yojanas / from north to south, O goddess, was traversed by the great-souled Revanta. (212)

16.11.s:
svinnagātrastato devi prabhāse samavasthitaḥ ..
daṇḍapiṃgalakasaṃyukto hyaśvārūḍhaḥ sa tiṣṭhati..213..
16.11.d:
स्विन्नगात्रस्ततो देवि प्रभासे समवस्थितः ..
दण्डपिंगलकसंयुक्तो ह्यश्वारूढः स तिष्ठति..213..
16.11.m: His limbs bathed in sweat, O goddess, he settled in Prabhāsa; / accompanied by Daṇḍa and Piṅgalaka, he stays mounted on his horse. (213)

16.11.s:
sāvitryā nairṛte bhāge nātidūre vyavasthitaḥ..
rājñīputro yato devi rājā bhaṭṭārakastataḥ.. 214..
16.11.d:
सावित्र्या नैरृते भागे नातिदूरे व्यवस्थितः..
राज्ञीपुत्रो यतो देवि राजा भट्टारकस्ततः.. 214..
16.11.m: He is situated to the south-west of Sāvitrī, not very far away. / Because he is the son of Rājñī, O goddess, he is therefore the venerable king (Rājā Bhaṭṭāraka). (214)

16.11.s:
loke khyātiṃ samāyāti rājabhaṭṭāriketi ca..
guhyabhaṭṭārakatve ca revaṃto viniyojitaḥ.. 215..
16.11.d:
लोके ख्यातिं समायाति राजभट्टारिकेति च..
गुह्यभट्टारकत्वे च रेवंतो विनियोजितः.. 215..
16.11.m: In the world he attains fame also as Rājabhaṭṭārikā; / and Revanta was appointed to the rank of Guhyabhaṭṭāraka. (215)

16.11.s:
evamabhyetyāha tato bhagavām̐llokatāpanaḥ..
tvamapyaśeṣalokasya pūjyo vatsa bhaviṣyasi.. 216..
16.11.d:
एवमभ्येत्याह ततो भगवाम्̐ल्लोकतापनः..
त्वमप्यशेषलोकस्य पूज्यो वत्स भविष्यसि.. 216..
16.11.m: Approaching him thus, the blessed Scorcher of the World said: / “Child, you too shall be worshipped by all the world. (216)

16.11.s:
araṇye ca mahādāve vairidasyubhayeṣu ca..
tvāṃ smariṣyaṃti ye marttyā mokṣyante te mahāpadaḥ..217..
16.11.d:
अरण्ये च महादावे वैरिदस्युभयेषु च..
त्वां स्मरिष्यंति ये मर्त्त्या मोक्ष्यन्ते ते महापदः..217..
16.11.m: In the wilderness, in a vast forest fire, and in fears of enemies and bandits, / mortals who remember you will be delivered from great disaster. (217)

16.11.s:
kṣemamṛddhiṃ sukhaṃ rājyamārogyaṃ kīrtimunnatim..
narāṇāmatituṣṭastvaṃ pūjitaḥ saṃpradāsyasi.. 218 ..
16.11.d:
क्षेममृद्धिं सुखं राज्यमारोग्यं कीर्तिमुन्नतिम्..
नराणामतितुष्टस्त्वं पूजितः संप्रदास्यसि.. 218 ..
16.11.m: Being greatly pleased when worshipped, you shall bestow upon men / safety, prosperity, happiness, kingship, health, fame, and exaltation.” (218)

16.11.s:
aśvinau devabhiṣajau kṛtau pitrā mahātmanā..
dharmadṛṣṭiryamaścāsau samo mitre tathā'hite.. 219..
16.11.d:
अश्विनौ देवभिषजौ कृतौ पित्रा महात्मना..
धर्मदृष्टिर्यमश्चासौ समो मित्रे तथाऽहिते.. 219..
16.11.m: The two Aśvins were made the physicians of the gods by their great-souled father; / and Yama was given insight into dharma, being impartial to friend and foe alike. (219)

16.11.s:
tato niyogaṃ taṃ cāsya cakāra timirāpahaḥ..
yamunāṃ ca nadīṃ cakre kalindāntaravāhinīm .. 7.1.11.220 ..
16.11.d:
ततो नियोगं तं चास्य चकार तिमिरापहः..
यमुनां च नदीं चक्रे कलिन्दान्तरवाहिनीम् .. 7.1.11.220 ..
16.11.m: Then the Dispeller of Darkness gave him that appointment, / and made Yamunā a river flowing through Kalinda. (220)

16.11.s:
chāyāsaṃjñāsutaścāpi sāvarṇistu mahāyaśāḥ ..
bhāvyaḥ sonāgate kāle manuḥ sāvarṇikoṣṭamaḥ .. 221 ..
16.11.d:
छायासंज्ञासुतश्चापि सावर्णिस्तु महायशाः ..
भाव्यः सोनागते काले मनुः सावर्णिकोष्टमः .. 221 ..
16.11.m: The son of Chāyā-Saṃjñā, the illustrious Sāvarṇi, / is to become the eighth Manu, Sāvarṇika, in a future time. (221)

16.11.s:
merupṛṣṭhe tapo ghoramadyāpi carati prabhuḥ ..
bhrātā śanaiścarastasya graho'bhūcca priye dhruvam .. 222 ..
16.11.d:
मेरुपृष्ठे तपो घोरमद्यापि चरति प्रभुः ..
भ्राता शनैश्चरस्तस्य ग्रहोऽभूच्च प्रिये ध्रुवम् .. 222 ..
16.11.m: The lord performs terrible austerity on the summit of Mount Meru even today; / his brother Śanaiścara became a planet, O beloved, firmly fixed. (222)

16.11.s:
evaṃ tebhyo varāndattvā revaṃtasyāpi bhāskaraḥ ..
punarnāma niruktaṃ sa revaṃtasyākarotpramuḥ ..223..
16.11.d:
एवं तेभ्यो वरान्दत्त्वा रेवंतस्यापि भास्करः ..
पुनर्नाम निरुक्तं स रेवंतस्याकरोत्प्रमुः ..223..
16.11.m: Having thus granted boons to them and also to Revanta, the Sun, / the lord, further pronounced an etymology of the name for Revanta. (223)

16.11.s:
evaṃgacchatyasau yasmātsaṃjñāyāḥ śāṃtidaḥ sutaḥ ..
aśvānāmādhipatye tu bhānunā ca niyojitaḥ .. 224 ..
16.11.d:
एवंगच्छत्यसौ यस्मात्संज्ञायाः शांतिदः सुतः ..
अश्वानामाधिपत्ये तु भानुना च नियोजितः .. 224 ..
16.11.m: Since this peace-bringing son of Saṃjñā traverses [the earth] in this way, / he was appointed by the Sun to the lordship over horses. (224)

16.11.s:
kṣemeṇa gacchate'dhvānaṃ yastu pūjayate pathi ..
sukhaprasādyo marttyānāṃ sadā ca varavarṇini .. 225 ..
iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye rājabhaṭṭārakotpattivarṇanaṃnāmaikādaśo'dhyāyaḥ .. 11 .. .. cha ..
16.11.d:
क्षेमेण गच्छतेऽध्वानं यस्तु पूजयते पथि ..
सुखप्रसाद्यो मर्त्त्यानां सदा च वरवर्णिनि .. 225 ..
इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये राजभट्टारकोत्पत्तिवर्णनंनामैकादशोऽध्यायः .. 11 .. .. छ ..
16.11.m:
He who worships him on the road travels his path in safety; / he is ever easily propitiated by mortals, O fair-complexioned woman. (225)
Thus ends the eleventh chapter, titled “The Description of the Origin of Rājabhaṭṭāraka”, in the first [sub-section], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh section, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compilation of eighty-one thousand [verses]. (11)

16.12.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
yā saṃjñā sā smṛtā rājñī chāyā yā sā tu nikṣubhā ..
rājṛ dīptau smṛto dhātū rājā rājati yaḥ sadā .. 1 ..
16.12.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
या संज्ञा सा स्मृता राज्ञी छाया या सा तु निक्षुभा ..
राजृ दीप्तौ स्मृतो धातू राजा राजति यः सदा .. 1 ..
16.12.m: Īśvara said: / She who is Saṃjñā is remembered as Rājñī; she who is Chāyā is Nikṣubhā. / The root rājṛ is remembered in the sense of shining; a king is one who always shines. (1)

16.12.s:
adhikaṃ sarvabhūtebhyastasmādrājā sa ucyate ..
rājapatnī tu sā yasmāttasmādrājñī prakīrtitā .. 2 ..
16.12.d:
अधिकं सर्वभूतेभ्यस्तस्माद्राजा स उच्यते ..
राजपत्नी तु सा यस्मात्तस्माद्राज्ञी प्रकीर्तिता .. 2 ..
16.12.m: He is called a king because he is superior to all beings; / and because she is the king's wife, she is celebrated as Rājñī. (2)

16.12.s:
kṣubha saṃcalane dhāturniścalā tena nikṣubhā ..
bhavaṃti hyathavā yasmātsvāṃgīyāḥ kṣudvivarjitāḥ .. 3 ..
16.12.d:
क्षुभ संचलने धातुर्निश्चला तेन निक्षुभा ..
भवंति ह्यथवा यस्मात्स्वांगीयाः क्षुद्विवर्जिताः .. 3 ..
16.12.m: The verbal root kṣubh means agitation; because she is motionless, she is Nikṣubhā; / or rather, because her own limbs are free from hunger. (3)

16.12.s:
chāyā tāṃ viśate divyā smṛtā sā tena nikṣubhā ..
sāṃprataṃ vartate yo'yaṃ manurloke mahāmate .. 4 ..
16.12.d:
छाया तां विशते दिव्या स्मृता सा तेन निक्षुभा ..
सांप्रतं वर्तते योऽयं मनुर्लोके महामते .. 4 ..
16.12.m: Because the divine Chāyā entered her, she is remembered as Nikṣubhā. / In the lineage of him who is the present Manu in the world, O wise one, (4)

16.12.s:
tasyānvavāye jātastu śaṃkhacakagadādharaḥ ..
yamastu mātrā saṃśapto hīnapādo dharātale .. 5 ..
16.12.d:
तस्यान्ववाये जातस्तु शंखचकगदाधरः ..
यमस्तु मात्रा संशप्तो हीनपादो धरातले .. 5 ..
16.12.m: was born the bearer of the conch, discus, and mace. / Yama, however, cursed by his mother, became lame on the surface of the earth. (5)

16.12.s:
prabhāsakṣetramāsādya cacāra vipulaṃ tapaḥ ..
varṣāṇāmayutaṃ sāgraṃ liṃgaṃ pūjitavānpriye .. 6 ..
16.12.d:
प्रभासक्षेत्रमासाद्य चचार विपुलं तपः ..
वर्षाणामयुतं साग्रं लिंगं पूजितवान्प्रिये .. 6 ..
16.12.m: Reaching the sacred field of Prabhāsa, he performed vast austerity; / for more than ten thousand years he worshipped the liṅga, O beloved. (6)

16.12.s:
tuṣṭaścāhaṃ tatastasya varāṇāṃ ca śataṃ dadau ..
adyāpi tatra deveśi yameśvaramiti śrutam ..
yamadvitīyāyāṃ dṛṣṭvā yamalokaṃ na paśyati .. 7 ..
16.12.d:
तुष्टश्चाहं ततस्तस्य वराणां च शतं ददौ ..
अद्यापि तत्र देवेशि यमेश्वरमिति श्रुतम् ..
यमद्वितीयायां दृष्ट्वा यमलोकं न पश्यति .. 7 ..
16.12.m: Pleased with him, I then granted him a hundred boons. / Even today it is famous there as Yameśvara, O queen of gods; / having seen it on Yamadvitīyā, one does not see Yama's realm. (7)

16.12.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye yameśvarotpattivarṇanaṃnāma dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ .. 12 ..
16.12.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये यमेश्वरोत्पत्तिवर्णनंनाम द्वादशोऽध्यायः .. 12 ..
16.12.m: Thus ends the twelfth chapter, titled “The Description of the Origin of Yameśvara”, in the first [sub-section], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh section, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compilation of eighty-one thousand [verses]. (12)

16.13.s:
.. devyuvāca .. ..
yadā bhramisthaḥ savitā takṣitaḥ kṣuradhārayā ..
śvaśureṇa mahādeva jāmātā prītipūrvakam.. 1 ..
16.13.d:
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
यदा भ्रमिस्थः सविता तक्षितः क्षुरधारया ..
श्वशुरेण महादेव जामाता प्रीतिपूर्वकम्.. 1 ..
16.13.m: The goddess said: / When Savitṛ, the son-in-law, standing on the lathe, was affectionately pared with the razor's edge / by his father-in-law, O Mahādeva, (1)

16.13.s:
tattejaḥ śātitaṃ bhūri prabhāse yatpapāta vai ..
tadabhūtkiṃ tadā deva prabhāsātkathayasva me .. 2 ..
16.13.d:
तत्तेजः शातितं भूरि प्रभासे यत्पपात वै ..
तदभूत्किं तदा देव प्रभासात्कथयस्व मे .. 2 ..
16.13.m: what became of that abundant splendour pared away, which fell in Prabhāsa? / Tell me that, O god, regarding Prabhāsa! (2)

16.13.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi sūryamāhātmyamuttamam ..
yacchrutvā mānavo bhaktyā mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ ..3..
16.13.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
शृणु देवि प्रवक्ष्यामि सूर्यमाहात्म्यमुत्तमम् ..
यच्छ्रुत्वा मानवो भक्त्या मुच्यते सर्वपातकैः ..3..
16.13.m: Īśvara said: / Listen, O goddess, I shall proclaim the supreme māhātmya of Sūrya, / hearing which with devotion, a mortal is freed from all sins. (3)

16.13.s:
dehāvatāro devasya prabhāse'rkasthalasya ca ..
purāṇākhyānamācakṣe tava devi yaśasvini .. 4 ..
16.13.d:
देहावतारो देवस्य प्रभासेऽर्कस्थलस्य च ..
पुराणाख्यानमाचक्षे तव देवि यशस्विनि .. 4 ..
16.13.m: I shall narrate to you, O renowned goddess, the Purāṇic account / of the descent of the god's body and of Arkasthala in Prabhāsa. (4)

16.13.s:
śākadvīpe mahādevi bhramisthasya tadā raveḥ ..
varṣāṇāṃ tu śataṃ sāgraṃ takṣyamāṇe vibhāvasau .. 5 ..
16.13.d:
शाकद्वीपे महादेवि भ्रमिस्थस्य तदा रवेः ..
वर्षाणां तु शतं साग्रं तक्ष्यमाणे विभावसौ .. 5 ..
16.13.m: In Śākadvīpa, O great goddess, while the Sun, standing on the lathe, / was being pared for more than a hundred years, (5)

16.13.s:
yadādya bhāgajaṃ tejastatprabhāse'patatpriye ..
patitaṃ tatra tattejaḥ sthalākāraṃ vyajāyata .. 6 ..
16.13.d:
यदाद्य भागजं तेजस्तत्प्रभासेऽपतत्प्रिये ..
पतितं तत्र तत्तेजः स्थलाकारं व्यजायत .. 6 ..
16.13.m: the splendour produced from the first portion fell in Prabhāsa, O beloved; / having fallen there, that splendour assumed the form of a mound. (6)

16.13.s:
jāṃbūnadamayaṃ devi tatpūrvamabhavatkṣitau ..
tiṣyamāhātmyayogena śailībhūtaṃ ca sāṃpratam .. 7 ..
16.13.d:
जांबूनदमयं देवि तत्पूर्वमभवत्क्षितौ ..
तिष्यमाहात्म्ययोगेन शैलीभूतं च सांप्रतम् .. 7 ..
16.13.m: Formerly, O goddess, it was of gold on the earth; / by virtue of the age of Tiṣya, it has now become stony. (7)

16.13.s:
tatra cārkamayaṃ rūpaṃ kṛtvā devo divākaraḥ ..
utpannaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ hitāya dharaṇītale .. 8 ..
16.13.d:
तत्र चार्कमयं रूपं कृत्वा देवो दिवाकरः ..
उत्पन्नः सर्वभूतानां हिताय धरणीतले .. 8 ..
16.13.m: And there, having assumed a solar form, the god who makes the day / was born on the surface of the earth for the welfare of all beings. (8)

16.13.s:
hiraṇyagarbhanāmeti kṛte sūryeti kīrtitam ..
tretāyāṃ savitānāma dvāpare bhāskaraḥ smṛtaḥ .. 9 ..
16.13.d:
हिरण्यगर्भनामेति कृते सूर्येति कीर्तितम् ..
त्रेतायां सवितानाम द्वापरे भास्करः स्मृतः .. 9 ..
16.13.m: In the Kṛta age it was called by the name Hiraṇyagarbha, and celebrated as Sūrya; / in the Tretā age its name was Savitṛ; in the Dvāpara age it was remembered as Bhāskara; (9)

16.13.s:
kalau cārkasthalonāma triṣu lokeṣu kīrtitaḥ ..
avatīrṇamidaṃ devi svayameva pratiṣṭhitam.. 7.1.13.10 ..
16.13.d:
कलौ चार्कस्थलोनाम त्रिषु लोकेषु कीर्तितः ..
अवतीर्णमिदं देवि स्वयमेव प्रतिष्ठितम्.. 7.1.13.10 ..
16.13.m: and in the Kali age it is celebrated as Arkasthala in the three worlds. / This descended [form], O goddess, became established by itself. (10)

16.13.s:
yadā svārociṣo devi dvitīyo'bhūnmanuḥ purā ..
tasminkāle'vatīrṇo'sau devastatra divākaraḥ .. 11 ..
16.13.d:
यदा स्वारोचिषो देवि द्वितीयोऽभून्मनुः पुरा ..
तस्मिन्कालेऽवतीर्णोऽसौ देवस्तत्र दिवाकरः .. 11 ..
16.13.m: Formerly, O goddess, when Svārociṣa was the second Manu, / at that time this god, the maker of the day, descended there. (11)

16.13.s:
bhaktimukti prado devi vyādhiduḥkhavināśakṛt ..
tasya tejodbhavairvyāptaṃ reṇubhiḥ pañcayojanam .. 12 ..
16.13.d:
भक्तिमुक्ति प्रदो देवि व्याधिदुःखविनाशकृत् ..
तस्य तेजोद्भवैर्व्याप्तं रेणुभिः पञ्चयोजनम् .. 12 ..
16.13.m: Granting devotion and liberation, O goddess, destroying diseases and sorrows, / an area of five yojanas is pervaded by particles arising from his brilliance.

16.13.s:
dakṣiṇottarato devi pañcapūrvāpareṇa tu ..
uttareṇa samudrasya yāvanmāheśvarī nadī .. 13 ..
16.13.d:
दक्षिणोत्तरतो देवि पञ्चपूर्वापरेण तु ..
उत्तरेण समुद्रस्य यावन्माहेश्वरी नदी .. 13 ..
16.13.m: From south to north, O goddess, and five from east to west, / north of the ocean up to the Māheśvarī river,

16.13.s:
nyaṃkumatyāścāparato yāvadeva kṛtasmaram ..
etadvyāptaṃ mahādevi tattejoreṇubhiḥ śubhaiḥ .. 14 ..
16.13.d:
न्यंकुमत्याश्चापरतो यावदेव कृतस्मरम् ..
एतद्व्याप्तं महादेवि तत्तेजोरेणुभिः शुभैः .. 14 ..
16.13.m: and west of the Nyaṅkumatī up to Kṛtasmaram, / this is pervaded, O great goddess, by those auspicious particles of his brilliance.

16.13.s:
tasya sūkṣmā prabhā yā tu āditejoviniḥsṛtā ..
tayā vyāptaṃ mahādevi yāvaddvādaśayojanam .. 15 ..
16.13.d:
तस्य सूक्ष्मा प्रभा या तु आदितेजोविनिःसृता ..
तया व्याप्तं महादेवि यावद्द्वादशयोजनम् .. 15 ..
16.13.m: The subtle radiance that issued from the original brilliance / pervaded [an area] of twelve yojanas, O great goddess.

16.13.s:
uttare bhāskarasutā dakṣiṇe saritāṃ patiḥ ..
pūrvapaścimato devi rukmiṇīdvitayaṃ smṛtam .. 16 ..
16.13.d:
उत्तरे भास्करसुता दक्षिणे सरितां पतिः ..
पूर्वपश्चिमतो देवि रुक्मिणीद्वितयं स्मृतम् .. 16 ..
16.13.m: To the north is the daughter of the sun, to the south the lord of rivers [the ocean]; / to the east and west, O goddess, the pair of Rukmiṇīs is recorded.

16.13.s:
etasminnantare devi sauraṃ tejaḥ prasarppitam ..
tena pāvitryamānītaṃ kṣetraṃ dvādaśayojanam .. 17 ..
16.13.d:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे देवि सौरं तेजः प्रसर्प्पितम् ..
तेन पावित्र्यमानीतं क्षेत्रं द्वादशयोजनम् .. 17 ..
16.13.m: Within this interval, O goddess, the solar brilliance spread; / by that, the sacred field of twelve yojanas was purified.

16.13.s:
tasya madhyasya yanmadhyaṃ tadgṛhaṃ mama sundari ..
tejomaṇḍalamadhyasthaṃ mama sthānaṃ maheśvari .. 18 ..
16.13.d:
तस्य मध्यस्य यन्मध्यं तद्गृहं मम सुन्दरि ..
तेजोमण्डलमध्यस्थं मम स्थानं महेश्वरि .. 18 ..
16.13.m: The very center of its middle is my abode, O beautiful one; / situated in the center of the orb of brilliance is my place, O great goddess.

16.13.s:
cakṣurmaṃḍalamadhye tu yathā devi kanīnikā ..
pūrvapaścimato devi gomukhādā''śvamedhikam.. 19 ..
16.13.d:
चक्षुर्मंडलमध्ये तु यथा देवि कनीनिका ..
पूर्वपश्चिमतो देवि गोमुखादा'ऽश्वमेधिकम्.. 19 ..
16.13.m: Just as the pupil, O goddess, is in the middle of the orb of the eye; / from east to west, O goddess, from Gomukha up to the Āśvamedhika,

16.13.s:
dakṣiṇottarato devi samudrātkauraveśvarīm ..
etasminnaṃtare kṣetre kṣetrajño'haṃ varānane .. 7.1.13.20 ..
16.13.d:
दक्षिणोत्तरतो देवि समुद्रात्कौरवेश्वरीम् ..
एतस्मिन्नंतरे क्षेत्रे क्षेत्रज्ञोऽहं वरानने .. 7.1.13.20 ..
16.13.m: from south to north, O goddess, from the ocean to Kauraveśvarī, / in this intermediate sacred field I am the knower of the field, O fair-faced one.

16.13.s:
yasmādarkasya tejobhirbhāsitaṃ mama tadgṛham ..
tasmātprabhāsanāmeti kalpe'sminprathitaṃ priye .. 21 ..
16.13.d:
यस्मादर्कस्य तेजोभिर्भासितं मम तद्गृहम् ..
तस्मात्प्रभासनामेति कल्पेऽस्मिन्प्रथितं प्रिये .. 21 ..
16.13.m: Because my abode is illumined by the brilliance of the sun, / therefore it is renowned in this kalpa by the name Prabhāsa, O beloved.

16.13.s:
tatra paśyati yaḥ sūryamarkkarūpaṃ narottamaḥ ..
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ sūryaloke mahīyate .. 22 ..
16.13.d:
तत्र पश्यति यः सूर्यमर्क्करूपं नरोत्तमः ..
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तः सूर्यलोके महीयते .. 22 ..
16.13.m: Whoever, the best of men, sees the sun there in the form of an arka plant, / freed from all sins, is glorified in the world of the sun.

16.13.s:
sa snātaḥ sarvatīrtheṣu tena ceṣṭaṃ mahāmakhaiḥ ..
sarvadānāni dattāni pūrvajāstena toṣitāḥ .. 23 ..
16.13.d:
स स्नातः सर्वतीर्थेषु तेन चेष्टं महामखैः ..
सर्वदानानि दत्तानि पूर्वजास्तेन तोषिताः .. 23 ..
16.13.m: He has bathed in all the sacred fords, he has sacrificed with great sacrifices; / he has given all gifts, and the ancestors have been pleased by him.

16.13.s:
arkarūpī yataḥ sūryastatra jāto mahītale ..
tasmāttyājyaḥ sadā cārko bhojane'tra na saṃśayaḥ .. 24 ..
16.13.d:
अर्करूपी यतः सूर्यस्तत्र जातो महीतले ..
तस्मात्त्याज्यः सदा चार्को भोजनेऽत्र न संशयः .. 24 ..
16.13.m: Since the sun was born there on the earth having the form of an arka plant, / therefore the arka must always be avoided in eating here, without a doubt.

16.13.s:
yo dṛṣṭvārkasthalaṃ marttyaścārkapatreṣu bhuṃjati ..
gomāṃsabhakṣaṇaṃ tena kṛtaṃ bhavati bhāmini .. 25 ..
16.13.d:
यो दृष्ट्वार्कस्थलं मर्त्त्यश्चार्कपत्रेषु भुंजति ..
गोमांसभक्षणं तेन कृतं भवति भामिनि .. 25 ..
16.13.m: The mortal who, having seen Arkasthala, eats from leaves of the arka plant, / beef has been eaten by him, O passionate woman.

16.13.s:
bhakṣito bhāskarastena sa kuṣṭhī jāyate naraḥ ..
tasmātsarvaprayatnena cārkapatrāṇi varjayet .. 26 ..
16.13.d:
भक्षितो भास्करस्तेन स कुष्ठी जायते नरः ..
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन चार्कपत्राणि वर्जयेत् .. 26 ..
16.13.m: The sun is eaten by him; that man becomes a leper. / Therefore, with all effort, one should avoid arka leaves.

16.13.s:
yātrāyāṃ prathamaṃ devi dṛṣṭo yenārkabhāskaraḥ ..
taṃ dṛṣṭvā mahiṣīṃ dadyādbrāhmaṇāya vipaścite .. .. 27 ..
16.13.d:
यात्रायां प्रथमं देवि दृष्टो येनार्कभास्करः ..
तं दृष्ट्वा महिषीं दद्याद्ब्राह्मणाय विपश्चिते .. .. 27 ..
16.13.m: By whom the Arka-sun is seen first during the pilgrimage, O goddess, / having seen him, he should give a female buffalo to a learned brahmin,

16.13.s:
tāmravarṇaṃ raktavastraṃ tatastuṣyati bhāskaraḥ ..
tasya caiva tu sāṃnidhye vahnikoṇe vyavasthitam .. 28 ..
16.13.d:
ताम्रवर्णं रक्तवस्त्रं ततस्तुष्यति भास्करः ..
तस्य चैव तु सांनिध्ये वह्निकोणे व्यवस्थितम् .. 28 ..
16.13.m: along with copper-colored or red cloth; then the sun is pleased. / And situated in its vicinity, in the southeast fire corner,

16.13.s:
nātidūre mahābhāge siddheśvaramiti smṛtam ..
sarvasiddhipradaṃ devi liṃgaṃ trailokyapūjitam .. 29 ..
16.13.d:
नातिदूरे महाभागे सिद्धेश्वरमिति स्मृतम् ..
सर्वसिद्धिप्रदं देवि लिंगं त्रैलोक्यपूजितम् .. 29 ..
16.13.m: not far away, O highly fortunate one, is known as Siddheśvara, / a liṅga granting all perfections, O goddess, worshipped in the three worlds.

16.13.s:
jaigīṣavyeśvaraṃnāma pūrvaṃ kṛtayuge'bhavat ..
kalau siddheśvaramiti prasiddhimagamatpriye .. 7.1.13.30 ..
16.13.d:
जैगीषव्येश्वरंनाम पूर्वं कृतयुगेऽभवत् ..
कलौ सिद्धेश्वरमिति प्रसिद्धिमगमत्प्रिये .. 7.1.13.30 ..
16.13.m: Formerly, in the Kṛta age, it was named Jaigīṣavyeśvara; / in the Kali [age], O beloved, it attained renown as Siddheśvara.

16.13.s:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā manujo devi sarvasiddhimavāpnuyāt ..
tatraiva devadeveśi nātidūre vyavasthitam ..31..
16.13.d:
तं दृष्ट्वा मनुजो देवि सर्वसिद्धिमवाप्नुयात् ..
तत्रैव देवदेवेशि नातिदूरे व्यवस्थितम् ..31..
16.13.m: A mortal who sees it, O goddess, attains all perfections. / In that very place, O ruler of gods, situated not far off,

16.13.s:
sūryadakṣiṇanairṛtye pātālavivaraṃ priye ..
maṃdehā rākṣasā yatra tathā śālakaṭaṃkaṭāḥ .. 32 ..
16.13.d:
सूर्यदक्षिणनैरृत्ये पातालविवरं प्रिये ..
मंदेहा राक्षसा यत्र तथा शालकटंकटाः .. 32 ..
16.13.m: to the south-southwest of the sun, O beloved, is the chasm to Pātāla, / where the Mandeha demons and the Śālakaṭaṅkaṭas,

16.13.s:
sūryasya tejasā dagdhāḥ pātālamagamanpurā ..
kalau taddvāramevāsti na pātāle gatiḥ priye .. 33 ..
16.13.d:
सूर्यस्य तेजसा दग्धाः पातालमगमन्पुरा ..
कलौ तद्द्वारमेवास्ति न पाताले गतिः प्रिये .. 33 ..
16.13.m: burnt by the brilliance of the sun, formerly went down to Pātāla. / In the Kali [age] only its door exists, O beloved, not access to Pātāla.

16.13.s:
yoginyastatra rakṣaṃti brāhmyādyā mātarastathā ..
māghekṛṣṇacaturdaśyāṃ rātrau mātṛgaṇānyajet ..
balipuṣpopahāraiśca tataḥ siddhirbhaviṣyati .. 34 ..
16.13.d:
योगिन्यस्तत्र रक्षंति ब्राह्म्याद्या मातरस्तथा ..
माघेकृष्णचतुर्दश्यां रात्रौ मातृगणान्यजेत् ..
बलिपुष्पोपहारैश्च ततः सिद्धिर्भविष्यति .. 34 ..
16.13.m: The yoginīs protect it there, as do the Mothers beginning with Brāhmī. / On the fourteenth day of the dark half of Māgha, at night, one should worship the groups of Mothers / with offerings, flowers, and presents; then perfection will arise.

16.13.s:
iti hi sakaladharmabhāvahetorharakamalāsanaviṣṇusaṃstutasya..
tanuparilikhanaṃ niśamya bhānorvrajati divākaralokamāyuṣoṃ'te..35..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye prabhāsapavitranāmakaraṇārkasthalotpattivarṇanaṃnāma trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ .. .. 13 ..
16.13.d:
इति हि सकलधर्मभावहेतोर्हरकमलासनविष्णुसंस्तुतस्य..
तनुपरिलिखनं निशम्य भानोर्व्रजति दिवाकरलोकमायुषोंऽते..35..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये प्रभासपवित्रनामकरणार्कस्थलोत्पत्तिवर्णनंनाम त्रयोदशोऽध्यायः .. .. 13 ..
16.13.m:
Thus, indeed, having heard of this delineation of the body of the sun, / the cause of the state of all righteousness, praised by Hara, Viṣṇu, and the lotus-seated Brahmā, / one goes to the world of the sun at the end of life.
Thus ends the thirteenth chapter, named 'Description of the Origin of Arkasthala and the Naming of Prabhāsa as Pure,' in the first [part], the Māhātmya of Prabhāsa Sacred Field, in the seventh [book], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the Skanda Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.14.s:
.. devyuvāca .. ..
yadetadbhavatā proktaṃ māhātmyaṃ sūryadaivatam..
tanme vistarato brūhi devadeva jagatpate .. 1 ..
16.14.d:
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
यदेतद्भवता प्रोक्तं माहात्म्यं सूर्यदैवतम्..
तन्मे विस्तरतो ब्रूहि देवदेव जगत्पते .. 1 ..
16.14.m: The goddess said: / This māhātmya relating to the sun deity that has been spoken of by you, / tell me that in detail, O god of gods, O lord of the world.

16.14.s:
kathamarkasthalo bhūtaḥ prabhāsakṣetrabhūṣaṇaḥ ..
pūjanīyo mahādevaḥ samyagyātrāphalepsubhiḥ .. 2 ..
16.14.d:
कथमर्कस्थलो भूतः प्रभासक्षेत्रभूषणः ..
पूजनीयो महादेवः सम्यग्यात्राफलेप्सुभिः .. 2 ..
16.14.m: How did Arkasthala become the ornament of the sacred field of Prabhāsa, / [and how should] Mahādeva be worshipped properly by those desiring the fruit of the pilgrimage?

16.14.s:
ke maṃtrāḥ kiṃ vidhānaṃ tu keṣu parvasu pūjayet..
jaigīṣavyeśvaro bhūtvā hyabhūtsiddheśvaraḥ katham ..
tanme kathaya deveśa vistarātsarvameva hi .. 3 ..
16.14.d:
के मंत्राः किं विधानं तु केषु पर्वसु पूजयेत्..
जैगीषव्येश्वरो भूत्वा ह्यभूत्सिद्धेश्वरः कथम् ..
तन्मे कथय देवेश विस्तरात्सर्वमेव हि .. 3 ..
16.14.m: What are the mantras, and what is the procedure? On what lunar occasions should one worship? / How did [the liṅga] that was Jaigīṣavyeśvara become Siddheśvara? / Tell me all of that in detail, O lord of gods.

16.14.s:
pātāle vivaraṃ tatra yoginyastatra kiṃ purā ..
tathā mātṛgaṇaścaiva kathametadabhūtpurā .. 4 ..
16.14.d:
पाताले विवरं तत्र योगिन्यस्तत्र किं पुरा ..
तथा मातृगणश्चैव कथमेतदभूत्पुरा .. 4 ..
16.14.m: The chasm to Pātāla there, why were the yoginīs there in ancient times, / and likewise the group of Mothers—how did this happen formerly?

16.14.s:
etatsarvamaśeṣeṇa dayāṃ kṛtvā jagatpate ..
mamācakṣva virūpākṣa yadyahaṃ te priyā hara .. 5 ..
16.14.d:
एतत्सर्वमशेषेण दयां कृत्वा जगत्पते ..
ममाचक्ष्व विरूपाक्ष यद्यहं ते प्रिया हर .. 5 ..
16.14.m: Explain all of this without omission, having taken pity, O lord of the world; / tell it to me, O Virūpākṣa, if I am dear to you, O Hara.

16.14.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
sādhu pṛṣṭaṃ tvayā devi kathayāmi samāsataḥ ..
siddheśvaro hyabhūdyena jaigīṣavyeśvaro haraḥ .. 6 ..
16.14.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
साधु पृष्टं त्वया देवि कथयामि समासतः ..
सिद्धेश्वरो ह्यभूद्येन जैगीषव्येश्वरो हरः .. 6 ..
16.14.m: Īśvara said: / Well asked by you, O goddess! I shall tell in brief / how Hara as Jaigīṣavyeśvara became Siddheśvara.

16.14.s:
pūjāvidhānaṃ vistīrya tanme nigadataḥ śṛṇu ..
āsīdasminkṛte devi sarva jñānaviśāradaḥ .. 7 ..
16.14.d:
पूजाविधानं विस्तीर्य तन्मे निगदतः शृणु ..
आसीदस्मिन्कृते देवि सर्व ज्ञानविशारदः .. 7 ..
16.14.m: I shall explain the rite of worship in full; listen to me reciting it. / In this Kṛta [age], O goddess, there was one proficient in all knowledge,

16.14.s:
putraḥ śatakalākasya jaigīṣavya iti śrutaḥ ..
prabhāsakṣetramāsādya sa cakre duścaraṃ tapaḥ .. 8 ..
16.14.d:
पुत्रः शतकलाकस्य जैगीषव्य इति श्रुतः ..
प्रभासक्षेत्रमासाद्य स चक्रे दुश्चरं तपः .. 8 ..
16.14.m: the son of Śatakalāka, renowned as Jaigīṣavya. / Having reached the sacred field of Prabhāsa, he performed severe austerity.

16.14.s:
atiṣṭhadvāyubhakṣaśca varṣāṇāṃ śatakaṃ kila ..
ambubhakṣaḥ sahasraṃ tu śākāhāro'yutaṃ tathā .. 9 ..
16.14.d:
अतिष्ठद्वायुभक्षश्च वर्षाणां शतकं किल ..
अम्बुभक्षः सहस्रं तु शाकाहारोऽयुतं तथा .. 9 ..
16.14.m: He stood subsisting on air for a hundred years, indeed, / subsisting on water for a thousand, and subsisting on greens for ten thousand.

16.14.s:
cāṃdrāyaṇasahasraṃ ca kṛtaṃ sāṃtapanaṃ punaḥ ..
śoṣayitvā mitāhāro digvāsāḥ samapadyata .. 7.1.14.10 ..
16.14.d:
चांद्रायणसहस्रं च कृतं सांतपनं पुनः ..
शोषयित्वा मिताहारो दिग्वासाः समपद्यत .. 7.1.14.10 ..
16.14.m: A thousand Cāndrāyaṇa fasts were performed, and then the Sāṃtapana penance; / having emaciated himself, of measured food, he became sky-clad [naked].

16.14.s:
pūrve kalpe svayaṃ bhūtaṃ mahodayamiti śrutam ..
sa liṃgaṃ devadevasya pratiṣṭhāpyārcayannapi .. 11 ..
16.14.d:
पूर्वे कल्पे स्वयं भूतं महोदयमिति श्रुतम् ..
स लिंगं देवदेवस्य प्रतिष्ठाप्यार्चयन्नपि .. 11 ..
16.14.m: Having installed the liṅga of the god of gods, which was self-manifest / in a former kalpa and renowned as Mahodaya, while worshipping it,

16.14.s:
bhasmaśāyī bhasmadigdho nṛtta gītairatoṣayat ..
japena vṛṣanādaiśca tapasā bhāvitaḥ śuciḥ .. 12 ..
16.14.d:
भस्मशायी भस्मदिग्धो नृत्त गीतैरतोषयत् ..
जपेन वृषनादैश्च तपसा भावितः शुचिः .. 12 ..
16.14.m: lying on ashes, smeared with ashes, he pleased [the god] with dances and songs, / with muttered prayer and bull-roars, purified and absorbed in austerity.

16.14.s:
tamevaṃ toṣayāṇaṃ tu bhaktyā paramayā yutam ..
bhagavāṃśca tamabhyetya idaṃ vacanamabravīt .. 13 ..
16.14.d:
तमेवं तोषयाणं तु भक्त्या परमया युतम् ..
भगवांश्च तमभ्येत्य इदं वचनमब्रवीत् .. 13 ..
16.14.m: To him who was thus pleasing [him], endowed with supreme devotion, / the Lord approached and spoke these words:

16.14.s:
jaigīṣavya mahābuddhe paśya māṃ divyacakṣuṣā ..
tuṣṭo'smi varadaścāhaṃ brūhi yatte manogatam .. 14 ..
16.14.d:
जैगीषव्य महाबुद्धे पश्य मां दिव्यचक्षुषा ..
तुष्टोऽस्मि वरदश्चाहं ब्रूहि यत्ते मनोगतम् .. 14 ..
16.14.m: "O Jaigīṣavya of great intellect, behold me with divine sight. / I am pleased and ready to grant a boon; speak what is in your heart."

16.14.s:
sa evamukto devena devaṃ dṛṣṭvā trilocanam..
praṇamya śirasā pādāvidaṃ vacanamabravīt .. 15 ..
16.14.d:
स एवमुक्तो देवेन देवं दृष्ट्वा त्रिलोचनम्..
प्रणम्य शिरसा पादाविदं वचनमब्रवीत् .. 15 ..
16.14.m: Addressed thus by the god, having seen the three-eyed god, / bowing with his head to his feet, he spoke these words:

16.14.s:
.. jaigīṣavya uvāca .. ..
bhagavandevadeveśa mama tuṣṭo yadi prabho ..
jñānayogaṃ hi me dehi yaḥ saṃsāranikṛntanam.. 16 ..
16.14.d:
.. जैगीषव्य उवाच .. ..
भगवन्देवदेवेश मम तुष्टो यदि प्रभो ..
ज्ञानयोगं हि मे देहि यः संसारनिकृन्तनम्.. 16 ..
16.14.m: Jaigīṣavya said: / "O Blessed Lord, ruler of the gods, if you are pleased with me, O master, / then give me the yoga of knowledge that cuts through worldly existence.

16.14.s:
bhagavannānyadicchāmi yogātparataraṃ hitam ..
tvayi bhaktiśca nityaṃ me devyāṃ skande gaṇeśvare .. .. 17 ..
16.14.d:
भगवन्नान्यदिच्छामि योगात्परतरं हितम् ..
त्वयि भक्तिश्च नित्यं मे देव्यां स्कन्दे गणेश्वरे .. .. 17 ..
16.14.m: O Blessed Lord, I desire no other good higher than yoga, / and perpetual devotion to you, to the goddess, to Skanda, and to Gaṇeśvara."

16.14.s:
na ca vyādhibhayaṃ bhūyānna ca tejo'pamānatā ..
anutsekaṃ tathā kṣāṃtiṃ damaṃ śamamathāpi ca .. 18 ..
16.14.d:
न च व्याधिभयं भूयान्न च तेजोऽपमानता ..
अनुत्सेकं तथा क्षांतिं दमं शममथापि च .. 18 ..
16.14.m: And may there be no fear of disease for me, nor diminution of fiery splendour, / and likewise absence of pride, forbearance, self-restraint, and mental tranquillity.

16.14.s: etānvarānmahādeva tvadicchāmi trilocana .. 19 ..
16.14.d: एतान्वरान्महादेव त्वदिच्छामि त्रिलोचन .. 19 ..
16.14.m: These boons I desire from you, O Mahādeva, O three-eyed lord!

16.14.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
ajaraścāmaraścaiva sarvaśokavivarjitaḥ ..
mahāyogī mahāvīryo yogaiśvaryasamanvitaḥ..7.1.14.20..
16.14.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
अजरश्चामरश्चैव सर्वशोकविवर्जितः ..
महायोगी महावीर्यो योगैश्वर्यसमन्वितः..7.1.14.20..
16.14.m: Īśvara said: / You shall be free from old age and death, rid of all sorrow, / a great yogin, of great virility, endowed with the sovereign powers of yoga.

16.14.s:
prabhāvāccāsya kṣetrasya guhyasya mama śāśvatam ..
yogāṣṭaguṇamaiśvaryaṃ prāpsyase paramaṃ mahat .. 21 ..
16.14.d:
प्रभावाच्चास्य क्षेत्रस्य गुह्यस्य मम शाश्वतम् ..
योगाष्टगुणमैश्वर्यं प्राप्स्यसे परमं महत् .. 21 ..
16.14.m: And by the power of this sacred field of mine, which is secret and eternal, / you shall attain supreme and great sovereignty consisting of the eightfold qualities of yoga.

16.14.s: bhaviṣyasi muniśreṣṭha yogācāryaḥ suviśrutaḥ .. 22 ..
16.14.d: भविष्यसि मुनिश्रेष्ठ योगाचार्यः सुविश्रुतः .. 22 ..
16.14.m: You shall become a teacher of yoga, highly renowned, O best of sages!

16.14.s:
yaścedaṃ tvatkṛtaṃ ligaṃ niyamenārcayiṣyati ..
sarvapāpavinirmukto yogaṃ divyamavāpsyati .. 23 ..
16.14.d:
यश्चेदं त्वत्कृतं लिगं नियमेनार्चयिष्यति ..
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो योगं दिव्यमवाप्स्यति .. 23 ..
16.14.m: And whoever worships this liṅga established by you according to rule / shall be freed from all sins and shall attain divine yoga.

16.14.s:
jaigīṣavyaguhāṃ cemāṃ prāpya yogaṃ karoti yaḥ ..
sa saptarātrādyuktātmā saṃsāraṃ saṃtariṣyati .. 24 ..
16.14.d:
जैगीषव्यगुहां चेमां प्राप्य योगं करोति यः ..
स सप्तरात्राद्युक्तात्मा संसारं संतरिष्यति .. 24 ..
16.14.m: And whoever reaches this cave of Jaigīṣavya and practises yoga, / disciplined in mind, shall cross over the cycle of worldly existence after seven nights.

16.14.s:
māsena pūrvajātiṃ ca janmātītaṃ ca vetsyati ..
ekarātrāttanuṃ śuddhāṃ dvābhyāṃ tārayate pitṝn..
trirātreṇa vyatītena tvaparānsapta tārayet .. 25 ..
16.14.d:
मासेन पूर्वजातिं च जन्मातीतं च वेत्स्यति ..
एकरात्रात्तनुं शुद्धां द्वाभ्यां तारयते पितॄन्..
त्रिरात्रेण व्यतीतेन त्वपरान्सप्त तारयेत् .. 25 ..
16.14.m: Within a month he shall know his previous state of existence and past births; / through a single night [he makes] his body pure; through two [nights] he rescues his ancestors; / and when three nights have passed, he can rescue seven others.

16.14.s:
punaśca tava viprarṣe ajeyatvaṃ ca yogibhiḥ ..
icchato darśanaṃ caiva bhaviṣyati ca te mama .. 26 ..
16.14.d:
पुनश्च तव विप्रर्षे अजेयत्वं च योगिभिः ..
इच्छतो दर्शनं चैव भविष्यति च ते मम .. 26 ..
16.14.m: Moreover, O brahmin seer, you shall be unconquerable by yogins, / and you shall have darśana of me whenever you desire.

16.14.s:
iti devo varāndattvā tatraivāṃtaradhīyata ..
etatkṛtayuge vṛttaṃ tava devi prabhāṣitam .. 27 ..
16.14.d:
इति देवो वरान्दत्त्वा तत्रैवांतरधीयत ..
एतत्कृतयुगे वृत्तं तव देवि प्रभाषितम् .. 27 ..
16.14.m: Having granted these boons, the god vanished right there. / This event in the Kṛta age has been related to you, O goddess.

16.14.s:
tretāyuge mahādevi dvāpare'pi tathaiva ca ..
kaliyugapraveśe tu vālakhilyā maharṣayaḥ .. 28 ..
16.14.d:
त्रेतायुगे महादेवि द्वापरेऽपि तथैव च ..
कलियुगप्रवेशे तु वालखिल्या महर्षयः .. 28 ..
16.14.m: In the Tretā age, O great goddess, and likewise in the Dvāpara, / but at the onset of the Kali age, the great seers, the Vālakhilyas,

16.14.s:
asminprābhāsike kṣetre sūryasthalasamīpataḥ ..
ārādhayaṃto deveśaṃ guhāmadhyanivāsinam .. 29 ..
16.14.d:
अस्मिन्प्राभासिके क्षेत्रे सूर्यस्थलसमीपतः ..
आराधयंतो देवेशं गुहामध्यनिवासिनम् .. 29 ..
16.14.m: in this sacred field of Prabhāsa, near Sūryasthala, / worshipping the lord of gods who dwells within the cave,

16.14.s:
aṣṭāśītisahasrāṇi ṛṣayaścorddharetasaḥ ..
varṣāyutaṃ tapastaptvā siddhiṃ jagmustadātmikām..7.1.14.30..
16.14.d:
अष्टाशीतिसहस्राणि ऋषयश्चोर्द्धरेतसः ..
वर्षायुतं तपस्तप्त्वा सिद्धिं जग्मुस्तदात्मिकाम्..7.1.14.30..
16.14.m: eighty-eight thousand seers of sublimated sexual energy, / having performed tapas for ten thousand years, attained perfection consisting of Him.

16.14.s:
tataḥ siddheśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ kalau khyātaṃ varānane ..
yadā somena saṃyuktā kṛṣṇā śivacaturdaśī ..
tadaiva tasya devasya darśanaṃ devi durllabham .. 31 ..
16.14.d:
ततः सिद्धेश्वरं लिंगं कलौ ख्यातं वरानने ..
यदा सोमेन संयुक्ता कृष्णा शिवचतुर्दशी ..
तदैव तस्य देवस्य दर्शनं देवि दुर्ल्लभम् .. 31 ..
16.14.m: From then on, the liṅga became renowned in the Kali [age] as Siddheśvara, O fair-faced one. / When the dark fourteenth day of Śiva is joined with the Moon (Monday), / only then, O goddess, is the darśana of that god difficult to obtain.

16.14.s:
brahmāṃḍaṃ sakalaṃ dattvā yatpuṇyamupajāyate ..
tatpuṇyaṃ labhate devi siddhaliṃgasya pūjanāt .. 32 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye siddheśvarotpattivarṇanaṃnāma caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ .. 14 ..
16.14.d:
ब्रह्मांडं सकलं दत्त्वा यत्पुण्यमुपजायते ..
तत्पुण्यं लभते देवि सिद्धलिंगस्य पूजनात् .. 32 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये सिद्धेश्वरोत्पत्तिवर्णनंनाम चतुर्दशोऽध्यायः .. 14 ..
16.14.m:
The merit that is generated by giving the entire cosmos— / that merit one obtains, O goddess, from worshipping the Siddha-liṅga.
Thus ends the fourteenth chapter, entitled 'Description of the Origin of Siddheśvara', in the first [part], 'Māhātmya of Prabhāsakṣetra', of the seventh [book], Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

16.15.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tasyāgneye tu deveśi aruṇena pratiṣṭhitam..
dhanuṣāṃ ca traye tatra siddhaliṃgasamīpataḥ ..1..
16.15.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
तस्याग्नेये तु देवेशि अरुणेन प्रतिष्ठितम्..
धनुषां च त्रये तत्र सिद्धलिंगसमीपतः ..1..
16.15.m: Īśvara said: / To the south-east of it, O queen of the gods, [a liṅga] was established by Aruṇa / at a distance of three bows from that Siddha-liṅga.

16.15.s:
sūryasārathinā tatra liṃgaṃ devipratiṣṭhitam..
kalau pāpaharaṃnāma darśanātpāpanāśanam .. 2 ..
16.15.d:
सूर्यसारथिना तत्र लिंगं देविप्रतिष्ठितम्..
कलौ पापहरंनाम दर्शनात्पापनाशनम् .. 2 ..
16.15.m: A liṅga was established there by the charioteer of the Sun, O goddess; / in the Kali [age] it is named Pāpahara, destroying sins by its very sight.

16.15.s:
caitramāsa trayodaśyāṃ śuklāyāṃ varavarṇini ..
pūjayedvidhivadbhaktyā pauṃḍarīkaphalaṃ labhet .. 3 ..
16.15.d:
चैत्रमास त्रयोदश्यां शुक्लायां वरवर्णिनि ..
पूजयेद्विधिवद्भक्त्या पौंडरीकफलं लभेत् .. 3 ..
16.15.m: On the thirteenth day of the bright fortnight in the month of Caitra, O woman of excellent complexion, / one who worships it according to rule with devotion attains the fruit of the Pauṇḍarīka sacrifice.

16.15.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye pāpanāśanotpattivarṇanaṃnāma paṃcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ .. 15 ..
16.15.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये पापनाशनोत्पत्तिवर्णनंनाम पंचदशोऽध्यायः .. 15 ..
16.15.m: Thus ends the fifteenth chapter, entitled 'Description of the Origin of Pāpanāśana', in the first [part], 'Māhātmya of Prabhāsakṣetra', of the seventh [book], Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

16.16.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
pātālavivarasyāpi māhātmyaṃ śṛṇu sāṃpratam ..
pūrvapṛṣṭaṃ mahādevi brahmaṇā viśvakarmaṇā .. 1 ..
16.16.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
पातालविवरस्यापि माहात्म्यं शृणु सांप्रतम् ..
पूर्वपृष्टं महादेवि ब्रह्मणा विश्वकर्मणा .. 1 ..
16.16.m: Īśvara said: / Hear now also the māhātmya of the chasm of Pātāla, / which was formerly asked about, O great goddess, by Viśvakarman, the creator.

16.16.s:
tamobhāve samutpanne jātāstatraiva rākṣasāḥ ..
sūryasya dveṣiṇaḥ sarve hyasaṃkhyātā mahābalāḥ .. .. 2 ..
16.16.d:
तमोभावे समुत्पन्ने जातास्तत्रैव राक्षसाः ..
सूर्यस्य द्वेषिणः सर्वे ह्यसंख्याता महाबलाः .. .. 2 ..
16.16.m: When darkness arose, rākṣasas were born right there, / all of them haters of the Sun, innumerable and of great strength.

16.16.s:
te tu dṛṣṭvā mahātmānaṃ samudyaṃtaṃ divākaram ..
te dhūmrapramukhāḥ sarve jahasuḥ sūryamaṃjasā .. 3 ..
16.16.d:
ते तु दृष्ट्वा महात्मानं समुद्यंतं दिवाकरम् ..
ते धूम्रप्रमुखाः सर्वे जहसुः सूर्यमंजसा .. 3 ..
16.16.m: When they saw the great-souled day-maker rising up, / all of them, headed by Dhūmra, straightway laughed at the Sun:

16.16.s:
asmākamaṃtakaḥ ko'yaṃ vidyate pāpakarmakṛt..
ityūcurvividhā vācaḥ sūryasyāgre sthitāstadā..4..
16.16.d:
अस्माकमंतकः कोऽयं विद्यते पापकर्मकृत्..
इत्यूचुर्विविधा वाचः सूर्यस्याग्रे स्थितास्तदा..4..
16.16.m: 'Who is this destroyer of ours that performs evil deeds?' / Thus, standing before the Sun, they spoke various words.

16.16.s:
iti śrutvā tadā devaḥ krodhasphuritādharaḥ..
rākṣasānāṃ vacaścaiva bhakṣyamāṇo divākaraḥ.. 5..
16.16.d:
इति श्रुत्वा तदा देवः क्रोधस्फुरिताधरः..
राक्षसानां वचश्चैव भक्ष्यमाणो दिवाकरः.. 5..
16.16.m: Hearing this speech of the rākṣasas, the god, the day-maker, / his lower lip trembling with wrath, being swallowed [by them],

16.16.s:
tataḥ krodhābhibhūtena cakṣuṣā cāvalokayat..
sa krūrarakṣaḥkṣayakṛttimiradvipakesarī.. 6..
16.16.d:
ततः क्रोधाभिभूतेन चक्षुषा चावलोकयत्..
स क्रूररक्षःक्षयकृत्तिमिरद्विपकेसरी.. 6..
16.16.m: then looked with an eye overcome by anger— / he, the destroyer of cruel demons, a lion to the elephant of darkness.

16.16.s:
mahāṃśumānkhagaḥ sūryastadvināśamaciṃtayat..
ajānannaṃtataśchidraṃ rākṣasānāṃ divaspatiḥ.. 7 ..
16.16.d:
महांशुमान्खगः सूर्यस्तद्विनाशमचिंतयत्..
अजानन्नंततश्छिद्रं राक्षसानां दिवस्पतिः.. 7 ..
16.16.m: The sun, possessing great rays, moving through the sky, contemplated their destruction, / not knowing at first any vulnerability in the rākṣasas, the lord of the sky.

16.16.s:
sa dharmavicyutāndṛṣṭvā pāpopahatacetasaḥ..
evaṃ saṃciṃtya bhagavāndadhyau dhyānaṃ prabhākaraḥ..8.
16.16.d:
स धर्मविच्युतान्दृष्ट्वा पापोपहतचेतसः..
एवं संचिंत्य भगवान्दध्यौ ध्यानं प्रभाकरः..8.
16.16.m: Seeing them fallen from dharma, their minds struck by sin, / reflecting thus, the blessed light-maker meditated in contemplation.

16.16.s:
ajānaṃstejasā grastaṃ trailokyaṃ rajanīcaraiḥ ..
tataste bhānunā dṛṣṭāḥ krodhādhmātena cakṣuṣā .. 9 ..
16.16.d:
अजानंस्तेजसा ग्रस्तं त्रैलोक्यं रजनीचरैः ..
ततस्ते भानुना दृष्टाः क्रोधाध्मातेन चक्षुषा .. 9 ..
16.16.m: He perceived that the three worlds were swallowed up by the night-stalkers through their fiery power. / Then they were looked upon by the Sun with an eye inflated by anger.

16.16.s:
nipeturaṃbarabhraṣṭāḥ kṣīṇapuṇyā iva grahāḥ ..
rākṣasairveṣṭito dhūmro nipatañchuśubheṃ'barāt .. 7.1.16.10 ..
16.16.d:
निपेतुरंबरभ्रष्टाः क्षीणपुण्या इव ग्रहाः ..
राक्षसैर्वेष्टितो धूम्रो निपतञ्छुशुभेंऽबरात् .. 7.1.16.10 ..
16.16.m: Fallen from the sky, they crashed down like planets whose merits are exhausted. / Surrounded by the rākṣasas, Dhūmra shone as he fell from the sky,

16.16.s:
arddhapakvaṃ yathā tālaphalaṃ kapibhirāvṛtam ..
yadṛcchayā nipetuste yaṃtramuktā yathopalāḥ .. 11 ..
16.16.d:
अर्द्धपक्वं यथा तालफलं कपिभिरावृतम् ..
यदृच्छया निपेतुस्ते यंत्रमुक्ता यथोपलाः .. 11 ..
16.16.m: like a half-ripe palmyra fruit surrounded by monkeys. / They crashed down randomly like stones hurled from a catapult.

16.16.s:
tato vāyu vaśādbhraṣṭā bhittvā bhūmiṃ rasātalam..
jagmuste kṣetramāsādya prabhāsaṃ varavarṇini .. 12..
16.16.d:
ततो वायु वशाद्भ्रष्टा भित्त्वा भूमिं रसातलम्..
जग्मुस्ते क्षेत्रमासाद्य प्रभासं वरवर्णिनि .. 12..
16.16.m: Then, having fallen by the power of the wind, piercing the earth, / they went to Rasātala after reaching the sacred field of Prabhāsa, O woman of excellent complexion,

16.16.s:
yatra cārkasthalo devaḥ sarvasiddhipradāyakaḥ ..
tatsānnidhyasthitaṃ devi pātālavivaraṃ mahat .. 13 ..
16.16.d:
यत्र चार्कस्थलो देवः सर्वसिद्धिप्रदायकः ..
तत्सान्निध्यस्थितं देवि पातालविवरं महत् .. 13 ..
16.16.m: where the god Arkasthala, the bestower of all perfections, resides; / near it, O goddess, is situated the great chasm of Pātāla.

16.16.s:
anyāni koṭiśaḥ saṃti tāni luptāni bhāmini ..
kṛtasmarātsamārabhya yāvadarkasthalo raviḥ .. 14 ..
16.16.d:
अन्यानि कोटिशः संति तानि लुप्तानि भामिनि ..
कृतस्मरात्समारभ्य यावदर्कस्थलो रविः .. 14 ..
16.16.m: There are crores of others, [but] they have disappeared, O radiant woman, / beginning from Kṛtasmara up to the sun of Arkasthala.

16.16.s:
devamāturvaraṃ prāpya siddhayo'ṣṭau vyavasthitāḥ ..
etasminnaṃtare devi sūryakṣetramudāhṛtam .. 15 ..
16.16.d:
देवमातुर्वरं प्राप्य सिद्धयोऽष्टौ व्यवस्थिताः ..
एतस्मिन्नंतरे देवि सूर्यक्षेत्रमुदाहृतम् .. 15 ..
16.16.m: Having obtained a boon from the Mother of the Gods, the eight perfections are stationed there. / In this interval, O goddess, the sacred field of the Sun is proclaimed.

16.16.s:
sūryasya tejaso devi madhyabhāgaṃ hi tatsmṛtam ..
sarvaṃ hemamayaṃ devi nāpuṇyastatra vīkṣate .. 16 ..
16.16.d:
सूर्यस्य तेजसो देवि मध्यभागं हि तत्स्मृतम् ..
सर्वं हेममयं देवि नापुण्यस्तत्र वीक्षते .. 16 ..
16.16.m: That is remembered as the central part of the Sun's splendour, O goddess; / it is entirely made of gold, O goddess; one devoid of merit does not behold it.

16.16.s:
vivarāṇāṃ śataṃ caikaṃ sparśāścaiva tu koṭiśaḥ ..
tatra saṃti mahādevi siddheśastu prarakṣati .. 17 ..
16.16.d:
विवराणां शतं चैकं स्पर्शाश्चैव तु कोटिशः ..
तत्र संति महादेवि सिद्धेशस्तु प्ररक्षति .. 17 ..
16.16.m: There are one hundred and one chasms, and touches by the crores; / they exist there, O great goddess, and Siddheśa protects them.

16.16.s:
idaṃ kṣetraṃ mahādevi priyaṃ sūryasya sarvadā ..
sūryaparvaṇisaṃprāpte kurukṣetrādhikaṃ priye .. 18 ..
16.16.d:
इदं क्षेत्रं महादेवि प्रियं सूर्यस्य सर्वदा ..
सूर्यपर्वणिसंप्राप्ते कुरुक्षेत्राधिकं प्रिये .. 18 ..
16.16.m: This sacred field, O great goddess, is always dear to the Sun; / when a solar conjunction arrives, O beloved, it is greater than Kurukṣetra.

16.16.s:
brāhmī caiva hiraṇyā ca saṃgamaśca mahodadheḥ ..
etattrisaṃgamaṃ devi koṭitīrtha phalapradam .. 19 ..
16.16.d:
ब्राह्मी चैव हिरण्या च संगमश्च महोदधेः ..
एतत्त्रिसंगमं देवि कोटितीर्थ फलप्रदम् .. 19 ..
16.16.m: The Brāhmī, the Hiraṇyā, and the confluence of the great ocean: / this triple confluence, O goddess, bestows the fruit of ten million sacred fords.

16.16.s:
devamātā ca tatraiva maṃkīśastatra tiṣṭhati ..
nāgasthānaṃ nagasthānaṃ tatraiva samudāhṛtam .1 7.1.16.20 ..
16.16.d:
देवमाता च तत्रैव मंकीशस्तत्र तिष्ठति ..
नागस्थानं नगस्थानं तत्रैव समुदाहृतम् .1 7.1.16.20 ..
16.16.m: The Mother of the Gods is right there, and Maṅkīśa stays there; / the abode of serpents and the abode of the mountain are proclaimed right there.

16.16.s:
iti saṃkṣepataḥ proktamarkasthalama- hodayam ..
rākṣasānāṃ ca saṃpātādabhūcca vivaraṃ yathā .. 21 ..
16.16.d:
इति संक्षेपतः प्रोक्तमर्कस्थलम- होदयम् ..
राक्षसानां च संपातादभूच्च विवरं यथा .. 21 ..
16.16.m: Thus the great majesty of Arkasthala has been briefly described, / and how the chasm came to be through the fall of the rākṣasas.

16.16.s:
anyāni tatra deveśi luptāni vivarāṇi vai ..
evaṃ tu prakaṭaṃ tatra dṛśyate'dyāpi bhāmini .. 22 ..
16.16.d:
अन्यानि तत्र देवेशि लुप्तानि विवराणि वै ..
एवं तु प्रकटं तत्र दृश्यतेऽद्यापि भामिनि .. 22 ..
16.16.m: Other chasms there have indeed vanished, O queen of the gods; / but this one is seen openly there even today, O radiant woman.

16.16.s:
śrīmukhaṃ nāma taddvāraṃ rakṣyate mātṛbhiḥ priye ..
varṣamekaṃ caturddaśyāṃ niyamādyastu pūjayet .. 23 ..
16.16.d:
श्रीमुखं नाम तद्द्वारं रक्ष्यते मातृभिः प्रिये ..
वर्षमेकं चतुर्द्दश्यां नियमाद्यस्तु पूजयेत् .. 23 ..
16.16.m: That opening, named Śrīmukha, is guarded by the Mothers, O beloved. / Whoever worships it with self-restraint on the fourteenth day for one year,

16.16.s:
tatra mātṛgaṇāndevi sunaṃdādyānvidhānataḥ..
paśupuṣpopahāraiśca dhūpadīpaistathottamaiḥ ..
viprāṇāṃ bhojanairdevi tasya siddhirbhaviṣyati .. 24 ..
16.16.d:
तत्र मातृगणान्देवि सुनंदाद्यान्विधानतः..
पशुपुष्पोपहारैश्च धूपदीपैस्तथोत्तमैः ..
विप्राणां भोजनैर्देवि तस्य सिद्धिर्भविष्यति .. 24 ..
16.16.m: There, O goddess, [he who worships] the host of mothers headed by Sunandā according to rule, / with offerings of animals and flowers, and with excellent incense and lamps, / and with feedings for brahmins, O goddess, will attain perfection.

16.16.s:
tasmātsarvaprayatnena tatrārkasthalasaṃnidhau ..
pūjayenmātaraḥ sarvā yadīcchetsiddhimātmanaḥ .. 25 ..
16.16.d:
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन तत्रार्कस्थलसंनिधौ ..
पूजयेन्मातरः सर्वा यदीच्छेत्सिद्धिमात्मनः .. 25 ..
16.16.m: Therefore, by every effort, near that Arkasthala, / one should worship all the mothers if one desires one's own perfection.

16.16.s:
etāstu mātaro devi sunaṃdāgaṇanāmataḥ ..
khyātiṃ yāṃti prabhāse tu kṣetresminvaravarṇini .. 26 ..
16.16.d:
एतास्तु मातरो देवि सुनंदागणनामतः ..
ख्यातिं यांति प्रभासे तु क्षेत्रेस्मिन्वरवर्णिनि .. 26 ..
16.16.m: These mothers, O goddess, known by the name of the group of Sunandā, / have attained fame in this sacred field of Prabhāsa, O fair-complexioned one.

16.16.s:
etatsaṃkṣepataḥ proktaṃ pātālottaramadhyataḥ ..
tacchrutvā mucyate devi sarvāpadbhyo narottamaḥ .. 27 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye arkasthalamāhātmye pātālavivarasunaṃdādimātṛgaṇotpattivarṇanaṃnāma ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ .. ..16 .. .. ..
16.16.d:
एतत्संक्षेपतः प्रोक्तं पातालोत्तरमध्यतः ..
तच्छ्रुत्वा मुच्यते देवि सर्वापद्भ्यो नरोत्तमः .. 27 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये अर्कस्थलमाहात्म्ये पातालविवरसुनंदादिमातृगणोत्पत्तिवर्णनंनाम षोडशोऽध्यायः .. ..16 .. .. ..
16.16.m:
This has been told in brief concerning the middle of the northern [entrance] of Pātāla; / having heard it, O goddess, the best of men is freed from all misfortunes.
Thus ends the sixteenth chapter, entitled 'Description of the Origin of the Host of Mothers Headed by Sunandā at the Opening to Pātāla', in the Māhātmya of Arkasthala in the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, the first [part] of the seventh section, Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

16.17.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
atha pūjāvidhānaṃ te kathayāmi yaśasvini ..
arkasthalasya devasya yathā pūjyo narottamaiḥ ..1..
16.17.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
अथ पूजाविधानं ते कथयामि यशस्विनि ..
अर्कस्थलस्य देवस्य यथा पूज्यो नरोत्तमैः ..1..
16.17.m: Īśvara said: / Now I shall tell you the rule of worship, O glorious one, / of the god of Arkasthala, how he is to be worshipped by the best of men.

16.17.s:
sarveṣāmeva devānāmādirāditya ucyate ..
ādikarttā tvasau yasmādādityastena cocyate..2..
16.17.d:
सर्वेषामेव देवानामादिरादित्य उच्यते ..
आदिकर्त्ता त्वसौ यस्मादादित्यस्तेन चोच्यते..2..
16.17.m: The Sun (Āditya) is said to be the first of all the gods; / and because he is the first maker, he is called Āditya.

16.17.s:
nādityena vinā rātrirna divā na ca tarpaṇam..
na dharmo vai na cādharmo na saṃtiṣṭheccarācaram .. 3 ..
16.17.d:
नादित्येन विना रात्रिर्न दिवा न च तर्पणम्..
न धर्मो वै न चाधर्मो न संतिष्ठेच्चराचरम् .. 3 ..
16.17.m: Without the Sun there is neither night nor day, nor water offering, / neither virtue nor vice; nor could the moving and unmoving exist.

16.17.s:
ādityaḥ pālayetsarvamādityaḥ sṛjate sadā ..
ādityaḥ saṃharetsarvaṃ tasmādeṣa trayīmayaḥ ..4..
16.17.d:
आदित्यः पालयेत्सर्वमादित्यः सृजते सदा ..
आदित्यः संहरेत्सर्वं तस्मादेष त्रयीमयः ..4..
16.17.m: The Sun preserves everything; the Sun always creates; / the Sun dissolves everything; therefore he is composed of the threefold Veda.

16.17.s:
ārādhanavidhiṃ tasya bhāskarasya mahātmanaḥ ..
kathayāmi mahādevi vedoktairmaṃtravistaraiḥ ..
taṃ śṛṇuṣva varārohe sarvapāpapraṇāśanam .. 5 ..
16.17.d:
आराधनविधिं तस्य भास्करस्य महात्मनः ..
कथयामि महादेवि वेदोक्तैर्मंत्रविस्तरैः ..
तं शृणुष्व वरारोहे सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् .. 5 ..
16.17.m: I shall proclaim the rite of worship of that great-souled Sun, / O great goddess, through the extensive mantras declared in the Vedas; / listen to that which destroys all sins, O woman of beautiful hips.

16.17.s:
mūrttisthaḥ pūjyate yena vidhānena maheśvari ..
dvādaśātmā yathā sūryastatte vakṣyāmyaśeṣataḥ .. 6 ..
16.17.d:
मूर्त्तिस्थः पूज्यते येन विधानेन महेश्वरि ..
द्वादशात्मा यथा सूर्यस्तत्ते वक्ष्याम्यशेषतः .. 6 ..
16.17.m: The rule by which the twelvefold Sun, dwelling in his image, / is worshipped, O great goddess—that I will tell you in full.

16.17.s:
mukhaśuddhiṃ ca kṛtvā''dau snānaṃ kṛtvā viśeṣataḥ ..
vastraśuddhiṃ deha śuddhiṃ kṛtvā sūryaṃ spṛśettataḥ .. 7 ..
16.17.d:
मुखशुद्धिं च कृत्वा'ऽदौ स्नानं कृत्वा विशेषतः ..
वस्त्रशुद्धिं देह शुद्धिं कृत्वा सूर्यं स्पृशेत्ततः .. 7 ..
16.17.m: First having purified the mouth, and especially having performed ritual ablution, / having purified one's garments and purified one's body, one should then touch the Sun.

16.17.s:
dantakāṣṭhavidhānaṃ tu prathamaṃ kathayāmi te ..
madhūke putralābhaḥ syādarke netrasukhaṃ priye .. 9 ..
vaktṛtvaṃ vai badaryā ca bṛhatyā drurjjanāñjayet ..
aiśvaryaṃ ca bhavedbilve khadire ca na saṃśayaḥ .. 9 ..
16.17.d:
दन्तकाष्ठविधानं तु प्रथमं कथयामि ते ..
मधूके पुत्रलाभः स्यादर्के नेत्रसुखं प्रिये .. 9 ..
वक्तृत्वं वै बदर्या च बृहत्या द्रुर्ज्जनाञ्जयेत् ..
ऐश्वर्यं च भवेद्बिल्वे खदिरे च न संशयः .. 9 ..
16.17.m:
First, however, I shall describe to you the rule of the tooth-stick: / from the madhūka there is the gain of a son; from the arka, delight of the eyes, O beloved.
Eloquence [comes] from the jujube, and with the bṛhatī one conquers wicked people; / sovereignty arises from the bilva, and from the khadira, without a doubt.

16.17.s:
rogakṣayaḥ kadambe tu arthalābho'timuktake ..
marutāṃ yāti sarvatra āṭarūṣakasaṃbhavaiḥ .. 7.1.17.10 ..
16.17.d:
रोगक्षयः कदम्बे तु अर्थलाभोऽतिमुक्तके ..
मरुतां याति सर्वत्र आटरूषकसंभवैः .. 7.1.17.10 ..
16.17.m: Destruction of disease [comes] from the kadamba; gain of wealth from the atimuktaka; / with sticks made of āṭarūṣaka, one goes everywhere among the gods.

16.17.s:
jātipradhānatāṃ jātāvaśvattho yacchate yaśaḥ ..
śriyaṃ prāpnoti nikhilāṃ śirīṣasya niṣevaṇāt .. 11 ..
16.17.d:
जातिप्रधानतां जातावश्वत्थो यच्छते यशः ..
श्रियं प्राप्नोति निखिलां शिरीषस्य निषेवणात् .. 11 ..
16.17.m: Pre-eminence in one's caste [comes from the jātī]; the aśvattha grants fame; / one obtains complete fortune from the use of the śirīṣa.

16.17.s:
priyaṃguṃ sevamānasya saubhāgyaṃ paramaṃ bhavet ..
abhīpsitārthasiddhiḥ syānnityaṃ plakṣaniṣevaṇāt ..12..
16.17.d:
प्रियंगुं सेवमानस्य सौभाग्यं परमं भवेत् ..
अभीप्सितार्थसिद्धिः स्यान्नित्यं प्लक्षनिषेवणात् ..12..
16.17.m: For one who uses the priyaṅgu, there will be supreme auspicious fortune; / the attainment of one's desired ends comes from the daily use of the plakṣa.

16.17.s:
na pāṭitaṃ samaśnīyāddaṃtakāṣṭhaṃ na savraṇam ..
na corddhaśuṣkaṃ vakraṃ vā naiva ca tvagvivarjjitam .. 13 ...
16.17.d:
न पाटितं समश्नीयाद्दंतकाष्ठं न सव्रणम् ..
न चोर्द्धशुष्कं वक्रं वा नैव च त्वग्विवर्ज्जितम् .. 13 ...
16.17.m: One should not use a tooth-stick that is split, nor one that is blemished, / nor one that is dried at the top, or crooked, nor one devoid of bark.

16.17.s:
vitastimātramaśnīyāddīrghaṃ hrasvaṃ ca varjayet ..
udaṅmukho vā prāṅmukhaḥ sukhāsīno'tha vāgyataḥ .. .. 14 ..
16.17.d:
वितस्तिमात्रमश्नीयाद्दीर्घं ह्रस्वं च वर्जयेत् ..
उदङ्मुखो वा प्राङ्मुखः सुखासीनोऽथ वाग्यतः .. .. 14 ..
16.17.m: One should use one that is only a span long, and avoid long or short ones, / facing north or facing east, seated comfortably and with speech restrained.

16.17.s:
kāmaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ hṛdaye kṛtvā samabhimantrya ca ..
maṃtreṇānena matimānaśnīyāddantadhāvanam .. 15 ..
16.17.d:
कामं यथेष्टं हृदये कृत्वा समभिमन्त्र्य च ..
मंत्रेणानेन मतिमानश्नीयाद्दन्तधावनम् .. 15 ..
16.17.m: Holding one's desired wish in heart, and consecrating it, / the wise person should use the tooth-cleanser with this mantra:

16.17.s:
varaṃ dattvā'bhijānāsi kāmaṃ caiva vanaspate ..
siddhiṃ prayaccha me nityaṃ dantakāṣṭha namo'stu te .. 16 ..
16.17.d:
वरं दत्त्वाऽभिजानासि कामं चैव वनस्पते ..
सिद्धिं प्रयच्छ मे नित्यं दन्तकाष्ठ नमोऽस्तु ते .. 16 ..
16.17.m: 'Granting a boon, you recognize my desire, O lord of the forest; / grant me success always, O tooth-stick; salutations to you!'

16.17.s:
trīnvārānparijapyaivaṃ bhakṣayeddaṃtadhāvanam ..
paścātprakṣālya tatkāṣṭhaṃ śucau deśe vinikṣipet .. 17 ..
16.17.d:
त्रीन्वारान्परिजप्यैवं भक्षयेद्दंतधावनम् ..
पश्चात्प्रक्षाल्य तत्काष्ठं शुचौ देशे विनिक्षिपेत् .. 17 ..
16.17.m: Having recited this three times, one should chew the tooth-cleanser; / afterwards, having washed that stick, one should cast it in a clean place.

16.17.s:
daṃtakāṣṭhena deveśi na jihvāṃ parimārjayet ..
pṛthakpṛthaktadā kāryaṃ yadīcchedvipulaṃ yaśaḥ .. 18 ..
16.17.d:
दंतकाष्ठेन देवेशि न जिह्वां परिमार्जयेत् ..
पृथक्पृथक्तदा कार्यं यदीच्छेद्विपुलं यशः .. 18 ..
16.17.m: One should not scrape the tongue with the tooth-stick, O ruler of the gods; / that must be done separately if one desires abundant fame.

16.17.s:
aṃgulyā daṃtakāṣṭhaṃ ca pratyakṣaṃ lavaṇaṃ ca yat ..
mṛttikābhakṣaṇaṃ caiva tulyaṃ gomāṃsabhakṣaṇaiḥ .. 19 ..
16.17.d:
अंगुल्या दंतकाष्ठं च प्रत्यक्षं लवणं च यत् ..
मृत्तिकाभक्षणं चैव तुल्यं गोमांसभक्षणैः .. 19 ..
16.17.m: [Brushing with] a tooth-stick using the finger, [eating] raw salt, / and eating earth are equal to eating beef.

16.17.s:
mukhe paryuṣite nityaṃ bhavatyaprayato dvijaḥ ..
tasmācchuṣkamathārdraṃ vā bhakṣayeddaṃtadhāvanam .. 7.1.17.20 ..
16.17.d:
मुखे पर्युषिते नित्यं भवत्यप्रयतो द्विजः ..
तस्माच्छुष्कमथार्द्रं वा भक्षयेद्दंतधावनम् .. 7.1.17.20 ..
16.17.m: When the mouth is stale [upon waking], a twice-born becomes constantly impure; / therefore, one should chew a tooth-cleanser, whether dry or moist.

16.17.s:
varjite divase caiva gaḍūṣāṃścaiva ṣoḍaśa ..
tattatpadmasugandhairvā mukhaśuddhiṃ ca kārayet .. 21 ..
16.17.d:
वर्जिते दिवसे चैव गडूषांश्चैव षोडश ..
तत्तत्पद्मसुगन्धैर्वा मुखशुद्धिं च कारयेत् .. 21 ..
16.17.m: And on forbidden days, [one should perform] sixteen mouthfuls of water, / or one should purify the mouth with fragrances of various lotuses.

16.17.s:
mukhaśuddhimakṛtvā yo bhāskaraṃ spṛśati dvijaḥ ..
trīṇi varṣasahasrāṇi sa kuṣṭhī jāyate naraḥ .. 22 ..
16.17.d:
मुखशुद्धिमकृत्वा यो भास्करं स्पृशति द्विजः ..
त्रीणि वर्षसहस्राणि स कुष्ठी जायते नरः .. 22 ..
16.17.m: The twice-born who touches the Sun without having purified his mouth / is born as a leper for three thousand years.

16.17.s:
evaṃ vastrādi saṃśodhya tataḥ snānaṃ samācaret ..
śucau manorame sthāne saṃgṛhyāstreṇa mṛttikām.. 23 ..
16.17.d:
एवं वस्त्रादि संशोध्य ततः स्नानं समाचरेत् ..
शुचौ मनोरमे स्थाने संगृह्यास्त्रेण मृत्तिकाम्.. 23 ..
16.17.m: Thus having purified one's clothes and the rest, one should then perform the ritual ablution: / in a clean, delightful place, taking clay with the astra-mantra.

16.17.s:
sānusvārokārayuto hakāraḥ phaṭsamanvitaḥ ..
anenāstreṇa saṃgṛhya snānaṃ tatra samācaret .. 24 ..
16.17.d:
सानुस्वारोकारयुतो हकारः फट्समन्वितः ..
अनेनास्त्रेण संगृह्य स्नानं तत्र समाचरेत् .. 24 ..
16.17.m: The letter 'ha' joined with an anusvāra and the vowel 'u', accompanied by 'phaṭ'— / taking [clay] with this weapon-mantra, one should perform the ritual ablution there.

16.17.s:
bhāgatrayaṃ tu saṃśuddhaṃ tṛṇapāṣāṇavarjitam ..
ekamastreṇa cālabhya tathānyaṃ bhāskareṇa tu .. 25 ..
16.17.d:
भागत्रयं तु संशुद्धं तृणपाषाणवर्जितम् ..
एकमस्त्रेण चालभ्य तथान्यं भास्करेण तु .. 25 ..
16.17.m: Having made three portions, purified and free from grass and stones, / smearing one with the astra-mantra, and likewise another with the sun-mantra,

16.17.s:
aṃgaiścaiva tṛtīyaṃ tu abhimaṃtrya sakṛtsakṛt ..
japtvāstreṇa kṣipeddikṣu nirvighnaṃ tu jalaṃ bhavet .. 26 ..
16.17.d:
अंगैश्चैव तृतीयं तु अभिमंत्र्य सकृत्सकृत् ..
जप्त्वास्त्रेण क्षिपेद्दिक्षु निर्विघ्नं तु जलं भवेत् .. 26 ..
16.17.m: and consecrating the third with the aṅga-mantras, each one at a time, / having recited the astra-mantra, one should throw it in the directions; then the water becomes free of obstacles.

16.17.s:
sūryatīrtha dvitīyena tṛtīyena sakṛtsakṛt ..
guṃṭhayitvā tataḥ snāyādravitīrthena mānavaḥ .. 27 ..
16.17.d:
सूर्यतीर्थ द्वितीयेन तृतीयेन सकृत्सकृत् ..
गुंठयित्वा ततः स्नायाद्रवितीर्थेन मानवः .. 27 ..
16.17.m: Covering [oneself] with the second in the Sūryatīrtha, and with the third once each time, / a man should then bathe in the sacred ford of the Sun.

16.17.s:
tūryaśaṃkha ninādena dhyātvā devaṃ divākaram ..
snātvā rājopacāreṇa punarācamya yatnataḥ .. 28 ..
16.17.d:
तूर्यशंख निनादेन ध्यात्वा देवं दिवाकरम् ..
स्नात्वा राजोपचारेण पुनराचम्य यत्नतः .. 28 ..
16.17.m: To the sound of trumpets and conches, meditating on the god who makes the day, / having bathed with royal honors, and carefully sipping water again,

16.17.s:
snānaṃ kṛtvā tato devi maṃtrarājena saṃyutam ..
harephau biṃdu lakṣmīśca tathā'nyo dīrghayā saha .. 29 ..
16.17.d:
स्नानं कृत्वा ततो देवि मंत्रराजेन संयुतम् ..
हरेफौ बिंदु लक्ष्मीश्च तथाऽन्यो दीर्घया सह .. 29 ..
16.17.m: and then having performed the ritual ablution, O goddess, joined with the king of mantras: / the 'ha' and 'ra', with a bindu and 'ī' (lakṣmī), and likewise another with a long

16.17.s:
mātrayā rephasaṃyukto hakāro biṃdunā saha ..
sakāraḥ savisargastu maṃtrarājo'yamucyate .. 7.1.17.30 ..
16.17.d:
मात्रया रेफसंयुक्तो हकारो बिंदुना सह ..
सकारः सविसर्गस्तु मंत्रराजोऽयमुच्यते .. 7.1.17.30 ..
16.17.m: vowel mark, joined with 'ra', the letter 'ha' with a bindu, / and the letter 'sa' with a visarga—this is called the king of mantras.

16.17.s:
tatastu tarppayenmaṃtrānsarvāṃstāṃstu karāgrajaiḥ ..
tulanādūrdhvato devānsavyena ca munīṃstathā ..
pitṝṃścaivāpasavyena hṛdbījena pratarpayet .. 31 ..
16.17.d:
ततस्तु तर्प्पयेन्मंत्रान्सर्वांस्तांस्तु कराग्रजैः ..
तुलनादूर्ध्वतो देवान्सव्येन च मुनींस्तथा ..
पितॄंश्चैवापसव्येन हृद्बीजेन प्रतर्पयेत् .. 31 ..
16.17.m: Then one should offer water to all those mantras with the tips of the fingers: / lifting upward to the gods, with the sacred thread on the right shoulder to the sages, / and with the sacred thread on the left shoulder to the ancestors, one should offer with the heart-bīja.

16.17.s:
yadgītaṃ pravaraṃ loke akṣarāṇāṃ manīṣibhiḥ ..
ekonaviṃśaṃ mātrāyā akṣaraṃ tatprakīrttitam .. 32 ..
16.17.d:
यद्गीतं प्रवरं लोके अक्षराणां मनीषिभिः ..
एकोनविंशं मात्राया अक्षरं तत्प्रकीर्त्तितम् .. 32 ..
16.17.m: That which is praised by the wise as the foremost among syllables in the world— / that is proclaimed as the nineteenth syllable of the vowels.

16.17.s:
evaṃ snātvā vidhānena saṃdhyāṃ vaṃdedvidhānataḥ ..
tato vidvānkṣipetpaścādbhāskarāyodakāṃjalim .. 33 ..
16.17.d:
एवं स्नात्वा विधानेन संध्यां वंदेद्विधानतः ..
ततो विद्वान्क्षिपेत्पश्चाद्भास्करायोदकांजलिम् .. 33 ..
16.17.m: Having thus bathed according to rule, one should worship the twilight according to rule; / then the learned man should afterwards cast an offering of water to the Sun.

16.17.s:
japecca tryakṣaraṃ maṃtra ṣaṇmukhaṃ ca yadṛcchayā ..
maṃtrarājeti yaḥ pūrvaṃ tavākhyāto mayā priye .. 34 ..
16.17.d:
जपेच्च त्र्यक्षरं मंत्र षण्मुखं च यदृच्छया ..
मंत्रराजेति यः पूर्वं तवाख्यातो मया प्रिये .. 34 ..
16.17.m: And one should recite the three-syllable mantra and the six-faced [mantra] at will, / which was previously declared to you by me, O beloved, as the king of mantras.

16.17.s:
paścāttīrthena maṃtrāstu saṃhṛtya hṛdaye nyaset ..
maṃtrairātmānamekatra kṛtvā cārghaṃ pradāpayet .. 35 ..
16.17.d:
पश्चात्तीर्थेन मंत्रास्तु संहृत्य हृदये न्यसेत् ..
मंत्रैरात्मानमेकत्र कृत्वा चार्घं प्रदापयेत् .. 35 ..
16.17.m: Then, drawing in the mantras by means of the sacred ford, one should place them in the heart; / uniting oneself with the mantras in one place, one should offer the argha.

16.17.s:
raktacaṃdanagaṃdhaistu śuciḥsnāto mahītale ..
kṛtvā maṃḍalakaṃ vṛttamekacitto vyavasthitaḥ .. 36 ..
16.17.d:
रक्तचंदनगंधैस्तु शुचिःस्नातो महीतले ..
कृत्वा मंडलकं वृत्तमेकचित्तो व्यवस्थितः .. 36 ..
16.17.m: Clean and bathed, with scents of red sandalwood on the surface of the earth, / having made a circular maṇḍala, steady with a one-pointed mind,

16.17.s:
gṛhītvā karavīrāṇi tāmre saṃsthāpya bhājane ..
tilataṃdulasaṃyuktaṃ kuśagandhodakena tu ..37..
16.17.d:
गृहीत्वा करवीराणि ताम्रे संस्थाप्य भाजने ..
तिलतंदुलसंयुक्तं कुशगन्धोदकेन तु ..37..
16.17.m: Taking oleanders and placing them in a copper vessel, / mixed with sesamum and rice grains, along with kuśa grass and fragrant water,

16.17.s:
raktacaṃdana dhūpena yuktama?rghyopasādhitam ..
kṛtvā śirasi tatpātraṃ jānubhyāmavaniṃ gataḥ.. 38 ..
16.17.d:
रक्तचंदन धूपेन युक्तम?र्घ्योपसाधितम् ..
कृत्वा शिरसि तत्पात्रं जानुभ्यामवनिं गतः.. 38 ..
16.17.m: accompanied by red sandalwood and incense, properly arranged for the offering of arghya, / placing that vessel upon his head, having gone down upon his knees to the ground,

16.17.s:
mūlamaṃtreṇa saṃyuktamarghyaṃ dadyācca bhānave ..
mucyate sarvapāpaistu yo hyevaṃ vinivedayet .. 39 ..
16.17.d:
मूलमंत्रेण संयुक्तमर्घ्यं दद्याच्च भानवे ..
मुच्यते सर्वपापैस्तु यो ह्येवं विनिवेदयेत् .. 39 ..
16.17.m: one should offer the arghya to the sun, accompanied by the root mantra. / For whoever presents it thus is freed from all sins.

16.17.s:
yadyugādisahasreṇa vyatīpātaśatena ca ..
ayanānāṃ sahasreṇa yatphalaṃ jyeṣṭhapuṣkare ..
tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti sūryāyārghya nivedane .. 7.1.17.40 ..
16.17.d:
यद्युगादिसहस्रेण व्यतीपातशतेन च ..
अयनानां सहस्रेण यत्फलं ज्येष्ठपुष्करे ..
तत्फलं समवाप्नोति सूर्यायार्घ्य निवेदने .. 7.1.17.40 ..
16.17.m: Whatever fruit is obtained in a thousand Yugādis and a hundred Vyatīpātas, / or in a thousand solstices at Jyeṣṭhapuṣkara, / that fruit one completely attains upon presenting an arghya to the sun.

16.17.s:
dīkṣāmaṃtravihīno'pi bhaktyā saṃvatsareṇa tu ..
phalamargheṇa vai devi labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 41 ..
16.17.d:
दीक्षामंत्रविहीनोऽपि भक्त्या संवत्सरेण तु ..
फलमर्घेण वै देवि लभते नात्र संशयः .. 41 ..
16.17.m: Even one devoid of initiation and mantras, through devotion over the course of a year, / indeed obtains the fruit through this arghya, O goddess; of this there is no doubt.

16.17.s:
yaḥ punardīkṣito vidvānvidhinārghyaṃ nivedayet ..
nāsau saṃbhavate bhūmau pralayaṃ yāti bhāskare .. 42 ..
16.17.d:
यः पुनर्दीक्षितो विद्वान्विधिनार्घ्यं निवेदयेत् ..
नासौ संभवते भूमौ प्रलयं याति भास्करे .. 42 ..
16.17.m: Moreover, the wise man who is initiated and presents the arghya according to rule / is not reborn on earth; he merges into the Sun.

16.17.s:
iha janmani saubhāgyamāyurārogyasaṃpadam ..
acirāllabhate devi sabhāryaḥ sukhabhājanam .. 43 ..
16.17.d:
इह जन्मनि सौभाग्यमायुरारोग्यसंपदम् ..
अचिराल्लभते देवि सभार्यः सुखभाजनम् .. 43 ..
16.17.m: In this birth he quickly attains good fortune, long life, health, and wealth; / together with his wife, O goddess, he becomes a vessel of happiness.

16.17.s:
evaṃ snānavidhiḥ proktaḥ sauraḥ saṃkṣepatastava ..
hitāya mānavendrāṇāṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanaḥ .. 44 ..
16.17.d:
एवं स्नानविधिः प्रोक्तः सौरः संक्षेपतस्तव ..
हिताय मानवेन्द्राणां सर्वपापप्रणाशनः .. 44 ..
16.17.m: Thus the solar rule of ritual ablution has been declared to you in brief, / destructive of all sins, for the benefit of the best among men.

16.17.s:
athavā vedamārgeṇa kuryātsnānaṃ dvijottamaḥ ..
yadyevaṃ mantravistāre hyaśakto dīkṣayā vinā .. 45 ..
16.17.d:
अथवा वेदमार्गेण कुर्यात्स्नानं द्विजोत्तमः ..
यद्येवं मन्त्रविस्तारे ह्यशक्तो दीक्षया विना .. 45 ..
16.17.m: Alternatively, the best of twice-borns may perform the ritual ablution according to the Vedic path, / if he is indeed unable to engage in the detailed mantras without initiation.

16.17.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
atha pūjāvidhānaṃ te kathayāmi yaśasvini ..
vedamārgeṇa divyena brāhmaṇānāṃ hitāya vai .. 46 ..
16.17.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
अथ पूजाविधानं ते कथयामि यशस्विनि ..
वेदमार्गेण दिव्येन ब्राह्मणानां हिताय वै .. 46 ..
16.17.m: Īśvara said: / Now I shall tell you the rule of worship, O glorious one, / according to the divine Vedic path, truly for the benefit of the brahmins.

16.17.s:
evaṃ saṃbhṛtasaṃbhāraḥ puṣpādipraguṇīkṛtaḥ ..
tata āvāhayedbhānuṃ sthāpayetkarṇikopari .. 47 ..
16.17.d:
एवं संभृतसंभारः पुष्पादिप्रगुणीकृतः ..
तत आवाहयेद्भानुं स्थापयेत्कर्णिकोपरि .. 47 ..
16.17.m: Having thus assembled the materials and made ready the flowers and other offerings, / one should then invoke the sun and install him upon the pericarp.

16.17.s:
upasthānaṃ tu vai kṛtvā maṃtreṇānena suvrate ..
udutyaṃ jātavedasamiti maṃtraḥ saṃparikīrtitaḥ .. 48 ..
16.17.d:
उपस्थानं तु वै कृत्वा मंत्रेणानेन सुव्रते ..
उदुत्यं जातवेदसमिति मंत्रः संपरिकीर्तितः .. 48 ..
16.17.m: Performing the adoration with this mantra, O lady of auspicious vows— / 'ud u tyaṃ jātavedasam' is the mantra proclaimed.

16.17.s:
agniṃ dūteti maṃtreṇa anenāvāhya bhāmini ..
ākṛṣṇena rajasā maṃtreṇānena vā'rcayet .. 49 ..
16.17.d:
अग्निं दूतेति मंत्रेण अनेनावाह्य भामिनि ..
आकृष्णेन रजसा मंत्रेणानेन वाऽर्चयेत् .. 49 ..
16.17.m: Having invoked [him] with this mantra, 'agniṃ dūtam', O lovely lady, / or with this mantra, 'ā kṛṣṇena rajasā', one should worship [him].

16.17.s:
haṃsaḥ śuciṣaditi maṃtreṇānena pūjayet ..
apatyeteti mantreṇa sūryaṃ devi prapūjayet .. 7.1.17.50 ..
16.17.d:
हंसः शुचिषदिति मंत्रेणानेन पूजयेत् ..
अपत्येतेति मन्त्रेण सूर्यं देवि प्रपूजयेत् .. 7.1.17.50 ..
16.17.m: With this mantra, 'haṃsaḥ śuciṣat', one should worship; / with the mantra 'apatye taye', O goddess, one should worship the sun.

16.17.s:
adṛśramasya caitena sūryaṃ devi samarccayet ..
taraṇirviśvadarśeti anena satataṃ japam .. 51 ..
16.17.d:
अदृश्रमस्य चैतेन सूर्यं देवि समर्च्चयेत् ..
तरणिर्विश्वदर्शेति अनेन सततं जपम् .. 51 ..
16.17.m: And with this [mantra], 'adṛśram asya', O goddess, one should worship the sun. / One should constantly chant with 'taraṇir viśvadarśataḥ'.

16.17.s:
citraṃ devānāmudeti bhadrāṃ devo sadārcayet ..
vibhūtimarccayennityaṃ yenā pāvaka cakṣasā .. 52 ..
16.17.d:
चित्रं देवानामुदेति भद्रां देवो सदार्चयेत् ..
विभूतिमर्च्चयेन्नित्यं येना पावक चक्षसा .. 52 ..
16.17.m: With 'citraṃ devānām udagāt', one should always worship the auspicious god; / one should daily worship Vibhūti with 'yena pāvaka cakṣasā'.

16.17.s:
vidyāmepirajaspṛthvityanena vimalāṃ sadā ..
amoghāṃ pūjayennityaṃ maṃtreṇānena suvrate.. 53 ..
16.17.d:
विद्यामेपिरजस्पृथ्वित्यनेन विमलां सदा ..
अमोघां पूजयेन्नित्यं मंत्रेणानेन सुव्रते.. 53 ..
16.17.m: One should always [worship] Vimalā with 'vidyām eṣi rajas pṛthu'; / one should daily worship Amoghā with this mantra, O lady of auspicious vows.

16.17.s:
sapta tvā harito'nena siddhidāṃ sarvakarmasu ..
vidyutāmarcayeddevaṃ sapta tvā haritena ca .. 54 ..
16.17.d:
सप्त त्वा हरितोऽनेन सिद्धिदां सर्वकर्मसु ..
विद्युतामर्चयेद्देवं सप्त त्वा हरितेन च .. 54 ..
16.17.m: With 'sapta tvā haritaḥ', [one should worship] the bestower of success in all undertakings; / and one should worship the god Vidyut with 'sapta tvā haritaḥ'.

16.17.s:
navamīṃ pūjayeddevīṃ satataṃ sarvatomukhīm ..
mantreṇānena vai devi udvayantamitīha vai .. 55 ..
16.17.d:
नवमीं पूजयेद्देवीं सततं सर्वतोमुखीम् ..
मन्त्रेणानेन वै देवि उद्वयन्तमितीह वै .. 55 ..
16.17.m: One should constantly worship the ninth goddess, Sarvatomukhī, / indeed with this mantra here, O goddess: 'ud vayaṃ tamasaḥ'.

16.17.s:
udyannadya mitramahaḥ prathamamakṣaraṃ japet ..
dvitīyaṃ pūjayeddevi śukeṣu me harimeti vai .. 56 ..
16.17.d:
उद्यन्नद्य मित्रमहः प्रथममक्षरं जपेत् ..
द्वितीयं पूजयेद्देवि शुकेषु मे हरिमेति वै .. 56 ..
16.17.m: With 'udyann adya mitramahaḥ', one should mutter the first syllable. / With 'śukeṣu me harimāṇam', O goddess, one should worship the second.

16.17.s:
udagādayamādityo hyanenāpi tṛtīyakam ..
tatsaviturvareṇyeti caturthaṃ parikīrtitam .. 57 ..
16.17.d:
उदगादयमादित्यो ह्यनेनापि तृतीयकम् ..
तत्सवितुर्वरेण्येति चतुर्थं परिकीर्तितम् .. 57 ..
16.17.m: With 'ud agād ayam ādityaḥ', the third is also [worshipped]. / With 'tat savitur vareṇyam', the fourth is proclaimed.

16.17.s:
mahāhivo mahāyeti pañcamaṃ parikīrtitam ..
hiraṇyagarbhaḥ samavartata ṣaṣṭhaṃ bījaṃ prakīrtitam .. 58 ..
16.17.d:
महाहिवो महायेति पञ्चमं परिकीर्तितम् ..
हिरण्यगर्भः समवर्तत षष्ठं बीजं प्रकीर्तितम् .. 58 ..
16.17.m: 'mahāñ hi vaḥ' is proclaimed as the fifth. / 'hiraṇyagarbhaḥ samavartata' is proclaimed as the sixth seed-syllable.

16.17.s:
savitā paścātātsavitā saptamaṃ varavarṇini ..
evaṃ bījāni vinyasya ādityaṃ sthāpayecchubhe .. 59 ..
16.17.d:
सविता पश्चातात्सविता सप्तमं वरवर्णिनि ..
एवं बीजानि विन्यस्य आदित्यं स्थापयेच्छुभे .. 59 ..
16.17.m: 'savitā paścātāt savitā' is the seventh, O lady of fair complexion. / Having thus installed the seed-syllables, one should establish the sun, O auspicious one.

16.17.s: ādityaṃ sthāpayitvā tu paścādaṅgāni vinyaset .. 7.1.17.60 ..
16.17.d: आदित्यं स्थापयित्वा तु पश्चादङ्गानि विन्यसेत् .. 7.1.17.60 ..
16.17.m: Having installed the sun, one should then install the limbs.

16.17.s:
āgneyyāṃ hṛdayaṃ nyasya aiśānyāṃ tu śiro nyaset ..
nairṛtyāṃ tu śikhāṃ caiva kavacaṃ vāyugocare .. 61 ..
16.17.d:
आग्नेय्यां हृदयं न्यस्य ऐशान्यां तु शिरो न्यसेत् ..
नैरृत्यां तु शिखां चैव कवचं वायुगोचरे .. 61 ..
16.17.m: Placing the heart in the south-east, one should place the head in the north-east, / the topknot in the south-west, and the armor in the region of Vāyu (north-west).

16.17.s:
astraṃ diśāsu vinyasya svabījena tu karṇikām ..
amosi prāṇiteneti anena hṛdayaṃ yajet .. 62 ..
16.17.d:
अस्त्रं दिशासु विन्यस्य स्वबीजेन तु कर्णिकाम् ..
अमोसि प्राणितेनेति अनेन हृदयं यजेत् .. 62 ..
16.17.m: Having placed the weapon in the [cardinal] directions, and the pericarp with its own seed-syllable, / one should worship the heart with this [mantra]: 'amo 'si prāṇite na'.

16.17.s:
śirastu pūjayeddevi āyuṣyaṃ varcaseti vai ..
gāyatryā tu śikhāṃ pūjya nairṛtyāṃ tu vyavasthitām .. 63 ..
16.17.d:
शिरस्तु पूजयेद्देवि आयुष्यं वर्चसेति वै ..
गायत्र्या तु शिखां पूज्य नैरृत्यां तु व्यवस्थिताम् .. 63 ..
16.17.m: One should worship the head, O goddess, with 'āyuṣyaṃ varcasyam'; / and having worshipped the topknot with the Gāyatrī, situated in the south-west,

16.17.s:
jīmūtasyeva bhavati pratyekaṃ kavacaṃ yajet ..
dhanvannāgā dhanvaneti anenāstraṃ sadā'rcayet .. 64 ..
16.17.d:
जीमूतस्येव भवति प्रत्येकं कवचं यजेत् ..
धन्वन्नागा धन्वनेति अनेनास्त्रं सदाऽर्चयेत् .. 64 ..
16.17.m: one should worship the armor separately with 'jīmūtasyeva bhavati'; / one should always worship the weapon with 'dhanvanā gā dhanvanā'.

16.17.s:
netraṃ tu pūjayeddevi aśvinā tejaseti ca ..
hyataḥ pūrvataḥ somaṃ dakṣiṇena budhaṃ tathā .. 65 ..
16.17.d:
नेत्रं तु पूजयेद्देवि अश्विना तेजसेति च ..
ह्यतः पूर्वतः सोमं दक्षिणेन बुधं तथा .. 65 ..
16.17.m: And one should worship the eye, O goddess, with 'aśvinā tejasā'. / Then on the east Soma, and on the south Budha;

16.17.s:
paścimena guruṃ nyasya uttareṇa ca bhārgavam ..
āgneyyāṃ maṅgalaṃ nyasya nairṛtyāṃ tu śanaiścaram .. 66 ..
16.17.d:
पश्चिमेन गुरुं न्यस्य उत्तरेण च भार्गवम् ..
आग्नेय्यां मङ्गलं न्यस्य नैरृत्यां तु शनैश्चरम् .. 66 ..
16.17.m: having placed Guru on the west and Bhārgava on the north; / having placed Maṅgala in the south-east and Śanaiścara in the south-west;

16.17.s:
vāyavyāṃ tu nyasedrāhuṃ ketumīśānagocare ..
āpyāyasveti mantreṇa devi somaṃ sadārcayet .. 67 ..
16.17.d:
वायव्यां तु न्यसेद्राहुं केतुमीशानगोचरे ..
आप्यायस्वेति मन्त्रेण देवि सोमं सदार्चयेत् .. 67 ..
16.17.m: one should place Rāhu in the north-west and Ketu in the region of Īśāna (north-east). / One should constantly worship Soma, O goddess, with the mantra 'āpyāyasva'.

16.17.s:
udbudhyadhvaṃ mahādevi budhaṃ tatra sadārcayet ..
bṛhaspateti mantreṇa pūjayetsatataṃ gurum .. 68 ..
16.17.d:
उद्बुध्यध्वं महादेवि बुधं तत्र सदार्चयेत् ..
बृहस्पतेति मन्त्रेण पूजयेत्सततं गुरुम् .. 68 ..
16.17.m: There one should constantly worship Budha with 'ud budhyadhvam', O great goddess; / one should constantly worship Guru with the mantra 'bṛhaspate'.

16.17.s:
śukraḥ śuśukvāniti ca bhārgavaṃ devi pūjayet ..
agnirmūrddheti mantreṇa sadā maṃgalamarcayet .. 69 ..
16.17.d:
शुक्रः शुशुक्वानिति च भार्गवं देवि पूजयेत् ..
अग्निर्मूर्द्धेति मन्त्रेण सदा मंगलमर्चयेत् .. 69 ..
16.17.m: And one should worship Bhārgava, O goddess, with 'śukraḥ śuśukvān'; / one should always worship Maṅgala with the mantra 'agnir mūrdhā'.

16.17.s:
śamagniritimantreṇa pūjayedbhāskarātmajam ..
kayānaścitretimantreṇa devi rāhuṃ sadā'rcayet .. 7.1.17.70 ..
16.17.d:
शमग्निरितिमन्त्रेण पूजयेद्भास्करात्मजम् ..
कयानश्चित्रेतिमन्त्रेण देवि राहुं सदाऽर्चयेत् .. 7.1.17.70 ..
16.17.m: One should worship the son of the Sun with the mantra 'śaṃ agniḥ'; / one should always worship Rāhu, O goddess, with the mantra 'kayā naś citraḥ'.

16.17.s:
ketuṃ kṛṇveti ketuṃ vai satataṃ pūjayedbudhaḥ ..
bāhyataḥ pūrvataḥ śukraṃ dakṣiṇena yamaṃ tathā .. 71 ..
16.17.d:
केतुं कृण्वेति केतुं वै सततं पूजयेद्बुधः ..
बाह्यतः पूर्वतः शुक्रं दक्षिणेन यमं तथा .. 71 ..
16.17.m: The wise man should constantly worship Ketu indeed with 'ketuṃ kṛṇvan'. / On the outside, Śukra in the east, and Yama in the south;

16.17.s:
aiśānyāmīśvaraṃ viṃdyādāgneyyāmagnirucyate ..
naiṛteti virūpākṣaṃ pavanaṃ vāyugocare .. 72 ..
16.17.d:
ऐशान्यामीश्वरं विंद्यादाग्नेय्यामग्निरुच्यते ..
नैऋतेति विरूपाक्षं पवनं वायुगोचरे .. 72 ..
16.17.m: one should recognize Īśvara in the north-east, and Agni is spoken of in the south-east; / Virūpākṣa in the south-west, and Pavana in the region of Vāyu (north-west).

16.17.s:
tamuṣṭavāma iti vai hyanenendramathārcayet ..
udīratāmavareti sadā vaivasvataṃ yajet .. 73 ..
16.17.d:
तमुष्टवाम इति वै ह्यनेनेन्द्रमथार्चयेत् ..
उदीरतामवरेति सदा वैवस्वतं यजेत् .. 73 ..
16.17.m: Then one should worship Indra with this: 'tam u ṣṭavāma'; / one should always worship Vaivasvata with 'udīratām avarāḥ'.

16.17.s:
tattvāyāmīti mantreṇa varuṇaṃ devi pūjayet ..
indrāsomāvata iti mantreṇa dhanadaṃ yajet .. 74 ..
16.17.d:
तत्त्वायामीति मन्त्रेण वरुणं देवि पूजयेत् ..
इन्द्रासोमावत इति मन्त्रेण धनदं यजेत् .. 74 ..
16.17.m: One should worship Varuṇa, O goddess, with the mantra 'tat tvā yāmi'; / one should worship the Bestower of Wealth with the mantra 'indrāsomāvatam'.

16.17.s:
pāvakaṃ pūjayeddevi agnimīḻe purohitam ..
rakṣohaṇaṃ vājineti virūpākṣaṃ sadārcayet .. 75 ..
16.17.d:
पावकं पूजयेद्देवि अग्निमीḻए पुरोहितम् ..
रक्षोहणं वाजिनेति विरूपाक्षं सदार्चयेत् .. 75 ..
16.17.m: One should worship Pāvaka, O goddess, with 'agnim īḷe purohitam'; / one should always worship Virūpākṣa with 'rakṣohaṇaṃ vājinam'.

16.17.s:
vāyavāyāhi mantreṇa vāyuṃ devi sadārcayet ..
yathākramamimāndevi sarvānvai pūjayedbudhaḥ .. 76 ..
16.17.d:
वायवायाहि मन्त्रेण वायुं देवि सदार्चयेत् ..
यथाक्रममिमान्देवि सर्वान्वै पूजयेद्बुधः .. 76 ..
16.17.m: One should always worship Vāyu, O goddess, with the mantra 'vāyav ā yāhi'. / The wise man should worship all these in due order, O goddess:

16.17.s:
bāhyataḥ pūrvato devi indrādīnāṃ samantataḥ ..
raktavarṇaṃ mahātejaṃ sitapadmopari sthitam .. 77 ..
16.17.d:
बाह्यतः पूर्वतो देवि इन्द्रादीनां समन्ततः ..
रक्तवर्णं महातेजं सितपद्मोपरि स्थितम् .. 77 ..
16.17.m: on the outside, on all sides beginning with Indra in the east, O goddess. / [Him who is] red in color, of great splendor, seated upon a white lotus,

16.17.s:
sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyuktaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam ..
dvibhujaṃ caikavaktraṃ ca saumyapañcakadhṛkkaram .. 78 ..
16.17.d:
सर्वलक्षणसंयुक्तं सर्वाभरणभूषितम् ..
द्विभुजं चैकवक्त्रं च सौम्यपञ्चकधृक्करम् .. 78 ..
16.17.m: endowed with all auspicious marks, adorned with all ornaments, / having two arms and one face, his hands holding five gentle [objects],

16.17.s:
varttulaṃ tejabiṃbaṃ tu madhyasthaṃ raktavāsasam ..
ādityasya tvidaṃ rūpaṃ sarvalokeṣu pūjitam ..
dhyātvā saṃpūjayennityaṃ sthaṃḍilaṃ maṇḍalāśrayam .. 79 ..
16.17.d:
वर्त्तुलं तेजबिंबं तु मध्यस्थं रक्तवाससम् ..
आदित्यस्य त्विदं रूपं सर्वलोकेषु पूजितम् ..
ध्यात्वा संपूजयेन्नित्यं स्थंडिलं मण्डलाश्रयम् .. 79 ..
16.17.m: standing in the center of a circular orb of light, wearing red garments— / having meditated upon this form of the sun, worshipped in all worlds, / one should daily venerate the raised altar situated in the maṇḍala.

16.17.s:
.. devyuvāca .. ..
maṇḍalasthaḥ suraśreṣṭha vidhinā yena bhāskaraḥ ..
pūjyate mānavairbhaktyā sa vidhiḥ kathitastvayā .. 7.1.17.80 ..
16.17.d:
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
मण्डलस्थः सुरश्रेष्ठ विधिना येन भास्करः ..
