पूज्यते मानवैर्भक्त्या स विधिः कथितस्त्वया .. 7.1.17.80 ..
16.17.m: The Goddess said: / The procedure by which the Sun residing in the maṇḍala is worshipped with devotion / by mortals, O best of the gods, has been declared by you.

16.17.s:
pūjayedvidhinā yena bhāskaraṃ padmasaṃbhavam ..
mūrttisthaṃ sarvagaṃ devaṃ tanme kathaya śaṃkara .. 81 .. ..
16.17.d:
पूजयेद्विधिना येन भास्करं पद्मसंभवम् ..
मूर्त्तिस्थं सर्वगं देवं तन्मे कथय शंकर .. 81 .. ..
16.17.m: Tell me, O Śaṃkara, the rite by which one should worship the Sun-god, born of the lotus, / the all-pervading god residing in an image.

16.17.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
sādhusādhu mahādevi sādhu pṛṣṭo'smi suvate ..
śṛṇuṣvaikamanā devi mūrtithaṃ yena pūjayet .. 82 ..
16.17.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
साधुसाधु महादेवि साधु पृष्टोऽस्मि सुवते ..
शृणुष्वैकमना देवि मूर्तिथं येन पूजयेत् .. 82 ..
16.17.m: Īśvara said: / Excellent, excellent, O great goddess! Well have I been asked, O virtuous lady. / Listen with a focused mind, O goddess, [to the rite] by which one should worship him residing in an image.

16.17.s:
iṣetveti ca mantreṇa uttamāṃgaṃ sadārcayet ..
agnimīḻeti mantreṇa pūjayeddakṣiṇaṃ karam .. 83 ..
16.17.d:
इषेत्वेति च मन्त्रेण उत्तमांगं सदार्चयेत् ..
अग्निमीḻएति मन्त्रेण पूजयेद्दक्षिणं करम् .. 83 ..
16.17.m: With the mantra 'iṣe tvā', one should always worship the head. / With the mantra 'agnim īḷe', one should worship the right hand.

16.17.s:
agna āyāhi mantreṇa pādau devasya pūjayet ..
ājighreti ca mantreṇa pūjayetpuṣpamālayā .. 84 ..
16.17.d:
अग्न आयाहि मन्त्रेण पादौ देवस्य पूजयेत् ..
आजिघ्रेति च मन्त्रेण पूजयेत्पुष्पमालया .. 84 ..
16.17.m: With the mantra 'agna ā yāhi', one should worship the two feet of the god. / With the mantra 'ājighra', one should worship [him] with a flower garland.

16.17.s:
yogeyogeti mantreṇa muktapuṣpāṃjaliṃ kṣipet ..
samudrāgaccha yatproktamanena snāpayedravim .. 85 ..
16.17.d:
योगेयोगेति मन्त्रेण मुक्तपुष्पांजलिं क्षिपेत् ..
समुद्रागच्छ यत्प्रोक्तमनेन स्नापयेद्रविम् .. 85 ..
16.17.m: With the mantra 'yoge-yoge', one should throw an open handful of flowers. / With that which is stated as 'samudrād āgaccha', one should bathe the Sun.

16.17.s:
imaṃ me gaṃgeti yatproktamanenāpi ca bhāmini ..
samudrajyeti mantreṇa kṣālayedvidhivadravim .. 86 ..
16.17.d:
इमं मे गंगेति यत्प्रोक्तमनेनापि च भामिनि ..
समुद्रज्येति मन्त्रेण क्षालयेद्विधिवद्रविम् .. 86 ..
16.17.m: With that which is declared as 'imaṃ me gaṅge', O beautiful lady, / and with the mantra 'samudrajyāḥ', one should wash the Sun according to the rule.

16.17.s:
sinīvālīti mantreṇa snāpayecchaṃkhavāriṇā ..
yajñaṃ yajñeti mantreṇa kaṣāyaiḥ parirakṣayet .. 87 ..
16.17.d:
सिनीवालीति मन्त्रेण स्नापयेच्छंखवारिणा ..
यज्ञं यज्ञेति मन्त्रेण कषायैः परिरक्षयेत् .. 87 ..
16.17.m: With the mantra 'sinīvālī', one should bathe him with conch-water. / With the mantra 'yajñaṃ yajñena', one should protect him with astringent decoctions.

16.17.s:
snāpayetpayasā devi āpyāyasveti maṃtrataḥ ..
dadhikrāvṇeti vai dadhnā snāpayedvidhivadravim .. 88 ..
16.17.d:
स्नापयेत्पयसा देवि आप्यायस्वेति मंत्रतः ..
दधिक्राव्णेति वै दध्ना स्नापयेद्विधिवद्रविम् .. 88 ..
16.17.m: One should bathe him with milk, O goddess, using the mantra 'āpyāyasva'. / With the mantra 'dadhikrāvṇaḥ', one should bathe the Sun with curd according to rule.

16.17.s:
imaṃ me gaṃgeti yatproktamanenāpi ca bhāmini ..
samudrajyeti maṃtreṇa snānamauṣadhibhiḥ smṛtam .. 89 ..
16.17.d:
इमं मे गंगेति यत्प्रोक्तमनेनापि च भामिनि ..
समुद्रज्येति मंत्रेण स्नानमौषधिभिः स्मृतम् .. 89 ..
16.17.m: With that which is proclaimed as 'imaṃ me gaṅge', and with the mantra 'samudrajyāḥ', / O passionate woman, bathing with medicinal herbs is traditionally taught.

16.17.s:
udvartayettato bhānuṃ dvipadābhirvarānane ..
mānastoketi maṃtreṇa yugapatsnānamācaret .. 7.1.17.90 ..
16.17.d:
उद्वर्तयेत्ततो भानुं द्विपदाभिर्वरानने ..
मानस्तोकेति मंत्रेण युगपत्स्नानमाचरेत् .. 7.1.17.90 ..
16.17.m: Then one should rub the Sun with the dvipadā verses, O fair-faced lady. / With the mantra 'mā nastoke', one should perform a simultaneous bath.

16.17.s:
viṣṇorarāṭamantreṇa snāpayedgaṃdhavāriṇā ..
sauvarṇena tu maṃtreṇa arghyaṃ pādyaṃ nivedayet .. 91 ..
16.17.d:
विष्णोरराटमन्त्रेण स्नापयेद्गंधवारिणा ..
सौवर्णेन तु मंत्रेण अर्घ्यं पाद्यं निवेदयेत् .. 91 ..
16.17.m: With the mantra 'viṣṇor rarāṭam', one should bathe him with fragrant water. / With the mantra 'sauvarṇam', one should offer water for the arghya and pādya.

16.17.s:
idaṃ viṣṇurvicakrame maṃtreṇārghyaṃ pradāpayet ..
vedosīti ca maṃtreṇa upavītaṃ pradāpayet .. 92 ..
16.17.d:
इदं विष्णुर्विचक्रमे मंत्रेणार्घ्यं प्रदापयेत् ..
वेदोसीति च मंत्रेण उपवीतं प्रदापयेत् .. 92 ..
16.17.m: With the mantra 'idaṃ viṣṇur vicakrame', one should offer the arghya. / With the mantra 'vedo'si', one should present the sacred thread.

16.17.s:
bṛhaspateti maṃtreṇa dadyādvastrāṇi bhānave ..
yena śriyaṃ prakurvāṇaḥ puṣpamālāṃ prapūjayet .. 93 ..
16.17.d:
बृहस्पतेति मंत्रेण दद्याद्वस्त्राणि भानवे ..
येन श्रियं प्रकुर्वाणः पुष्पमालां प्रपूजयेत् .. 93 ..
16.17.m: With the mantra 'bṛhaspate', one should give garments to the Sun. / With 'yena śriyam prakurvāṇaḥ', one should worship him with a flower garland.

16.17.s:
dhūrasīti ca maṃtreṇa dhūpaṃ dadyātsaguggalam ..
samiddhoṃjanamaṃtreṇa aṃjanaṃ tu pradāpayet .. 94 ..
16.17.d:
धूरसीति च मंत्रेण धूपं दद्यात्सगुग्गलम् ..
समिद्धोंजनमंत्रेण अंजनं तु प्रदापयेत् .. 94 ..
16.17.m: With the mantra 'dhūr asi', one should offer incense accompanied with bdellium. / With the mantra 'samiddho'ñjana', one should apply collyrium.

16.17.s:
yuṃjāna iti maṃtreṇa bhānuṃ rocanamālabhet ..
ārārttikaṃ ca vai kuryāddīrghāyutvāya vai punaḥ .. 95 ..
16.17.d:
युंजान इति मंत्रेण भानुं रोचनमालभेत् ..
आरार्त्तिकं च वै कुर्याद्दीर्घायुत्वाय वै पुनः .. 95 ..
16.17.m: With the mantra 'yuñjānaḥ', one should smear the Sun with yellow orpiment. / And one should perform the waving of lamps for the sake of long life.

16.17.s:
sahasraśīrṣā puruṣaḥ sūryaṃ śirasi pūjayet ..
śaṃbhavāyeti maṃtreṇa ravernetre parāmṛśet .. 96 ..
16.17.d:
सहस्रशीर्षा पुरुषः सूर्यं शिरसि पूजयेत् ..
शंभवायेति मंत्रेण रवेर्नेत्रे परामृशेत् .. 96 ..
16.17.m: With 'sahasraśīrṣā puruṣaḥ', one should worship the Sun on the head. / With the mantra 'śaṃbhavāya', one should touch the two eyes of the Sun.

16.17.s:
viśvataścakṣurityevaṃ bhānordehaṃ samālabhet ..
śrīśca te lakṣmīśceti sarvāṃge pūjayedravim .. 97 ..
16.17.d:
विश्वतश्चक्षुरित्येवं भानोर्देहं समालभेत् ..
श्रीश्च ते लक्ष्मीश्चेति सर्वांगे पूजयेद्रविम् .. 97 ..
16.17.m: With 'viśvataścakṣuḥ', one should touch the body of the Sun. / With 'śrīś ca te lakṣmīś ca', one should worship the Sun on all his limbs.

16.17.s:
.. īśvara uvāca . ..
atha merormahādevi aṣṭaśṛṃgasya suvrate ..
pūjāvidhānamaṃtrāṃste kathayāmi samāsataḥ ..98..
16.17.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच . ..
अथ मेरोर्महादेवि अष्टशृंगस्य सुव्रते ..
पूजाविधानमंत्रांस्ते कथयामि समासतः ..98..
16.17.m: Īśvara said: / Now, O great goddess, O virtuous lady, I shall tell you in brief / the rites and mantras for the worship of the eight-peaked Meru.

16.17.s:
aṣṭaśṛṃgaṃ mahādevi anena vidhinā'rcayet ..
prathamaṃ pūjayenmadhye maṃtreṇānena suvrate .. 99 ..
16.17.d:
अष्टशृंगं महादेवि अनेन विधिनाऽर्चयेत् ..
प्रथमं पूजयेन्मध्ये मंत्रेणानेन सुव्रते .. 99 ..
16.17.m: One should worship the eight peaks, O great goddess, by this rule: / First, one should worship in the center with this mantra, O virtuous lady:

16.17.s:
mahāhivomahāyeti nānāpuṣpakadaṃbakaiḥ ..
trātāramiṃdramaṃtreṇa pūrvaśṛṃgaṃ sadārcayet .. 7.1.17.100 ..
16.17.d:
महाहिवोमहायेति नानापुष्पकदंबकैः ..
त्रातारमिंद्रमंत्रेण पूर्वशृंगं सदार्चयेत् .. 7.1.17.100 ..
16.17.m: With 'mahāhi vo mahāya', [one should worship] with clusters of various flowers. / With the mantra 'trātāram indram', one should always worship the eastern peak.

16.17.s:
tamuṣṭavāmeti maṃtreṇa pūjayetsurasundari ..
agnimīḻe purohitamāgneyaṃ śṛṃgamarcayet .. 101 ..
16.17.d:
तमुष्टवामेति मंत्रेण पूजयेत्सुरसुन्दरि ..
अग्निमीḻए पुरोहितमाग्नेयं शृंगमर्चयेत् .. 101 ..
16.17.m: With the mantra 'tam uṣṭavāma', O celestial beauty, / [or] with 'agnim īḷe purohitam', one should worship the southeastern peak.

16.17.s:
āgneyyā caiva gāyatryā athavānena pūjayet ..
yamāya tvā makhāya tvā dakṣiṇaṃ śṛṃgamarca yet ..102..
16.17.d:
आग्नेय्या चैव गायत्र्या अथवानेन पूजयेत् ..
यमाय त्वा मखाय त्वा दक्षिणं शृंगमर्च येत् ..102..
16.17.m: And with the Gāyatrī addressed to Agni, or one should worship with this: / 'yamāya tvā makhāya tvā', one should worship the southern peak.

16.17.s:
udīratāmavarepyathavānena pūjayet ..
āyaṃ gauriti maṃtreṇa nairṛtyaṃ śṛṅgamarcayet..103..
16.17.d:
उदीरतामवरेप्यथवानेन पूजयेत् ..
आयं गौरिति मंत्रेण नैरृत्यं शृङ्गमर्चयेत्..103..
16.17.m: Or one should worship with this: 'udīratām avare'. / With the mantra 'āyaṃ gauḥ', one should worship the southwestern peak.

16.17.s:
rakṣohaṇaṃ vājinaṃ vā pūjayedasurāṃtikam..
iṃdrāsomā ca yo maṃtro hyathavā tena pūjayet .. 104 ..
16.17.d:
रक्षोहणं वाजिनं वा पूजयेदसुरांतिकम्..
इंद्रासोमा च यो मंत्रो ह्यथवा तेन पूजयेत् .. 104 ..
16.17.m: One should worship the [quarter] near the asuras with 'rakṣohaṇaṃ vājinam', / or one should worship with the mantra that is 'indrāsomā'.

16.17.s:
abhi tvā sūra nonviti caiśānaṃ śṛṃgamarcayet ..
yenedaṃ bhūtamiti vā athavānena pūjayet .. 105 ..
16.17.d:
अभि त्वा सूर नोन्विति चैशानं शृंगमर्चयेत् ..
येनेदं भूतमिति वा अथवानेन पूजयेत् .. 105 ..
16.17.m: With 'abhi tvā sūra nonumaḥ', one should worship the northeastern peak; / or with 'yenedam bhūtam', one may worship with that.

16.17.s:
namostu sarpebhya iti merupīṭhaṃ sadā'rcayet ..
hiraṇyagarbhaḥ samavarttateti punarmadhye sadārcayet .. 106 ..
16.17.d:
नमोस्तु सर्पेभ्य इति मेरुपीठं सदाऽर्चयेत् ..
हिरण्यगर्भः समवर्त्ततेति पुनर्मध्ये सदार्चयेत् .. 106 ..
16.17.m: With 'namo 'stu sarpebhyaḥ', one should always worship the Meru pedestal. / With 'hiraṇyagarbhaḥ samavartata', one should worship again in the center.

16.17.s:
savitā paścātāditi vai pūjayetpuṣpa mālayā ..
trikālamarcayeddevi pradadyādarghyamādarāt ..107..
16.17.d:
सविता पश्चातादिति वै पूजयेत्पुष्प मालया ..
त्रिकालमर्चयेद्देवि प्रदद्यादर्घ्यमादरात् ..107..
16.17.m: With 'savitā paścātāt', one should worship with a flower garland. / One should worship at the three junctures of the day, O goddess, offering arghya with reverence.

16.17.s:
mātā rudrāṇāṃ duhitā vasūnāṃ pūrvāhne caiva pūjayet ..
madhyāhne pūjayeddevi tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam .. 108 ..
16.17.d:
माता रुद्राणां दुहिता वसूनां पूर्वाह्ने चैव पूजयेत् ..
मध्याह्ने पूजयेद्देवि तद्विष्णोः परमं पदम् .. 108 ..
16.17.m: One should worship in the morning with 'mātā rudrāṇāṃ duhitā vasūnām'. / In the midday, O goddess, one should worship with 'tad viṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam'.

16.17.s:
ham̐saḥ śuciṣaditi vā aparāhṇe sadārcayet ..
evaṃ bhānuṃ grahaiḥ sārddha pūjayedvaravarṇini .. 109 ..
16.17.d:
हम्̐सः शुचिषदिति वा अपराह्णे सदार्चयेत् ..
एवं भानुं ग्रहैः सार्द्ध पूजयेद्वरवर्णिनि .. 109 ..
16.17.m: Or in the afternoon one should always worship with 'haṃsaḥ śuciṣat'. / Thus one should worship the Sun together with the planets, O woman of excellent complexion.

16.17.s:
.. devyuvāca .. ..
yāni puṣpāṇi ceṣṭāni sadā bhāskarapūjane ..
kāni coktāni deveśa kathayasva prasādataḥ .. 7.1.17.110 ..
16.17.d:
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
यानि पुष्पाणि चेष्टानि सदा भास्करपूजने ..
कानि चोक्तानि देवेश कथयस्व प्रसादतः .. 7.1.17.110 ..
16.17.m: The goddess said: / Which flowers are beloved always in the worship of the Sun, / and which have been spoken of, O lord of gods? Tell me out of your grace.

16.17.s:
īśvara uvāca .. ..
śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi puṣpā dhyāyamanuttamam ..
yena cārkasthale devi śīghraṃ tuṣyati pūjitaḥ .. 111 ..
16.17.d:
ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
शृणु देवि प्रवक्ष्यामि पुष्पा ध्यायमनुत्तमम् ..
येन चार्कस्थले देवि शीघ्रं तुष्यति पूजितः .. 111 ..
16.17.m: Īśvara said: / Listen, O goddess, I shall speak of the supreme chapter on flowers, / by which, when worshipped at the place of the Sun, O goddess, he is quickly pleased.

16.17.s:
mālatīkusumaiḥ pūjā bhavetsāṃnidhyakārikā ..
mallikāyāśca kusumairbhogavāñjāyate naraḥ .. 112 ..
16.17.d:
मालतीकुसुमैः पूजा भवेत्सांनिध्यकारिका ..
मल्लिकायाश्च कुसुमैर्भोगवाञ्जायते नरः .. 112 ..
16.17.m: Worship with mālatī flowers brings about his presence. / And by means of mallikā flowers, a man comes to enjoy pleasures.

16.17.s:
saubhāgyaṃ puṃḍarīkaistu bhavatyarthaśca śāśvataḥ ..
kadaṃbapuṣpairdeveśi paramaiśvaryamaśnute .. 113 ..
16.17.d:
सौभाग्यं पुंडरीकैस्तु भवत्यर्थश्च शाश्वतः ..
कदंबपुष्पैर्देवेशि परमैश्वर्यमश्नुते .. 113 ..
16.17.m: With white lotuses comes good fortune and enduring wealth. / With kadamba flowers, O ruler of gods, one enjoys supreme sovereignty.

16.17.s:
bhavatyakṣayamannaṃ ca bakulai rarcane raveḥ ..
maṃdārapuṣpakaiḥ pūjā sarvakuṣṭhavināśinī .. 114 ..
16.17.d:
भवत्यक्षयमन्नं च बकुलै रर्चने रवेः ..
मंदारपुष्पकैः पूजा सर्वकुष्ठविनाशिनी .. 114 ..
16.17.m: Food becomes inexhaustible through the worship of the Sun with bakula flowers. / Worship with mandāra flowers destroys all leprosy.

16.17.s:
bilvasya patrakusumaimahatīṃ śriyamaśnute ..
arkasrajā bhavatyarthaḥ sarvakāmaphalapradaḥ .. .. 115 ..
16.17.d:
बिल्वस्य पत्रकुसुमैमहतीं श्रियमश्नुते ..
अर्कस्रजा भवत्यर्थः सर्वकामफलप्रदः .. .. 115 ..
16.17.m: With the leaves and flowers of the bilva tree, one enjoys great prosperity. / A garland of arka flowers yields wealth that grants the fruits of all desires.

16.17.s:
pradadyādrūpiṇīṃ kanyāṃ pūjito bakulasrajā ..
kiṃśukairarcito devi na pīḍayati bhāskaraḥ ..116..
16.17.d:
प्रदद्याद्रूपिणीं कन्यां पूजितो बकुलस्रजा ..
किंशुकैरर्चितो देवि न पीडयति भास्करः ..116..
16.17.m: When worshipped with a garland of bakula flowers, he will bestow a shapely maiden. / When worshipped with kiṃśuka flowers, O goddess, the Sun causes no affliction.

16.17.s:
agastikusumaistadvadānukūlyaṃ prayaccha ti ..
karavīraistu deveśi sūryasyānucaro bhavet .. 117 ..
16.17.d:
अगस्तिकुसुमैस्तद्वदानुकूल्यं प्रयच्छ ति ..
करवीरैस्तु देवेशि सूर्यस्यानुचरो भवेत् .. 117 ..
16.17.m: Likewise, with agasti flowers, he grants favor. / And with oleanders, O ruler of gods, one becomes an attendant of the Sun.

16.17.s:
śatapatrasrajā devi sūryasālokyatāṃ vrajet ..
bakapuṣpairmahādevi dāridyaṃ naiva jāyate ..119..
ṛtukusumena gandhena samabhyarcya divākaram ..
catuḥsamudramaryādāṃ sa bhuṃkte pṛthivīmimām .. 119 ..
16.17.d:
शतपत्रस्रजा देवि सूर्यसालोक्यतां व्रजेत् ..
बकपुष्पैर्महादेवि दारिद्यं नैव जायते ..119..
ऋतुकुसुमेन गन्धेन समभ्यर्च्य दिवाकरम् ..
चतुःसमुद्रमर्यादां स भुंक्ते पृथिवीमिमाम् .. 119 ..
16.17.m:
With a garland of hundred-petaled lotuses, O goddess, one goes to the world of the Sun. / With baka flowers, O great goddess, poverty does not arise at all.
Having worshipped the day-maker with seasonal flowers and perfume, / he enjoys this earth bounded by the four oceans.

16.17.s:
yaḥ sūryāyatanaṃ bhaktyā gairikeṇopalepayet ..
prāpnuyānmahatīṃ lakṣmīṃ rogaiścāpi pramucyate .. 7.1.17.120 ..
16.17.d:
यः सूर्यायतनं भक्त्या गैरिकेणोपलेपयेत् ..
प्राप्नुयान्महतीं लक्ष्मीं रोगैश्चापि प्रमुच्यते .. 7.1.17.120 ..
16.17.m: Whoever smears the shrine of the Sun with devotion using red chalk / shall attain great fortune and is freed from diseases.

16.17.s:
aṣṭādaśeha kuṣṭhāni ye cānye vyādhayo nṛṇām ..
pralayaṃ yāṃti te sarve mṛdā yadyupalepayet .. .. 121 ..
16.17.d:
अष्टादशेह कुष्ठानि ये चान्ये व्याधयो नृणाम् ..
प्रलयं यांति ते सर्वे मृदा यद्युपलेपयेत् .. .. 121 ..
16.17.m: The eighteen types of leprosy here, and whatever other ailments of men exist, / all of them go to destruction if one smears [it] with clay.

16.17.s:
vilepanānāṃ sarveṣāṃ kuṃkumaṃ raktacaṃdanam ..
puṣpāṇāṃ karavīrāṇi praśastāni varānane ..122..
16.17.d:
विलेपनानां सर्वेषां कुंकुमं रक्तचंदनम् ..
पुष्पाणां करवीराणि प्रशस्तानि वरानने ..122..
16.17.m: Among all ungents, saffron and red sandalwood are praised, / and among flowers, oleanders are commended, O fair-faced lady.

16.17.s:
nātaḥ parataraṃ kiṃcidbhāsvatastuṣṭikārakam ..
yādṛśaṃ kuṅkumaṃ jātī śatapatraṃ tathā'guruḥ ..123..
16.17.d:
नातः परतरं किंचिद्भास्वतस्तुष्टिकारकम् ..
यादृशं कुङ्कुमं जाती शतपत्रं तथाऽगुरुः ..123..
16.17.m: There is nothing superior to this for causing pleasure to the Sun / such as saffron, jasmine, the hundred-petaled lotus, and agarwood.

16.17.s:
kiṃ tasya na bhavelloke yaścaibhiścārcayedravim ..
upalipyālayaṃ yastu kuryānmaṃḍalakaṃ śubham ..124..
16.17.d:
किं तस्य न भवेल्लोके यश्चैभिश्चार्चयेद्रविम् ..
उपलिप्यालयं यस्तु कुर्यान्मंडलकं शुभम् ..124..
16.17.m: What would not come to be in the world for him who worships the Sun with these, / and who, having smeared the temple, makes an auspicious circle?

16.17.s:
ekenāsya bhavedartho dvābhyāmārogyamaśnute ..
tribhistu sarvavidyāvāṃścaturbhirbhogavānbhavet ..125..
16.17.d:
एकेनास्य भवेदर्थो द्वाभ्यामारोग्यमश्नुते ..
त्रिभिस्तु सर्वविद्यावांश्चतुर्भिर्भोगवान्भवेत् ..125..
16.17.m: With one [mandala] one gains wealth, with two one attains health, / with three one possesses all knowledge, and with four one becomes an enjoyer of pleasures.

16.17.s:
paṃcabhirvipulaṃ dhānyaṃ ṣaḍbhirāyurbalaṃ yaśaḥ..
saptamaṇḍalatārī syānmaṃḍalādhipatirnaraḥ .. 126 ..
16.17.d:
पंचभिर्विपुलं धान्यं षड्भिरायुर्बलं यशः..
सप्तमण्डलतारी स्यान्मंडलाधिपतिर्नरः .. 126 ..
16.17.m: With five [one gains] abundant grain; with six, longevity, strength, and renown; / with seven mandalas drawn, a man becomes the lord of a realm.

16.17.s:
ghṛtadīpapradānena cakṣuṣmāñjāyate naraḥ ..
kaṭutailasya dīpena svaṃ śatruṃ jayate naraḥ .. 127 ..
16.17.d:
घृतदीपप्रदानेन चक्षुष्माञ्जायते नरः ..
कटुतैलस्य दीपेन स्वं शत्रुं जयते नरः .. 127 ..
16.17.m: By offering a lamp of clarified butter, a man becomes possessed of good sight; / by offering a lamp of pungent oil, a man conquers his own enemy.

16.17.s:
tailadīpapradānena sūryaloke mahīyate ..
madhūkatailadīpena saubhāgyaṃ paramaṃ labhet .. 128. ..
puṣpāṇāṃ pravarā jātī dhūpānāṃ vijayaḥ paraḥ ..
gandhānāṃ kuṃkumaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ lepānāṃ raktacaṃdanam .. 129 ..
16.17.d:
तैलदीपप्रदानेन सूर्यलोके महीयते ..
मधूकतैलदीपेन सौभाग्यं परमं लभेत् .. 128. ..
पुष्पाणां प्रवरा जाती धूपानां विजयः परः ..
गन्धानां कुंकुमं श्रेष्ठं लेपानां रक्तचंदनम् .. 129 ..
16.17.m:
By offering a lamp of [sesame] oil, one is glorified in the world of Sūrya; / by a lamp of madhūka oil, one obtains supreme good fortune.
Among flowers, jasmine is superior; among incenses, vijaya is foremost; / among fragrances, saffron is best; and among unguents, red sandalwood.

16.17.s:
dīpadāne ghṛtaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ naivedye modakaḥ param ..
etaistuṣyati deveśaḥ sāṃnidhyaṃ cādhigacchati .. 7.1.17.130 ..
16.17.d:
दीपदाने घृतं श्रेष्ठं नैवेद्ये मोदकः परम् ..
एतैस्तुष्यति देवेशः सांनिध्यं चाधिगच्छति .. 7.1.17.130 ..
16.17.m: In offering lamps, clarified butter is best; in food offerings, a sweetmeat is foremost; / with these the lord of gods is pleased and grants his presence.

16.17.s:
evaṃ saṃpūjya vidhivatkṛtvā pitṛpradakṣiṇām ..
praṇamya śirasā devaṃ tatra cārkasthalaṃ priye.. 131 ..
16.17.d:
एवं संपूज्य विधिवत्कृत्वा पितृप्रदक्षिणाम् ..
प्रणम्य शिरसा देवं तत्र चार्कस्थलं प्रिये.. 131 ..
16.17.m: Having thus worshipped according to rule, and having made circumambulations for the ancestors, / having bowed with the head to the god at that Arkasthala, O beloved,

16.17.s:
sukhāsīnastataḥ paśyedraverabhimukhe sthitaḥ ..
ekaṃ siddhārthakaṃ kṛtvā haste pānīyasaṃyutam .. 132 ..
16.17.d:
सुखासीनस्ततः पश्येद्रवेरभिमुखे स्थितः ..
एकं सिद्धार्थकं कृत्वा हस्ते पानीयसंयुतम् .. 132 ..
16.17.m: sitting comfortably, he should then look, remaining facing the sun, / having placed a single white mustard seed in his hand along with water.

16.17.s:
kāmaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ hṛdaye kṛtvārkasthalasannidhau ..
pibetsatoyaṃ taddevi hyaspṛṣṭaṃ daśanaiḥ sakṛt .. 133 ..
16.17.d:
कामं यथेष्टं हृदये कृत्वार्कस्थलसन्निधौ ..
पिबेत्सतोयं तद्देवि ह्यस्पृष्टं दशनैः सकृत् .. 133 ..
16.17.m: Having formed whatever desire he wishes in his heart near Arkasthala, / he should drink it with the water, O goddess, untouched by his teeth, all at once.

16.17.s:
evaṃ kṛtvā naro devi koṭiyātrāphalaṃ labhet ..
brahmā viṣṇurmahādevo jvalano dhanadastathā .. 134 ..
16.17.d:
एवं कृत्वा नरो देवि कोटियात्राफलं लभेत् ..
ब्रह्मा विष्णुर्महादेवो ज्वलनो धनदस्तथा .. 134 ..
16.17.m: By doing thus, O goddess, a man obtains the fruit of ten million pilgrimages. / Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Mahādeva, the Fire-god, and likewise Kubera—

16.17.s:
bhānumāśritya sarve te modante divi suvrate ..
tasmādbhānusamaṃ devaṃ nāhaṃ paśyāmi kañcana .. 135 ..
16.17.d:
भानुमाश्रित्य सर्वे ते मोदन्ते दिवि सुव्रते ..
तस्माद्भानुसमं देवं नाहं पश्यामि कञ्चन .. 135 ..
16.17.m: all of them rejoice in heaven relying upon the Sun, O lady of good vows; / therefore I see no god equal to the Sun.

16.17.s:
iti kṛtvā mahādevi punarbhānau pradakṣiṇam ..
kuryānmantreṇa deveśi saptakṛtvo varānane .. 136 ..
16.17.d:
इति कृत्वा महादेवि पुनर्भानौ प्रदक्षिणम् ..
कुर्यान्मन्त्रेण देवेशि सप्तकृत्वो वरानने .. 136 ..
16.17.m: Having done this, O great goddess, he should again perform circumambulation / around the Sun seven times with mantra[s], O goddess of gods, O fair-faced one.

16.17.s:
tamuṣṭavāma iti ṛkprathamā parikīrtitā ..
etonvindraṃ stavāmeti dvitīyā parikīrtitā .. 137 ..
16.17.d:
तमुष्टवाम इति ऋक्प्रथमा परिकीर्तिता ..
एतोन्विन्द्रं स्तवामेति द्वितीया परिकीर्तिता .. 137 ..
16.17.m: ‘Tam u ṣṭavāma’ is celebrated as the first ṛg-verse; / ‘Eta u nv indraṃ stavāma’ is celebrated as the second;

16.17.s:
iṃdra śuddho na āgahi tṛtīyā parikīrtitā ..
indraṃ śuddho hi no rayiṃ caturthī parikīrtitā .. 138 ..
16.17.d:
इंद्र शुद्धो न आगहि तृतीया परिकीर्तिता ..
इन्द्रं शुद्धो हि नो रयिं चतुर्थी परिकीर्तिता .. 138 ..
16.17.m: ‘Indra śuddho na ā gahi’ is celebrated as the third; / ‘Indraṃ śuddho hi no rayim’ is celebrated as the fourth;

16.17.s:
asya vāmasyeti śubhe pañcamī parikīrtitā ..
tribhiṣṭvaṃ deva iti vai ṣaṣṭhī ca parikīrtitā .. 139 ..
daśa sāmāni vai yāni pravarāṇi manīṣibhiḥ ..
gītāni sāmagairnityaṃ saptamīṃ taistu kārayet ..7.1.17.14...
16.17.d:
अस्य वामस्येति शुभे पञ्चमी परिकीर्तिता ..
त्रिभिष्ट्वं देव इति वै षष्ठी च परिकीर्तिता .. 139 ..
दश सामानि वै यानि प्रवराणि मनीषिभिः ..
गीतानि सामगैर्नित्यं सप्तमीं तैस्तु कारयेत् ..7.1.17.14...
16.17.m:
‘Asya vāmasya’, O auspicious one, is celebrated as the fifth; / and ‘Tribhiṣ ṭvaṃ deva’ indeed is celebrated as the sixth.
Those ten superior Sāmans that are always sung by wise Sāman-chanters— / with them he should have the seventh [circumambulation] performed.

16.17.s:
tāni te kathayāmyadya daśa sāmāni sundari..
huṃkāraḥ praṇavodgīthaḥ prastāvaśca catuṣṭayam .. 141 ..
16.17.d:
तानि ते कथयाम्यद्य दश सामानि सुन्दरि..
हुंकारः प्रणवोद्गीथः प्रस्तावश्च चतुष्टयम् .. 141 ..
16.17.m: I tell those ten Sāmans to you today, O beautiful woman: / the huṃkāra, the praṇava, the udgītha, and the prastāva make four;

16.17.s:
pañcamaṃ praharo yatra ṣaṣṭhamāraṇyakaṃ tathā ..
nidhanaṃ saptamaṃ sāmnāṃ saptasiddhimiti smṛtam .. 142 ..
16.17.d:
पञ्चमं प्रहरो यत्र षष्ठमारण्यकं तथा ..
निधनं सप्तमं साम्नां सप्तसिद्धिमिति स्मृतम् .. 142 ..
16.17.m: the fifth is where the prahāra is, and likewise the sixth is the Āraṇyaka; / the seventh is the nidhana of the Sāmans, remembered as the saptasiddhi.

16.17.s:
pañcavidhyamiti proktaṃ hrīṃkārapraṇavena tu ..
aṣṭamaṃ ca tathā sādhyaṃ navamaṃ vāmadevakam .. 143 ..
16.17.d:
पञ्चविध्यमिति प्रोक्तं ह्रींकारप्रणवेन तु ..
अष्टमं च तथा साध्यं नवमं वामदेवकम् .. 143 ..
16.17.m: This is taught as fivefold; but with hrīṃkāra and the praṇava, / the eighth is Sādhya, and the ninth is Vāmadevaka,

16.17.s:
jyeṣṭhaṃ tu daśamaṃ sāma vedhase priyamuttamam ..
eteṣāṃ devi sāmnāṃ vai jāpyaṃ kāryaṃ vidhānataḥ .. 144 ..
16.17.d:
ज्येष्ठं तु दशमं साम वेधसे प्रियमुत्तमम् ..
एतेषां देवि साम्नां वै जाप्यं कार्यं विधानतः .. 144 ..
16.17.m: and the Jyeṣṭhasāman is the tenth Sāman, beloved of the Creator and supreme. / The recitation of these Sāmans, O goddess, must indeed be performed according to rule.

16.17.s:
jyeṣṭhasāmaparaṃ caiva dvitīyaṃ gadataḥ śṛṇu ..
na ca śrāvyaṃ dvitīyaṃ tu japtavyaṃ muktimicchatā ..145...
16.17.d:
ज्येष्ठसामपरं चैव द्वितीयं गदतः शृणु ..
न च श्राव्यं द्वितीयं तु जप्तव्यं मुक्तिमिच्छता ..145...
16.17.m: Hear also from me as I speak of another that is beyond the Jyeṣṭhasāman; / that second one is not to be recited aloud, but murmured by one desiring liberation.

16.17.s:
tajjāpyaṃ paramaṃ proktaṃ svayaṃ devena bhānunā ..
jāpyasya viniyogo'sya lakṣaṇaṃ ca nibodha me ..
stobhasāraṃ śvāsalīnamoṃkārādi smṛtaṃ budhaiḥ ..146..
16.17.d:
तज्जाप्यं परमं प्रोक्तं स्वयं देवेन भानुना ..
जाप्यस्य विनियोगोऽस्य लक्षणं च निबोध मे ..
स्तोभसारं श्वासलीनमोंकारादि स्मृतं बुधैः ..146..
16.17.m: That supreme text to be muttered was proclaimed by the Sun God himself; / learn from me the ritual application and characteristics of this recitation: / the essence of stobhas, merging with the breath, beginning with the syllable Oṃ, is remembered by the wise.

16.17.s:
ūrbhānuśca tathā dharmaṃ dharmaḥ satyaṃ hyṛta tathā ..
dharmaṃ ye dharmavaddharme dharme vai nidhanaṃ gatāḥ .. 147 ..
16.17.d:
ऊर्भानुश्च तथा धर्मं धर्मः सत्यं ह्यृत तथा ..
धर्मं ये धर्मवद्धर्मे धर्मे वै निधनं गताः .. 147 ..
16.17.m: ‘Ūr, the sun, and likewise dharma; dharma is truth and indeed cosmic order; / dharma, those who are dharmic in dharma, have indeed attained the conclusion in dharma.’

16.17.s:
yadebhiśca yajecchabdairucitaṃ sāmagairdvijaiḥ ..
jāpyaṃ caitatparaṃ proktaṃ svayaṃ devena bhānunā .. 148 ..
16.17.d:
यदेभिश्च यजेच्छब्दैरुचितं सामगैर्द्विजैः ..
जाप्यं चैतत्परं प्रोक्तं स्वयं देवेन भानुना .. 148 ..
16.17.m: When one worships with these words as appropriate for Sāma-singing twice-born [brahmins]— / this supreme recitation was taught by the Sun God himself.

16.17.s:
etadvai japyamānastu punarāvartate na tu ..
sarvarogavinirmukto mucyate brahmahatyayā .. 149 ..
16.17.d:
एतद्वै जप्यमानस्तु पुनरावर्तते न तु ..
सर्वरोगविनिर्मुक्तो मुच्यते ब्रह्महत्यया .. 149 ..
16.17.m: Being muttered, one does not return again [to rebirth]; / freed from all diseases, he is released from [the sin of] killing a brahmin.

16.17.s: ājyadohādyadoheti jyeṣṭhasāmno'pi lakṣaṇam ..7.1.17.150..
16.17.d: आज्यदोहाद्यदोहेति ज्येष्ठसाम्नोऽपि लक्षणम् ..7.1.17.150..
16.17.m: ‘Ājyadohādyadohā’ is also the characteristic of the Jyeṣṭhasāman.

16.17.s:
iti saṃpūjya deveśaṃ tataḥ kuryātparāṃ stutim ..
ṛgbhirve paṃcabhiścaiva śṛṇuṣvaikamanāstu tāḥ ..151..
16.17.d:
इति संपूज्य देवेशं ततः कुर्यात्परां स्तुतिम् ..
ऋग्भिर्वे पंचभिश्चैव शृणुष्वैकमनास्तु ताः ..151..
16.17.m: Having thus worshipped the lord of gods, he should then utter supreme praise / with five ṛg-verses; listen to them attentively:

16.17.s:
ukṣāṇaṃ pṛśnimiti vai prathamā parikīrtitā ..
catvāri vākparīti vai dvitīyā parikīrtitā .. 152 ..
16.17.d:
उक्षाणं पृश्निमिति वै प्रथमा परिकीर्तिता ..
चत्वारि वाक्परीति वै द्वितीया परिकीर्तिता .. 152 ..
16.17.m: ‘Ukṣāṇaṃ pṛśnim’ is celebrated as the first; / ‘Catvāri vāk pari’ is celebrated as the second;

16.17.s:
iṃdraṃ mitraṃ tṛtīyā tu ṛkcaiva parikīrtitā ..
kṛṣṇaṃ niyānaṃ hi tathā caturthī parikīrtitā .. 153 ..
16.17.d:
इंद्रं मित्रं तृतीया तु ऋक्चैव परिकीर्तिता ..
कृष्णं नियानं हि तथा चतुर्थी परिकीर्तिता .. 153 ..
16.17.m: and ‘Indraṃ mitraṃ’ is celebrated as the third ṛg-verse; / ‘Kṛṣṇaṃ niyānam’ indeed is celebrated as the fourth;

16.17.s:
dvādaśaprathama iti paṃcamī parikīrtitā ..
yo ratnavāhītyanayā kirīṭaṃ yojayedraveḥ ..154..
16.17.d:
द्वादशप्रथम इति पंचमी परिकीर्तिता ..
यो रत्नवाहीत्यनया किरीटं योजयेद्रवेः ..154..
16.17.m: ‘Dvādaśaprathamaḥ’ is celebrated as the fifth. / With ‘Yo ratnavāhī’, he should fasten the crown of the Sun.

16.17.s:
gatehanāmityanayā avyaṃgaṃ bhāskaraṃ nyaset ..
anena vidhinā devi pūjayedvidhivadravim .. 155 ..
16.17.d:
गतेहनामित्यनया अव्यंगं भास्करं न्यसेत् ..
अनेन विधिना देवि पूजयेद्विधिवद्रविम् .. 155 ..
16.17.m: With ‘Gatehanām’, he should place the avyaṅga belt on the Sun. / In this manner, O goddess, he should worship the Sun according to rule.

16.17.s: ityeṣa te mayā khyātaḥ pratimāpūjane vidhiḥ .. .. 156 ..
16.17.d: इत्येष ते मया ख्यातः प्रतिमापूजने विधिः .. .. 156 ..
16.17.m: Thus has the rule for worshipping the image been declared to you by me.

16.17.s:
anenavidhinā yastu satataṃ pūjayedravim ..
sa prāpnotyadhikānkāmāniha loke paratra ca .. 157 ..
16.17.d:
अनेनविधिना यस्तु सततं पूजयेद्रविम् ..
स प्राप्नोत्यधिकान्कामानिह लोके परत्र च .. 157 ..
16.17.m: He who continually worships the Sun according to this rule / obtains superior desires in this world and in the next.

16.17.s:
putrārthī labhate putraṃ dhanārthī labhate dhanam ..
kanyārthī labhate kanyāṃ vidyārthī vedavidbhavet .. 158 ..
16.17.d:
पुत्रार्थी लभते पुत्रं धनार्थी लभते धनम् ..
कन्यार्थी लभते कन्यां विद्यार्थी वेदविद्भवेत् .. 158 ..
16.17.m: He who desires a son obtains a son; he who desires wealth obtains wealth; / he who desires a maiden obtains a maiden; he who desires knowledge becomes a knower of the Veda.

16.17.s:
niṣkāmaḥ pūjayedyastu sa mokṣaṃ yāti vai dhruvam ..
asya kṣetrasya māhātmyādarkasūryaprabhāvataḥ .. 159 ..
16.17.d:
निष्कामः पूजयेद्यस्तु स मोक्षं याति वै ध्रुवम् ..
अस्य क्षेत्रस्य माहात्म्यादर्कसूर्यप्रभावतः .. 159 ..
16.17.m: He who worships without desire goes surely to liberation / because of the māhātmya of this sacred field and by the power of the Sun of Arkasthala.

16.17.s:
anyatra brāhmaṇānāṃ ca koṭinā yatphalaṃ labhet..
arkasthale tathaikena bhojitena tu tatphalam .. 7.1.17.160 ..
16.17.d:
अन्यत्र ब्राह्मणानां च कोटिना यत्फलं लभेत्..
अर्कस्थले तथैकेन भोजितेन तु तत्फलम् .. 7.1.17.160 ..
16.17.m: Whatever fruit one may obtain elsewhere by [feeding] ten million brahmins, / that same fruit is gained by feeding just one [brahmin] at Arkasthala.

16.17.s:
snānaṃ dānaṃ japo homaḥ sūryaparvaṇi yatkṛtam..
tatsarvaṃ koṭiguṇitaṃ sūryakoṭiprabhāvataḥ .. 161 ..
16.17.d:
स्नानं दानं जपो होमः सूर्यपर्वणि यत्कृतम्..
तत्सर्वं कोटिगुणितं सूर्यकोटिप्रभावतः .. 161 ..
16.17.m: Whatever ritual ablution, gifting, recitation, and oblation is performed on a solar eclipse / is multiplied ten million times by the power of ten million suns.

16.17.s:
māghamāse naro yastu saptamyāṃ ravivāsare ..
kṛṣṇapakṣe mahādevi jāgaraṃ śraddhayā''caret ..
arkasthalasamīpe tu sa yāti paramāṃ gatim .. 162 ..
16.17.d:
माघमासे नरो यस्तु सप्तम्यां रविवासरे ..
कृष्णपक्षे महादेवि जागरं श्रद्धया'ऽचरेत् ..
अर्कस्थलसमीपे तु स याति परमां गतिम् .. 162 ..
16.17.m: Whatever man faithfully keeps a vigil on the seventh day [of the lunar fortnight] falling on a Sunday / in the dark fortnight of the month of Māgha, O great goddess, / near Arkasthala, he goes to the supreme state.

16.17.s:
gośatasya pradattasya kurukṣetre ca yatphalam ..
tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti tatrārkasthaladarśanāt .. 163 ..
16.17.d:
गोशतस्य प्रदत्तस्य कुरुक्षेत्रे च यत्फलम् ..
तत्फलं समवाप्नोति तत्रार्कस्थलदर्शनात् .. 163 ..
16.17.m: Whatever fruit [comes] from giving a hundred cows in Kurukṣetra, / one obtains that same fruit from the darśana of Arkasthala there.

16.17.s:
arkasthalaḥ pūjanīyastatra sthāne nivāsibhiḥ ..
japāpuṣpairarkapuṣpai rogibhistu viśeṣataḥ .. 164 ..
16.17.d:
अर्कस्थलः पूजनीयस्तत्र स्थाने निवासिभिः ..
जपापुष्पैरर्कपुष्पै रोगिभिस्तु विशेषतः .. 164 ..
16.17.m: Arkasthala should be worshipped by those dwelling in that place, / especially by the sick, with hibiscus flowers and arka flowers.

16.17.s:
na ca patrorṇakusumairna caivonmattasaṃbhavaiḥ ..
na cāmrātakajaiḥ puṣpairarcanīyo divākaraḥ .. 165 ..
16.17.d:
न च पत्रोर्णकुसुमैर्न चैवोन्मत्तसंभवैः ..
न चाम्रातकजैः पुष्पैरर्चनीयो दिवाकरः .. 165 ..
16.17.m: The Sun should not be worshipped with patrorṇa flowers, / nor with those arising from dhattūra, nor with flowers produced from hog-plum.

16.17.s:
āmrātakasya kusumaṃ nirmālyamiva dṛśyate ..
apratyagraṃ bahiryasmāttasmāttatparivarjayet .. 166 ..
16.17.d:
आम्रातकस्य कुसुमं निर्माल्यमिव दृश्यते ..
अप्रत्यग्रं बहिर्यस्मात्तस्मात्तत्परिवर्जयेत् .. 166 ..
16.17.m: The flower of the hog-plum appears like an already-used offering / because it is not fresh on the outside; therefore, one should avoid it.

16.17.s:
nāvijñātaṃ pradātavyaṃ na mlānaṃ na ca dūṣitam ..
na ca paryyuṣitaṃ mālyaṃ dātavyaṃ bhūtimicchatā .. 167 ..
16.17.d:
नाविज्ञातं प्रदातव्यं न म्लानं न च दूषितम् ..
न च पर्य्युषितं माल्यं दातव्यं भूतिमिच्छता .. 167 ..
16.17.m: One desiring prosperity should not offer an unknown garland, nor one that is withered, / nor one that is tainted, nor one that is stale.

16.17.s:
devamullocayedyastu tatkṣaṇātpuṣpalobhataḥ ..
puṣpāṇi ca sugandhāni bhojakenetarāṇi ca .. 168 ..
16.17.d:
देवमुल्लोचयेद्यस्तु तत्क्षणात्पुष्पलोभतः ..
पुष्पाणि च सुगन्धानि भोजकेनेतराणि च .. 168 ..
16.17.m: Whoever strips the deity immediately out of greed for flowers— / [whether] fragrant flowers or others [offered] by a temple priest—

16.17.s:
brahmahatyāmavāpnoti bhojako lobhamohitaḥ ..
mahārauravamāsādya pacyate śāśvatīḥ samāḥ .. 169 ..
16.17.d:
ब्रह्महत्यामवाप्नोति भोजको लोभमोहितः ..
महारौरवमासाद्य पच्यते शाश्वतीः समाः .. 169 ..
16.17.m: The bhojaka, deluded by greed, incurs the sin of killing a brahmin; / having reached Mahāraurava, he is cooked for eternal years. // 169

16.17.s:
hanta te kīrttayiṣyāmi dhūpadānavidhiṃ param ..
pradānāddevadevasya yena dhūpena yatphalam .. 7.1.17.170 ..
16.17.d:
हन्त ते कीर्त्तयिष्यामि धूपदानविधिं परम् ..
प्रदानाद्देवदेवस्य येन धूपेन यत्फलम् .. 7.1.17.170 ..
16.17.m: Come, I shall declare to you the supreme rule for offering incense, / [and] which fruit comes from which incense by offering it to the God of gods: // 7.1.17.170

16.17.s:
sadārcane ca dhūpena sāmīpyaṃ kurute raviḥ ..
pradadyātsakalaṃ kāmaṃ yadyadicchati mānavaḥ .. 171 ..
16.17.d:
सदार्चने च धूपेन सामीप्यं कुरुते रविः ..
प्रदद्यात्सकलं कामं यद्यदिच्छति मानवः .. 171 ..
16.17.m: With regular worship by means of incense, the Sun grants proximity; / he would grant every desired thing, whatever a mortal wishes. // 171

16.17.s:
tathaivāgurudhūpena nidhiṃ dadyādabhīpsitam ..
ārogyārthī dhanārthī ca nityadā guggalaṃ dahet .. 172 ..
16.17.d:
तथैवागुरुधूपेन निधिं दद्यादभीप्सितम् ..
आरोग्यार्थी धनार्थी च नित्यदा गुग्गलं दहेत् .. 172 ..
16.17.m: Likewise, through aloe incense he would grant a desired treasure; / one who desires health and desires wealth should continually burn bdellium. // 172

16.17.s:
piṃḍātadhūpadānena sadā tuṣyati bhānumān ..
ārogyaṃ ca svayaṃ dadyātsaukhyaṃ ca paramaṃ bhavet..173..
16.17.d:
पिंडातधूपदानेन सदा तुष्यति भानुमान् ..
आरोग्यं च स्वयं दद्यात्सौख्यं च परमं भवेत्..173..
16.17.m: The Sun is ever pleased by offering piṇḍāta incense; / he would himself grant health, and supreme happiness would ensue. // 173

16.17.s:
śrīvāsakasya dhūpena vāṇijyaṃ sakalaṃ labhet..
rasaṃ sarjarasaṃ caiva dahato'rthāgamo bhavet..174..
16.17.d:
श्रीवासकस्य धूपेन वाणिज्यं सकलं लभेत्..
रसं सर्जरसं चैव दहतोऽर्थागमो भवेत्..174..
16.17.m: Through incense of pine resin, one obtains complete [success in] trade; / and to one who burns the resin of the Sāla tree, influx of wealth will come. // 174

16.17.s:
devadāruṃ ca dahato bhavatyannamathākṣayam..
vilepanaṃ kuṃkumena sarvakāmaphalapradam..175..
16.17.d:
देवदारुं च दहतो भवत्यन्नमथाक्षयम्..
विलेपनं कुंकुमेन सर्वकामफलप्रदम्..175..
16.17.m: And to one who burns deodar wood, food becomes inexhaustible; / anointment with saffron grants the fruit of all desires. // 175

16.17.s:
iha loke sukhī bhūtvā akṣayaṃ svargamāpnuyāt..
caṃdanasya pralepena śriyamāyuśca viṃdati .. 176 ..
16.17.d:
इह लोके सुखी भूत्वा अक्षयं स्वर्गमाप्नुयात्..
चंदनस्य प्रलेपेन श्रियमायुश्च विंदति .. 176 ..
16.17.m: Having become happy in this world, he would attain imperishable heaven; / through anointment with sandalwood paste, he finds fortune and longevity. // 176

16.17.s:
raktacandanalepena sarvaṃ dadyāddivākaraḥ ..
api rogaśatairgrastaḥ kṣemamārogyamāpnuyāt .. 177 ..
16.17.d:
रक्तचन्दनलेपेन सर्वं दद्याद्दिवाकरः ..
अपि रोगशतैर्ग्रस्तः क्षेममारोग्यमाप्नुयात् .. 177 ..
16.17.m: Through anointment with red sandalwood, the Sun gives everything; / even if afflicted with hundreds of diseases, he would attain well-being and health. // 177

16.17.s:
gatigaṃdhaṃ ca saubhāgyaṃ paramaṃ viṃdate naraḥ ..
kastūrikāmardanakairaiśvaryamatulaṃ labhet .. 178 ..
16.17.d:
गतिगंधं च सौभाग्यं परमं विंदते नरः ..
कस्तूरिकामर्दनकैरैश्वर्यमतुलं लभेत् .. 178 ..
16.17.m: A man obtains pleasant fragrance and supreme good fortune; / through massage with musk, he will obtain peerless sovereignty. // 178

16.17.s:
karpūrasaṃyutairgaṃdhaiḥ kṣmādhipādhipatibhavet ..
catuḥsamena gaṃdhena sarvā nkāmānavāpnuyāt .. 179 ..
16.17.d:
कर्पूरसंयुतैर्गंधैः क्ष्माधिपाधिपतिभवेत् ..
चतुःसमेन गंधेन सर्वा न्कामानवाप्नुयात् .. 179 ..
16.17.m: With perfumes combined with camphor, he becomes a sovereign of kings; / with fourfold perfume, he will attain all desires. // 179

16.17.s:
etatte kathitaṃ devi sūryamāhātmyamuttamam ..
savistaraṃ mayā khyātaṃ kimanyatparipṛcchasi ..7.1.17.180...
16.17.d:
एतत्ते कथितं देवि सूर्यमाहात्म्यमुत्तमम् ..
सविस्तरं मया ख्यातं किमन्यत्परिपृच्छसि ..7.1.17.180...
16.17.m: This excellent māhātmya of the Sun has been told to you, O Goddess; / it has been proclaimed in detail by me; what else do you ask? // 7.1.17.180

16.17.s:
.. devyuvāca .. ..
yadyevaṃ bhagavānsūryaḥ sarvatejasvināṃ varaḥ ..
sa kathaṃ grasyate deva saiṃhikeyena rāhuṇā .. 181 ..
16.17.d:
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
यद्येवं भगवान्सूर्यः सर्वतेजस्विनां वरः ..
स कथं ग्रस्यते देव सैंहिकेयेन राहुणा .. 181 ..
16.17.m: The Goddess said: / If the divine Sun is thus the foremost of all luminous beings, / how, O Lord, is he swallowed by Rāhu, the son of Siṃhikā? // 181

16.17.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
śṛṇu daivi pravakṣyāmi sarva pāpapraṇāśanam ..
kāraṇaṃ grahaṇasyāpi bhrāṃtervicchedakārakam .. 182 ..
16.17.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
शृणु दैवि प्रवक्ष्यामि सर्व पापप्रणाशनम् ..
कारणं ग्रहणस्यापि भ्रांतेर्विच्छेदकारकम् .. 182 ..
16.17.m: Īśvara said: / Listen, O Goddess, I will declare that which destroys all sins, / the cause of the eclipse, which destroys delusion. // 182

16.17.s:
rāhurādityabiṃbasyādhastāttiṣṭhati bhāmini ..
amṛtārthī vimānastho yāvatsaṃsravate'mṛtam .. 183 ..
16.17.d:
राहुरादित्यबिंबस्याधस्तात्तिष्ठति भामिनि ..
अमृतार्थी विमानस्थो यावत्संस्रवतेऽमृतम् .. 183 ..
16.17.m: Rāhu stands below the solar orb, O spirited lady, / seated in an aerial chariot, desiring nectar, as long as the nectar trickles. // 183

16.17.s:
biṃbenāṃtarito devi ādityagrahaṇaṃ hi tat ..
na kaścidgrasituṃ śakta ādityo dahati dhruvam .. 184 ..
brahmādayastamarcaṃti sa ādiḥ sarvanākinām .1
16.17.d:
बिंबेनांतरितो देवि आदित्यग्रहणं हि तत् ..
न कश्चिद्ग्रसितुं शक्त आदित्यो दहति ध्रुवम् .. 184 ..
ब्रह्मादयस्तमर्चंति स आदिः सर्वनाकिनाम् .1
16.17.m:
It is screened by the orb, O Goddess; that is indeed the solar eclipse. / No one is able to swallow [him]; the Sun certainly burns. // 184
Brahmā and the others worship him; he is the origin of all denizens of heaven. // 185ab

16.17.s: ādityadehajāḥ sarve tathānye devadānavāḥ ..185..
16.17.d: आदित्यदेहजाः सर्वे तथान्ये देवदानवाः ..185..
16.17.m: All gods and Dānavas and others were born from the body of the Sun. // 185cd

16.17.s:
ādikarttā svayaṃ yasmādādityastena cocyate ..
prabhāse saṃsthito devaḥ sarvapātakanāśanaḥ .. 186 ..
16.17.d:
आदिकर्त्ता स्वयं यस्मादादित्यस्तेन चोच्यते ..
प्रभासे संस्थितो देवः सर्वपातकनाशनः .. 186 ..
16.17.m: Because he is himself the original creator, he is called Āditya; / the god is situated at Prabhāsa, destroying all sins. // 186

16.17.s:
bhuktimuktiprado devo vyādhiduṣkṛtanāśakṛt ..
tatra siddhāḥ purā devi lokapālā maharṣayaḥ .. 187 ..
16.17.d:
भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदो देवो व्याधिदुष्कृतनाशकृत् ..
तत्र सिद्धाः पुरा देवि लोकपाला महर्षयः .. 187 ..
16.17.m: The god grants enjoyment and liberation, destroying diseases and wicked deeds; / there, in ancient times, O Goddess, the guardians of the worlds and great seers became perfected. // 187

16.17.s:
siddhā vidyā dharā yakṣā gaṃdharvā munayastathā ..
dhanado'pi tathā bhīṣmo yayātirgālavastathā .. 188 ..
16.17.d:
सिद्धा विद्या धरा यक्षा गंधर्वा मुनयस्तथा ..
धनदोऽपि तथा भीष्मो ययातिर्गालवस्तथा .. 188 ..
16.17.m: Siddhas, Vidyādharas, Yakṣas, Gandharvas, and likewise sages; / Dhanada as well, and likewise Bhīṣma, Yayāti, and Gālava; // 188

16.17.s:
sāṃbaścaiva tathā devi parāṃ siddhimito gatāḥ ..
idaṃ rahasyaṃ deveśi sūryamāhātmyamuttamam .. 189 ..
16.17.d:
सांबश्चैव तथा देवि परां सिद्धिमितो गताः ..
इदं रहस्यं देवेशि सूर्यमाहात्म्यमुत्तमम् .. 189 ..
16.17.m: and Sāmba as well, O Goddess, attained supreme perfection from here. / This secret, O ruler of the gods, is the supreme māhātmya of the Sun. // 189

16.17.s:
na deyaṃ duṣṭabuddhīnāṃ pāpināṃ ca viśeṣataḥ ..
na nāstike'śraddadhāne na krūraṃ vā kathaṃcana .. 7.1.17.190 ..
16.17.d:
न देयं दुष्टबुद्धीनां पापिनां च विशेषतः ..
न नास्तिकेऽश्रद्दधाने न क्रूरं वा कथंचन .. 7.1.17.190 ..
16.17.m: It must not be given to evil-minded persons, and especially not to sinners; / not to an atheist, not to an unbeliever, nor ever to a cruel person. // 7.1.17.190

16.17.s:
imāṃ kathāmanubrūyāttathā nā'sūyake śive .
idaṃ putrāya śiṣyāya dharmiṇe nyāyavartine .. 191 ..
16.17.d:
इमां कथामनुब्रूयात्तथा नाऽसूयके शिवे .
इदं पुत्राय शिष्याय धर्मिणे न्यायवर्तिने .. 191 ..
16.17.m: One may recite this narrative, O auspicious lady, to one who is not envious; / this should be told to a son, to a disciple who is righteous and righteous in conduct, // 191

16.17.s:
kathanīyaṃ mahābrahma sūryabhaktāya suvrate ..
arkasthalasya devasya māhātmyamidamuttamam .. 192 ..
16.17.d:
कथनीयं महाब्रह्म सूर्यभक्ताय सुव्रते ..
अर्कस्थलस्य देवस्य माहात्म्यमिदमुत्तमम् .. 192 ..
16.17.m: O lady of noble vows, this great sacred lore [should be told] to a devotee of the Sun; / this is the supreme māhātmya of the god of Arkasthala. // 192

16.17.s:
yaḥ śrāddhe śrāvayeddevi brāhmaṇānsaṃśitavratān ..
tasyānaṃtaṃ bhaveddevi yaddānaṃ puruṣasya vai .. 193 ..
yatredaṃ kīrttyate puṇyaṃ saṃpadastatra vai sadā .1
16.17.d:
यः श्राद्धे श्रावयेद्देवि ब्राह्मणान्संशितव्रतान् ..
तस्यानंतं भवेद्देवि यद्दानं पुरुषस्य वै .. 193 ..
यत्रेदं कीर्त्त्यते पुण्यं संपदस्तत्र वै सदा .1
16.17.m:
Whoever recites [this] at a śrāddha to brahmins of strict vows, O Goddess, / endless indeed becomes whatever gift that man gives, O Goddess. // 193
Where this sacred text is recited, prosperity is indeed ever present. // 194ab

16.17.s: yātudhānā na hiṃsaṃti tacchrāddhaṃ bhayavihvalāḥ .. 194 ..
16.17.d: यातुधाना न हिंसंति तच्छ्राद्धं भयविह्वलाः .. 194 ..
16.17.m: Overcome with fear, the Yātudhānas do not disrupt that śrāddha. // 194cd

16.17.s:
paṃktipāvanatāṃ yāṃti ye'pi vai paṃktidūṣakāḥ ..
sutavāñjanmavāṃśca syātsarvakāmamanoramaḥ ..195 ..
16.17.d:
पंक्तिपावनतां यांति येऽपि वै पंक्तिदूषकाः ..
सुतवाञ्जन्मवांश्च स्यात्सर्वकाममनोरमः ..195 ..
16.17.m: Even those who defile the dining row attain the status of sanctifiers of the row; / he will have sons, have a noble birth, and be pleasing in all desires. // 195

16.17.s:
pravāsibhirbaṃdhuvargaiḥ saṃyujyeta sadā naraḥ ..
naṣṭaiḥ saṃyujyate cārthairaparaiścāpi ciṃtitaiḥ .. 196 ..
16.17.d:
प्रवासिभिर्बंधुवर्गैः संयुज्येत सदा नरः ..
नष्टैः संयुज्यते चार्थैरपरैश्चापि चिंतितैः .. 196 ..
16.17.m: A man will always be reunited with his kinsmen living abroad; / he is reunited with lost wealth, and with other desired things as well. // 196

16.17.s:
rakṣyate yāginībhiśca priyaiśca na viyujyate ..
upaspṛśya śucirbhūtvā śṛṇuyādbrāhmaṇaḥ sadā ..
sarvānkāmāṃśca labhate nātra kāryā vicāraṇā .. 197 ..
16.17.d:
रक्ष्यते यागिनीभिश्च प्रियैश्च न वियुज्यते ..
उपस्पृश्य शुचिर्भूत्वा शृणुयाद्ब्राह्मणः सदा ..
सर्वान्कामांश्च लभते नात्र कार्या विचारणा .. 197 ..
16.17.m: He is protected by Yoginīs, and is not separated from his beloved ones; / having touched water and become pure, a brahmin should always listen to it; / he obtains all desires, there is no doubt about this. // 197

16.17.s:
vaiśyaḥ samṛddhimatulāṃ kṣatriyaḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ..
vaṇijaścāpi vāṇijyamakhaṃḍaṃ śatasaṃkhyayā..
labheyuḥ kīrtanādasyāḥ sūryotpattervarānane..198..
16.17.d:
वैश्यः समृद्धिमतुलां क्षत्रियः पृथिवीपतिः..
वणिजश्चापि वाणिज्यमखंडं शतसंख्यया..
लभेयुः कीर्तनादस्याः सूर्योत्पत्तेर्वरानने..198..
16.17.m: A vaiśya [would obtain] peerless prosperity, a kṣatriya would become a ruler of the earth, / and merchants would obtain undivided trade hundreds of times over, / from the recitation of this origin of the Sun, O fair-faced lady. // 198

16.17.s:
śūdrāścaivābhilaṣitānkāmānprāpsyaṃti bhāmini..
apamṛtyubhayaṃ ghoraṃ mṛtyuto'pi mahābhayam..199.
16.17.d:
शूद्राश्चैवाभिलषितान्कामान्प्राप्स्यंति भामिनि..
अपमृत्युभयं घोरं मृत्युतोऽपि महाभयम्..199.
16.17.m: And śūdras will obtain their cherished desires, O spirited lady; / the terrible fear of premature death, which is even a greater fear than death, // 199

16.17.s:
naśyate nātra saṃdeho rājadvārakṛtaṃ ca yat..
sarvakāmasamṛddhātmā sūryaloke mahīyate .. 7.1.17.200 ..
16.17.d:
नश्यते नात्र संदेहो राजद्वारकृतं च यत्..
सर्वकामसमृद्धात्मा सूर्यलोके महीयते .. 7.1.17.200 ..
16.17.m: is destroyed, of this there is no doubt, as well as [fear] caused at the royal gate; / enriched in all desires, he is glorified in the world of the Sun. // 7.1.17.200

16.17.s:
ityetatkathitaṃ devi māhātmyaṃ sūryadaivatam ..
arkasthalaprasaṃgena kimanyacchrotumicchasi... .. 201 ..
16.17.d:
इत्येतत्कथितं देवि माहात्म्यं सूर्यदैवतम् ..
अर्कस्थलप्रसंगेन किमन्यच्छ्रोतुमिच्छसि... .. 201 ..
16.17.m: Thus this māhātmya pertaining to the Sun deity has been told, O Goddess, / in connection with Arkasthala; what else do you wish to hear? // 201

16.17.s:
sthānaṃ śāśvatamojasāṃ gatirapāṃ dīpo diśāmakṣayaḥ siddherdvāramapāvabhedi jagatāṃ sādhāraṇaṃ locanam..
haimaṃ puṣkaramaṃtarikṣasaraso dīptaṃ divaḥ kuṇḍalaṃ kālonmānavibhāvanākṣatalayaṃ biṃbaṃ raveḥ pātu vaḥ .. 202 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye'rkkasthalamāhātmyārkasthalapūjāvidhānādivarṇanaṃnāma saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ .. 17 ..
16.17.d:
स्थानं शाश्वतमोजसां गतिरपां दीपो दिशामक्षयः सिद्धेर्द्वारमपावभेदि जगतां साधारणं लोचनम्..
हैमं पुष्करमंतरिक्षसरसो दीप्तं दिवः कुण्डलं कालोन्मानविभावनाक्षतलयं बिंबं रवेः पातु वः .. 202 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्येऽर्क्कस्थलमाहात्म्यार्कस्थलपूजाविधानादिवर्णनंनाम सप्तदशोऽध्यायः .. 17 ..
16.17.m:
May the orb of the Sun protect you—the eternal abode of powers, the destination of waters, the inexhaustible lamp of the quarters, the unobstructed gate to perfection, the common eye of the worlds, / the golden lotus of the lake of the atmosphere, the blazing earring of the sky, the imperishable limit for the reckoning and measure of time! // 202
Thus ends the seventeenth chapter, titled 'Description of the Arkasthala Māhātmya, Rules for Arkasthala Worship, etc.,' in the first [sub-section], Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh section, Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skandapurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses]. // 17

16.18.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
iti proktā tadā devī śaṃkareṇa yaśasvinī ..
punaḥ papraccha vipreṃdrāḥ kṣetramāhātmyavistaram .. 1 ..
16.18.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
इति प्रोक्ता तदा देवी शंकरेण यशस्विनी ..
पुनः पप्रच्छ विप्रेंद्राः क्षेत्रमाहात्म्यविस्तरम् .. 1 ..
16.18.m: Sūta said: / Having been thus addressed then by Śaṃkara, the renowned Goddess / asked again, O foremost among vipras, for the detailed māhātmya of the sacred field. // 1

16.18.s:
.. devyuvāca .. ..
adya me saphalaṃ janma saphalaṃ ca tapaḥ prabho ..
devatvamadya me jātaṃ tvatprasādena śaṃkara .. 2 ..
16.18.d:
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
अद्य मे सफलं जन्म सफलं च तपः प्रभो ..
देवत्वमद्य मे जातं त्वत्प्रसादेन शंकर .. 2 ..
16.18.m: The Goddess said: / Today my birth is fruitful, and fruitful is my austerity, O Lord; / today my divinity has come into being through your grace, O Śaṃkara! // 2

16.18.s:
adyāhaṃ kṛtakalyāṇī jñānadṛṣṭiḥ kṛtātvayā ..
adya me bhūṣitau karṇau kṣetra māhātmyabhūṣaṇau .. 3 ..
16.18.d:
अद्याहं कृतकल्याणी ज्ञानदृष्टिः कृतात्वया ..
अद्य मे भूषितौ कर्णौ क्षेत्र माहात्म्यभूषणौ .. 3 ..
16.18.m: Today I have obtained good fortune, the vision of wisdom has been granted by you; / today my two ears are adorned with the ornaments of the māhātmya of the sacred field. // 3

16.18.s:
adya me tejasaḥ piṃḍo jāto jñānaṃ hṛdi sthitam ..
adya me kulaśīlaṃ ca adya me rūpalakṣaṇam .. 4 ..
16.18.d:
अद्य मे तेजसः पिंडो जातो ज्ञानं हृदि स्थितम् ..
अद्य मे कुलशीलं च अद्य मे रूपलक्षणम् .. 4 ..
16.18.m: Today a mass of splendour has arisen in me, wisdom has settled in my heart; / today my lineage and conduct [are vindicated], today my beauty and auspicious marks! // 4

16.18.s:
adya me bhrāṃtirucchinnā tīrthabhramaṇasaṃbhavā ..
prabhāse niścalaṃ jātaṃ mano me mānināṃ vara .. 5 ..
16.18.d:
अद्य मे भ्रांतिरुच्छिन्ना तीर्थभ्रमणसंभवा ..
प्रभासे निश्चलं जातं मनो मे मानिनां वर .. 5 ..
16.18.m: Today my delusion arising from wandering among sacred fords has been dispelled; / my mind has become steady in Prabhāsa, O foremost among the proud! // 5

16.18.s:
ārādhito mayā pūrvaṃ tuṣṭo me'dya sureśvaraḥ ..
vahninā veṣṭitā sāhamekapādena saṃsthitā .. 6 ..
16.18.d:
आराधितो मया पूर्वं तुष्टो मेऽद्य सुरेश्वरः ..
वह्निना वेष्टिता साहमेकपादेन संस्थिता .. 6 ..
16.18.m: Formerly he was worshipped by me; today the Lord of Gods is pleased with me. / Surrounded by fire, I stood upon one foot. 6.

16.18.s:
tattapaḥ saphalaṃ tvadya jātaṃ me bhaktavatsala ..
prabhāsakṣetramāhātmyamadya me prakaṭīkṛtam .. 7 ..
16.18.d:
तत्तपः सफलं त्वद्य जातं मे भक्तवत्सल ..
प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्यमद्य मे प्रकटीकृतम् .. 7 ..
16.18.m: That austerity of mine has borne fruit today, O lover of devotees! / Today the māhātmya of Prabhāsa-kṣetra has been revealed to me. 7.

16.18.s: punaḥ pṛcchāmi deveśa yāthātathyaṃ vada prabho ..8..
16.18.d: पुनः पृच्छामि देवेश याथातथ्यं वद प्रभो ..8..
16.18.m: I ask again, O Lord of Gods; speak the truth, O master! 8.

16.18.s:
adyāpi saṃśayo nātha tīrthamāhātmyasaṃbhavaḥ..
anyatkautūhalaṃ deva kathayasva maheśvara .. 9 ..
16.18.d:
अद्यापि संशयो नाथ तीर्थमाहात्म्यसंभवः..
अन्यत्कौतूहलं देव कथयस्व महेश्वर .. 9 ..
16.18.m: Even now doubt remains, O Lord, regarding the māhātmya of the tīrtha. / Tell me of another wonder, O God, O Maheśvara! 9.

16.18.s:
ayaṃ yo varttate deva caṃdraste śirasi sthitaḥ ..
kasyāyaṃ kathamutpannaḥ kasminkāle vada prabho .. 7.1.18.10 ..
16.18.d:
अयं यो वर्त्तते देव चंद्रस्ते शिरसि स्थितः ..
कस्यायं कथमुत्पन्नः कस्मिन्काले वद प्रभो .. 7.1.18.10 ..
16.18.m: This moon that exists, O God, resting upon your head— / whose is he, how was he born, and at what time? Tell me, O Lord! 10.

16.18.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
asminkāle mahādevi vārāha iti viśrute ..
parārddhe tu dvitīye'sminvartamāne tu vedhasaḥ .. 11 ..
16.18.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
अस्मिन्काले महादेवि वाराह इति विश्रुते ..
परार्द्धे तु द्वितीयेऽस्मिन्वर्तमाने तु वेधसः .. 11 ..
16.18.m: Īśvara said: / In this time known as Vārāha, O Great Goddess, / while this second half of Brahmā's life is current, 11.

16.18.s:
dvitīyamāsasyādau tu pratipadyā prakīrtitā ..
vārāheṇoddhṛtā tasyāṃ tathā cādau dharā priye ..
tena vārāhakalpeti nāma jātaṃ dharātale .. 12 ..
16.18.d:
द्वितीयमासस्यादौ तु प्रतिपद्या प्रकीर्तिता ..
वाराहेणोद्धृता तस्यां तथा चादौ धरा प्रिये ..
तेन वाराहकल्पेति नाम जातं धरातले .. 12 ..
16.18.m: at the beginning of the second month, on the first lunar day as it is proclaimed, / on that [day] the earth was raised up at first by the Boar, O beloved; / therefore the name 'Vārāhakalpa' arose upon the surface of the earth. 12.

16.18.s:
tasminkalpe mahādevi gate saṃdhyāṃśake priye ..
prathamasya manoścādau devi svāyaṃbhuvasya hi .. 13 ..
16.18.d:
तस्मिन्कल्पे महादेवि गते संध्यांशके प्रिये ..
प्रथमस्य मनोश्चादौ देवि स्वायंभुवस्य हि .. 13 ..
16.18.m: In that kalpa, O Great Goddess, when the dawn twilight had passed, O beloved, / and at the beginning of the first Manu, Svāyambhuva indeed, O Goddess, 13.

16.18.s:
kṣīrode mathyamāne tu daivatairdānavairapi ..
ratnāni jajñire tatra caturddaśamitāni vai .. 14 ..
16.18.d:
क्षीरोदे मथ्यमाने तु दैवतैर्दानवैरपि ..
रत्नानि जज्ञिरे तत्र चतुर्द्दशमितानि वै .. 14 ..
16.18.m: when the Ocean of Milk was being churned by the gods and also the Dānavas, / fourteen jewels were born there. 14.

16.18.s:
teṣāṃ madhye mahātejāścaṃdramāstattvasaṃbhava ..
so'yaṃ mayā dhṛto devi adyāpi śirasi priye .. 15 ..
16.18.d:
तेषां मध्ये महातेजाश्चंद्रमास्तत्त्वसंभव ..
सोऽयं मया धृतो देवि अद्यापि शिरसि प्रिये .. 15 ..
16.18.m: Among them was the moon of great splendor, born of reality. / That very one has been borne by me upon my head even to this day, O beloved Goddess. 15.

16.18.s:
viṣe pīte mahādevi prabhāsasthasya me sadā ..
bhūṣaṇaṃ muktaye devairmama caṃdraḥ kṛtaḥ purā .. 16 ..
16.18.d:
विषे पीते महादेवि प्रभासस्थस्य मे सदा ..
भूषणं मुक्तये देवैर्मम चंद्रः कृतः पुरा .. 16 ..
16.18.m: When the poison had been drunk, O Great Goddess, as I dwell perpetually in Prabhāsa, / the moon was placed by the gods as an ornament for my liberation in the past. 16.

16.18.s:
śaśinābhūṣito yasmāttenāhaṃ śaśibhūṣaṇaḥ..
tatra sthāne sthito'dyāpi svayaṃbhūrliṃgamūrttimān..17..
16.18.d:
शशिनाभूषितो यस्मात्तेनाहं शशिभूषणः..
तत्र स्थाने स्थितोऽद्यापि स्वयंभूर्लिंगमूर्त्तिमान्..17..
16.18.m: Because I am adorned with the moon, therefore I am Śaśibhūṣaṇa. / Remaining in that place even today, self-manifest, in the form of a liṅga, 17.

16.18.s:
sarvasiddhipradātā ca kalpasthāyī sadā priye ..
ityetatkathitaṃ devi kimanyatparipṛcchasi .. 18 ..
iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye śivaśirobhūṣaṇa candrotpattivṛttāntavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ .. 18 ..
16.18.d:
सर्वसिद्धिप्रदाता च कल्पस्थायी सदा प्रिये ..
इत्येतत्कथितं देवि किमन्यत्परिपृच्छसि .. 18 ..
इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये शिवशिरोभूषण चन्द्रोत्पत्तिवृत्तान्तवर्णनंनामाष्टादशोऽध्यायः .. 18 ..
16.18.m:
and the giver of all perfections, enduring for a kalpa always, O beloved. / Thus this has been related, O Goddess; what else do you ask? 18.
Thus ends the eighteenth chapter, entitled 'Description of the Account of the Origin of the Moon, the Ornament on Śiva's Head,' in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, in the seventh [section], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses]. 18.

16.19.s:
.. devyuvāca .. ..
yadyevaṃ sakalaścaṃdraḥ kathaṃ na vidhṛtastvayā ..
antabhāve kalānāṃ tatkāraṇaṃ kathaya prabho .. 1 ..
16.19.d:
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
यद्येवं सकलश्चंद्रः कथं न विधृतस्त्वया ..
अन्तभावे कलानां तत्कारणं कथय प्रभो .. 1 ..
16.19.m: The Goddess said: / If it is so, why is the moon not borne in full by you? / With respect to the inclusion of the digits, tell me the reason for that, O Lord. 1.

16.19.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
amā ṣoḍaśabhedena devi proktā mahākalā ..
saṃsthitā paramā māyā dehināṃ deha dhāriṇī .. 2 ..
16.19.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
अमा षोडशभेदेन देवि प्रोक्ता महाकला ..
संस्थिता परमा माया देहिनां देह धारिणी .. 2 ..
16.19.m: Īśvara said: / The Great Digit, O Goddess, is declared to be sixteenfold as Amā. / Present as the supreme Māyā, she supports the bodies of embodied beings. 2.

16.19.s:
amādipaurṇamāsyaṃtā yā eva śaśinaḥ kalāḥ ..
tithayastāḥ samākhyātāḥ ṣoḍaśaiva prakīrtitāḥ .. 3 ..
16.19.d:
अमादिपौर्णमास्यंता या एव शशिनः कलाः ..
तिथयस्ताः समाख्याताः षोडशैव प्रकीर्तिताः .. 3 ..
16.19.m: The digits of the moon that begin with the new moon and end with the full moon— / those are named lunar days, proclaimed to be sixteen indeed. 3.

16.19.s:
amā sūkṣmā parā śaktiḥ sā tvaṃ devi prakīrtitā ..
pralayotpattiyogena sthitāḥ kālakramoditāḥ ..4..
16.19.d:
अमा सूक्ष्मा परा शक्तिः सा त्वं देवि प्रकीर्तिता ..
प्रलयोत्पत्तियोगेन स्थिताः कालक्रमोदिताः ..4..
16.19.m: Amā is the subtle supreme power; you are proclaimed to be that, O Goddess! / United with dissolution and origination, they stand manifested by the order of time. 4.

16.19.s:
ṣoḍaśaiva svarā ye tu ādyāḥ sṛṣṭayaṃtakāḥ priye ..
kālasyāvayavāste ca vijñeyāḥ kālavedibhiḥ .. 5 ..
16.19.d:
षोडशैव स्वरा ये तु आद्याः सृष्टयंतकाः प्रिये ..
कालस्यावयवास्ते च विज्ञेयाः कालवेदिभिः .. 5 ..
16.19.m: The sixteen vowels, which begin with creation and end with dissolution, O beloved, / are to be known by knowers of time as the limbs of time. 5.

16.19.s:
truṭirlavo nimeṣaśca kalā kāṣṭhā muhūrtakam..
rātryahaḥpakṣamāsāśca ayanaṃ vatsaraṃ yugam .. 6 ..
16.19.d:
त्रुटिर्लवो निमेषश्च कला काष्ठा मुहूर्तकम्..
रात्र्यहःपक्षमासाश्च अयनं वत्सरं युगम् .. 6 ..
16.19.m: A truṭi, a lava, a nimeṣa, a kalā, a kāṣṭhā, a muhūrta, / night, day, a fortnight, months, an ayana, a year, a yuga, 6.

16.19.s:
manvataraṃ tathā kalpaṃ mahākalpaṃ ca ṣoḍaśa ..
kalā visarjanī yā tu jīvamāśritya vartate ..7..
16.19.d:
मन्वतरं तथा कल्पं महाकल्पं च षोडश ..
कला विसर्जनी या तु जीवमाश्रित्य वर्तते ..7..
16.19.m: a manvantara, a kalpa, and a mahākalpa are the sixteen. / That which is the projecting digit, resting upon the living soul, 7.

16.19.s:
sā sṛjatyakhilaṃ viśvaṃ viṣuvadvayasaṃyutam ..
tathā saṃvaraṇī yā tu viśvaṃ saṃharate priye .. ..
netrapātāccaturbhāgastruṭikālo nigadyate ..
tasmācca dviguṇaṃ viddhi nimiṣaṃ tanmaheśvari .. 9 ..
16.19.d:
सा सृजत्यखिलं विश्वं विषुवद्वयसंयुतम् ..
तथा संवरणी या तु विश्वं संहरते प्रिये .. ..
नेत्रपाताच्चतुर्भागस्त्रुटिकालो निगद्यते ..
तस्माच्च द्विगुणं विद्धि निमिषं तन्महेश्वरि .. 9 ..
16.19.m: she creates the whole universe along with the two equinoxes. / Likewise, that which is the withdrawing [digit] dissolves the universe, O beloved. / A fourth part of the wink of an eye is called the time of a truṭi; / and know a nimiṣa to be twice that, O Maheśvarī! 9.

16.19.s:
nimiṣaistriṃśadbhiḥ kāṣṭhā tābhirviṃśatibhiḥ kalā..
viṃśatikalo muhūrtaḥ syāddinaṃ paṃcadaśaistu taiḥ..7.1.19.10...
16.19.d:
निमिषैस्त्रिंशद्भिः काष्ठा ताभिर्विंशतिभिः कला..
विंशतिकलो मुहूर्तः स्याद्दिनं पंचदशैस्तु तैः..7.1.19.10...
16.19.m: A kāṣṭhā is made of thirty nimiṣas; a kalā is made of twenty of them; / a muhūrta consists of twenty kalās; and a day consists of fifteen of those. 10.

16.19.s:
dinamānā niśā jñeyā ahorātraṃ dvayādbhavet .
taiḥ paṃcadaśabhiḥ pakṣo dvipakṣo māsa ucyate ..11..
16.19.d:
दिनमाना निशा ज्ञेया अहोरात्रं द्वयाद्भवेत् .
तैः पंचदशभिः पक्षो द्विपक्षो मास उच्यते ..11..
16.19.m: The measure of night is known to be equal to day; a day-and-night is made of both. / A fortnight consists of fifteen of those; a month is said to consist of two fortnights. 11.

16.19.s:
māsaiścaivāyanaṃ ṣaḍbhirvarṣaṃ syādayanadvaye ..
catvāriṃśacca lakṣāṇi lakṣāṇāṃ tritayaṃ punaḥ..12..
16.19.d:
मासैश्चैवायनं षड्भिर्वर्षं स्यादयनद्वये ..
चत्वारिंशच्च लक्षाणि लक्षाणां त्रितयं पुनः..12..
16.19.m: An ayana consists of six months; a year is in two ayanas. / Forty lakhs and three lakhs again, 12.

16.19.s:
viṃśatiśca sahasrāṇi jñeyaṃ sauraṃ caturyugam..
caturyugaikasaptatyā manvaṃtaramudāhṛtam..13..
16.19.d:
विंशतिश्च सहस्राणि ज्ञेयं सौरं चतुर्युगम्..
चतुर्युगैकसप्तत्या मन्वंतरमुदाहृतम्..13..
16.19.m: and twenty thousand [solar years] are to be known as a solar four-yuga cycle. / By seventy-one four-yuga cycles a manvantara is declared. 13.

16.19.s:
aiṃdrametadbhavedāyuḥ samāsāṃtaṃ ca kīrtitam..
caturdaśendraiḥ pralīnaiḥ kalpaṃ brahmadinaṃ bhavet ..14..
16.19.d:
ऐंद्रमेतद्भवेदायुः समासांतं च कीर्तितम्..
चतुर्दशेन्द्रैः प्रलीनैः कल्पं ब्रह्मदिनं भवेत् ..14..
16.19.m: This is the lifespan of an Indra, proclaimed as the completion of a summary. / When fourteen Indras have dissolved, a kalpa becomes a day of Brahmā. 14.

16.19.s:
rātriśca tāvatī caiva caturyugasahasrikā..
anena dinamānena śatābdaṃ jīvati priye ..15..
16.19.d:
रात्रिश्च तावती चैव चतुर्युगसहस्रिका..
अनेन दिनमानेन शताब्दं जीवति प्रिये ..15..
16.19.m: And the night is of equal length, consisting of a thousand four-yuga cycles. / By this measure of a day, he lives for a hundred years, O beloved. 15.

16.19.s:
mamaiva nimiṣārddhena sahasrāṇi caturddaśa ..
vinaśyaṃti tato viṣṇorasaṃkhyātāḥ pitāmahāḥ ..16..
16.19.d:
ममैव निमिषार्द्धेन सहस्राणि चतुर्द्दश ..
विनश्यंति ततो विष्णोरसंख्याताः पितामहाः ..16..
16.19.m: In half a wink of my eye, fourteen thousand / [Brahmās] perish, and countless grandfathers after Viṣṇu. 16.

16.19.s:
evaṃ krameṇa deveśi samutpannamidaṃ jagat ..
śaśisūryavibhāgena citrarūpamanaṃtakam ..17..
16.19.d:
एवं क्रमेण देवेशि समुत्पन्नमिदं जगत् ..
शशिसूर्यविभागेन चित्ररूपमनंतकम् ..17..
16.19.m: In this order, O Goddess of Gods, this universe arose, / manifold in form and endless through the division of moon and sun. 17.

16.19.s:
kalā devi yadādyaṃtamanādimajamavyayam..
tadānvitaḥ śaśī tasyāmadhomukhamavasthitaḥ .. 18 ..
16.19.d:
कला देवि यदाद्यंतमनादिमजमव्ययम्..
तदान्वितः शशी तस्यामधोमुखमवस्थितः .. 18 ..
16.19.m: When the digit is without beginning or end, unborn and imperishable, O Goddess, / then, connected with it, the moon rests facing downward in it. 18.

16.19.s:
evaṃ kṣayodayaṃ jñeyaṃ caṃdrārkābhyāmavasthitam ..
sṛṣṭikramaṃ mayā proktaṃ saṃhāramadhunā śṛṇu .. 19 ..
mahākalpaṃ hataṃ kalpaiḥ kalpaṃ manvaṃtarairhatam ..
māsaṃ pakṣāhataṃ kṛtvā taṃ cāhorātribhājitam ..7.1.19.2...
16.19.d:
एवं क्षयोदयं ज्ञेयं चंद्रार्काभ्यामवस्थितम् ..
सृष्टिक्रमं मया प्रोक्तं संहारमधुना शृणु .. 19 ..
महाकल्पं हतं कल्पैः कल्पं मन्वंतरैर्हतम् ..
मासं पक्षाहतं कृत्वा तं चाहोरात्रिभाजितम् ..7.1.19.2...
16.19.m:
Thus the wane and rise established through the moon and sun are to be known. / The order of creation has been spoken by me; hear now of dissolution. 19.
A mahākalpa is destroyed by kalpas; a kalpa is destroyed by manvantaras; / having multiplied a month by fortnights, and divided that by days and nights, 20.

16.19.s:
ahorātraṃ muhūrtena muhūrtaṃ tu kalāhatam..
kalāṃ kāṣṭhā hatāṃ kṛtvā kāṣṭhāṃ nimiṣabhājitām .. 21 ..
16.19.d:
अहोरात्रं मुहूर्तेन मुहूर्तं तु कलाहतम्..
कलां काष्ठा हतां कृत्वा काष्ठां निमिषभाजिताम् .. 21 ..
16.19.m: a day-and-night by a muhūrta, and a muhūrta struck by kalās; / having made a kalā struck by kāṣṭhās, and divided a kāṣṭhā by nimiṣas, 21.

16.19.s:
nimiṣaṃ ca lavairhatvā lavaṃ truṭivibhājitam ..
tadatītaṃ praśāṃtaṃ ca nirvikāramalakṣaṇam ..22..
16.19.d:
निमिषं च लवैर्हत्वा लवं त्रुटिविभाजितम् ..
तदतीतं प्रशांतं च निर्विकारमलक्षणम् ..22..
16.19.m: and having struck a nimiṣa by lavas, and divided a lava by truṭis; / that which transcends that is tranquil, changeless, and without characteristics. 22.

16.19.s:
tasya ceyaṃ parā māyā kalā śirasi dhāritā ..
sā śaktirdevadevasya viśvākārā parā priye ..
mohayitvā tu saṃtānaṃ saṃsārayati pārvati ..23..
16.19.d:
तस्य चेयं परा माया कला शिरसि धारिता ..
सा शक्तिर्देवदेवस्य विश्वाकारा परा प्रिये ..
मोहयित्वा तु संतानं संसारयति पार्वति ..23..
16.19.m: And this supreme Māyā of his, a digit, is borne upon [my] head. / She is the supreme power of the God of Gods, whose form is the universe, O beloved; / having deluded progeny, she causes it to transmigrate in saṃsāra, O Pārvatī. 23.

16.19.s:
30a
evametajjagaddevi utpattisthitilakṣaṇam ..
yatraivotpadyate kṛtsnaṃ punastatraiva līyate .. 24 ..
16.19.d:
30अ
एवमेतज्जगद्देवि उत्पत्तिस्थितिलक्षणम् ..
यत्रैवोत्पद्यते कृत्स्नं पुनस्तत्रैव लीयते .. 24 ..
16.19.m: Thus, O Goddess, is this world, characterized by origination and maintenance; / where the whole is born, there indeed it dissolves again. 24.

16.19.s:
seyaṃ māyāmayī śaktiḥ śuddhāśuddhasvarūpiṇī ..
caṃdrarūpā sthitā sā tu tava devi prakāśayet.. 25 ..
16.19.d:
सेयं मायामयी शक्तिः शुद्धाशुद्धस्वरूपिणी ..
चंद्ररूपा स्थिता सा तु तव देवि प्रकाशयेत्.. 25 ..
16.19.m: This power composed of Māyā, having the nature of the pure and the impure, / abiding in the form of the moon, reveals [herself] to you, O Goddess. 25.

16.19.s:
.. devyuvāca .. ..
paṃcāgninopasantaptā varṣakoṭīranekadhā ..
tattapaḥ saphalaṃ jātaṃ me'dya deva jagatpate .. 26 ..
16.19.d:
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
पंचाग्निनोपसन्तप्ता वर्षकोटीरनेकधा ..
तत्तपः सफलं जातं मेऽद्य देव जगत्पते .. 26 ..
16.19.m: The Goddess said: / Tormented by the five fires for crores of years in various ways, / that austerity of mine has borne fruit today, O God, Lord of the Universe! 26.

16.19.s:
sṛṣṭiyogo mayā jñātaḥ saṃhāraśca maheśvara ..
candrotpattisvarūpaṃ ca kalāmānaṃ tathaiva ca .. 27 ..
16.19.d:
सृष्टियोगो मया ज्ञातः संहारश्च महेश्वर ..
चन्द्रोत्पत्तिस्वरूपं च कलामानं तथैव च .. 27 ..
16.19.m: The process of creation has been understood by me, and dissolution, O Maheśvara, / as well as the nature of the moon's origin and the measure of the digits. 27.

16.19.s:
adhunā mama deveśa sandeho hṛdi saṃsthitaḥ ..
kautūhalaṃ paraṃ deva kathayasva maheśvara .. 28 ..
16.19.d:
अधुना मम देवेश सन्देहो हृदि संस्थितः ..
कौतूहलं परं देव कथयस्व महेश्वर .. 28 ..
16.19.m: Now a doubt rests in my heart, O Lord of Gods; / tell me of a great wonder, O God, O Maheśvara! 28.

16.19.s:
amṛtādeva saṃbhūtaḥ sarvāhlādakaraḥ śaśī ..
priyaśca tava deveśa vallabhaścaṃdramāstathā .. 29 ..
caṃdre ca cadi ityeṣa hlādane dhāturiṣyate..
śuklatve cāpatattve ca mayā tveṣa vibhāvyate ..7.1.19.3...
16.19.d:
अमृतादेव संभूतः सर्वाह्लादकरः शशी ..
प्रियश्च तव देवेश वल्लभश्चंद्रमास्तथा .. 29 ..
चंद्रे च चदि इत्येष ह्लादने धातुरिष्यते..
शुक्लत्वे चापतत्त्वे च मया त्वेष विभाव्यते ..7.1.19.3...
16.19.m:
The moon, born indeed from nectar, causes delight to all; / and he is dear to you, O Lord of Gods, the moon is your favorite. 29.
And in the word 'candra', the root 'cadi' is accepted in the sense of gladdening. / But in whiteness and in the nature of water, it is conceived by me.

16.19.s:
sarvauṣadhīnāmadhipaḥ pitṝṇāṃ prīṇanaṃ param ..
tadāśrayaśca tvadbhaktastva tsevātatparaḥ śaśī .. 31 ..
16.19.d:
सर्वौषधीनामधिपः पितॄणां प्रीणनं परम् ..
तदाश्रयश्च त्वद्भक्तस्त्व त्सेवातत्परः शशी .. 31 ..
16.19.m: The moon is the lord of all medicinal herbs, the supreme delight of the ancestors, / devoted to you, having refuge in you, and intent on your service.

16.19.s:
tathāpi sakalaṃko'yaṃ kautukaṃ kurute mama ..
devi brahmāṃḍasaṃghaṭṭamālāmaṃḍitaśekharaḥ .. 32 ..
16.19.d:
तथापि सकलंकोऽयं कौतुकं कुरुते मम ..
देवि ब्रह्मांडसंघट्टमालामंडितशेखरः .. 32 ..
16.19.m: Even so, this spotted [moon] causes me astonishment. / O goddess, his crest is adorned with the garland of cosmic collisions,

16.19.s:
śīrṣe tava niviṣṭasya kaṣṭaṃ caṃdrasya cedyadi ..
tarhi nātha na śocyā vai saṃsāre duḥkhabhāginaḥ .. 33 ..
16.19.d:
शीर्षे तव निविष्टस्य कष्टं चंद्रस्य चेद्यदि ..
तर्हि नाथ न शोच्या वै संसारे दुःखभागिनः .. 33 ..
16.19.m: If there is distress even for the moon seated upon your head, / then, O Lord, those who suffer grief in worldly existence are truly not to be pitied.

16.19.s:
na cāsti triṣu lokeṣu na caitatsaṃbhaviṣyati ..
yatra śakto bhavatkartuṃ duḥkhasyāsya ca saṃkṣayam.. 34 ..
16.19.d:
न चास्ति त्रिषु लोकेषु न चैतत्संभविष्यति ..
यत्र शक्तो भवत्कर्तुं दुःखस्यास्य च संक्षयम्.. 34 ..
16.19.m: For there is no one in the three worlds, nor will there ever be, / who would be capable of causing the destruction of this grief.

16.19.s:
sarveṣāṃ vartate śaṃkā yathā mama maheśvara ..
utpannaṃ kāraṇaṃ kiṃtadyena somasya lāṃchanam .. 35 ..
16.19.d:
सर्वेषां वर्तते शंका यथा मम महेश्वर ..
उत्पन्नं कारणं किंतद्येन सोमस्य लांछनम् .. 35 ..
16.19.m: Doubt exists for everyone just as it does for me, O Maheśvara. / What is that cause which arose, by which the spot of Soma occurred?

16.19.s:
kimetatkāraṇaṃ deva kathayasva maheśvara ..
amṛte saṃbhavo yasya kathaṃ tasyāpi lāṃchanam.. 36 ..
16.19.d:
किमेतत्कारणं देव कथयस्व महेश्वर ..
अमृते संभवो यस्य कथं तस्यापि लांछनम्.. 36 ..
16.19.m: What is this reason, O God? Tell me, O Maheśvara. / How can there be a spot even for him whose origin is in nectar?

16.19.s:
priyaśca tava deveśa lāṃchanaṃ cāpi tiṣṭhati ..
kautūhalaṃ paraṃ deva tattvaṃ me vaktumarhasi .. 37 ..
16.19.d:
प्रियश्च तव देवेश लांछनं चापि तिष्ठति ..
कौतूहलं परं देव तत्त्वं मे वक्तुमर्हसि .. 37 ..
16.19.m: And he is dear to you, O Lord of the gods, yet the spot remains. / My curiosity is great, O God; you ought to tell me the truth.

16.19.s:
evamuktaḥ sa pārvatyā devadevo maheśvaraḥ ..
uvāca paramaprītaḥ premṇā śailasutāṃ prabhuḥ .. 38 ..
16.19.d:
एवमुक्तः स पार्वत्या देवदेवो महेश्वरः ..
उवाच परमप्रीतः प्रेम्णा शैलसुतां प्रभुः .. 38 ..
16.19.m: Addressed thus by Pārvatī, the God of gods, Maheśvara, / the Lord, highly pleased, spoke with love to the daughter of the mountain:

16.19.s:
.. īśvara uvāca ..
kiṃ te devi mahāśaṃkādyotpannā varavarṇini ..
mamopari na karttavyā nirudvignā bhava priye ..
pitustava prabhāvena lāṃchanaṃ śaśino'bhavat .. 39 ..
16.19.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच ..
किं ते देवि महाशंकाद्योत्पन्ना वरवर्णिनि ..
ममोपरि न कर्त्तव्या निरुद्विग्ना भव प्रिये ..
पितुस्तव प्रभावेन लांछनं शशिनोऽभवत् .. 39 ..
16.19.m: Īśvara said: / Why has this great doubt arisen for you today, O lady of excellent complexion? / It should not be directed against me; be free from anxiety, my dear. / Through the influence of your father, the moon came to have a spot.

16.19.s:
bhāvitvātkarmaṇo devi dakṣasyājñāvyatikramāt ..
samaṃ varttasva bhāryābhirityuktaḥ śaśalāṃchanaḥ .. 7.1.19.40 ..
16.19.d:
भावित्वात्कर्मणो देवि दक्षस्याज्ञाव्यतिक्रमात् ..
समं वर्त्तस्व भार्याभिरित्युक्तः शशलांछनः .. 7.1.19.40 ..
16.19.m: Due to the inevitability of past actions, O goddess, and from transgressing Dakṣa's command, / the hare-marked [moon] was told: 'Treat [all] your wives equally!'

16.19.s:
tadvākyamanyathā cakre tataḥ śaptaḥ śaśī priye..
idaṃ pṛṣṭaṃ tu yaddevi tvayā lāṃchanakāraṇam .. 41 ..
16.19.d:
तद्वाक्यमन्यथा चक्रे ततः शप्तः शशी प्रिये..
इदं पृष्टं तु यद्देवि त्वया लांछनकारणम् .. 41 ..
16.19.m: He violated that word, and therefore the moon was cursed, my dear. / But as for this reason for the spot about which you have asked, O goddess,

16.19.s:
kalpekalpe pṛthagbhāvaṃ kāraṇairasti bhāmini ..
asaṃkhyātaṃ ca tadvaktuṃ śakyaṃ naiva mayā priye .. 42 ..
16.19.d:
कल्पेकल्पे पृथग्भावं कारणैरस्ति भामिनि ..
असंख्यातं च तद्वक्तुं शक्यं नैव मया प्रिये .. 42 ..
16.19.m: in kalpa after kalpa, there is a distinct condition due to various causes, O spirited lady; / and that is countless, and it is impossible for me to recount it, my dear.

16.19.s:
asaṃkhyeyāścandramasaḥ saṃbhavaṃti punaḥpunaḥ ..
vinaśyaṃti ca deveśi sarvamanvantarāntaram ..43 ..
16.19.d:
असंख्येयाश्चन्द्रमसः संभवंति पुनःपुनः ..
विनश्यंति च देवेशि सर्वमन्वन्तरान्तरम् ..43 ..
16.19.m: Countless moons come into being again and again, / and they perish, O ruler of the gods, across all the intervals between Manus.

16.19.s:
asaṃkhyātāśca kalpākhyā asaṃkhyātāḥ pitāmahāḥ ..
harayaścāpyasaṃkhyātā eka eva maheśvaraḥ .. 44 ..
16.19.d:
असंख्याताश्च कल्पाख्या असंख्याताः पितामहाः ..
हरयश्चाप्यसंख्याता एक एव महेश्वरः .. 44 ..
16.19.m: Countless are the names of the kalpas, countless are the Pitāmahas, / and the Haris too are countless; Maheśvara alone is one.

16.19.s:
koṭikoṭyayutānyatra brahmāṇḍāni mama priye ..
jalabudbudavaddevi saṃjātāni tu līlayā.. 45..
16.19.d:
कोटिकोट्ययुतान्यत्र ब्रह्माण्डानि मम प्रिये ..
जलबुद्बुदवद्देवि संजातानि तु लीलया.. 45..
16.19.m: Tens of thousands of crores of eggs of Brahmā are here, my dear; / like water bubbles, O goddess, they have arisen simply in sport.

16.19.s:
tatratatra caturvaktrā brahmāṇo harayo bhavāḥ..
sṛṣṭāḥ pradhānena tadā labdhā śaṃbhostu saṃnidhiḥ..46..
16.19.d:
तत्रतत्र चतुर्वक्त्रा ब्रह्माणो हरयो भवाः..
सृष्टाः प्रधानेन तदा लब्धा शंभोस्तु संनिधिः..46..
16.19.m: Here and there, four-faced Brahmās, Haris, and Bhavas / were created by Pradhāna at that time, and obtained proximity to Śambhu.

16.19.s:
layaṃ caiva tathānyonyamādyaṃtaṃ prakaroti ca..
sargasaṃhārasaṃsthānāṃ karttā devo maheśvaraḥ..47..
16.19.d:
लयं चैव तथान्योन्यमाद्यंतं प्रकरोति च..
सर्गसंहारसंस्थानां कर्त्ता देवो महेश्वरः..47..
16.19.m: And in the same way, he brings about mutual dissolution, beginning and end. / The god Maheśvara is the maker of creation, destruction, and maintenance.

16.19.s:
sarge ca rajasā pṛktaḥ sattvasthaḥ paripālane..
pratisarge tamoyuktaḥ so'haṃ devi tridhā sthitaḥ..48..
16.19.d:
सर्गे च रजसा पृक्तः सत्त्वस्थः परिपालने..
प्रतिसर्गे तमोयुक्तः सोऽहं देवि त्रिधा स्थितः..48..
16.19.m: Joined with rajas in creation, situated in sattva during preservation, / endowed with tamas in cosmic reabsorption, thus I remain threefold, O goddess.

16.19.s:
tasmānmāheśvaro brahmā brahmaṇo'dhipatiḥ śivaḥ ..
sadāśivo bhavedviṣṇurbrahmā sarvātmako hyataḥ .. 49 ..
16.19.d:
तस्मान्माहेश्वरो ब्रह्मा ब्रह्मणोऽधिपतिः शिवः ..
सदाशिवो भवेद्विष्णुर्ब्रह्मा सर्वात्मको ह्यतः .. 49 ..
16.19.m: Therefore Brahmā is of Maheśvara; Śiva is the master of Brahmā; / Sadāśiva becomes Viṣṇu; and hence Brahmā is the self of all.

16.19.s:
sa eva bhagavānrudro viṣṇurviśva jagatprabhuḥ ..
asminnaṇḍe tvimelokā antarviśvamidaṃjagat .. 7.1.19.50 ..
16.19.d:
स एव भगवान्रुद्रो विष्णुर्विश्व जगत्प्रभुः ..
अस्मिन्नण्डे त्विमेलोका अन्तर्विश्वमिदंजगत् .. 7.1.19.50 ..
16.19.m: He alone is the Lord Rudra, Viṣṇu, and the ruler of the universe. / In this cosmic egg are these worlds, and within it is this whole universe.

16.19.s:
candrasūryagrahā devi brahmāṇḍe'sminmanasvini ..
saṃkhyātuṃ naiva śakyante ye bhaviṣyaṃti ye gatāḥ .. 51 ..
16.19.d:
चन्द्रसूर्यग्रहा देवि ब्रह्माण्डेऽस्मिन्मनस्विनि ..
संख्यातुं नैव शक्यन्ते ये भविष्यंति ये गताः .. 51 ..
16.19.m: The moons, suns, and planets in this cosmic egg, O wise goddess, / those that will be and those that have passed, cannot be counted at all.

16.19.s:
asminvārāhakalpe tu vartamāne manasvini ..
ṣaḍatītā mahādevi rohiṇīpatayaḥ purā .. 52 ..
16.19.d:
अस्मिन्वाराहकल्पे तु वर्तमाने मनस्विनि ..
षडतीता महादेवि रोहिणीपतयः पुरा .. 52 ..
16.19.m: In this present Vārāhakalpa, however, O wise one, / six husbands of Rohiṇī have passed away in the past, O great goddess.

16.19.s:
saptamo'yaṃ mahādevi vartate'mṛtasaṃbhavaḥ ..
dakṣaśāpena yo devi saṃkṣīṇo dṛśyate'dhunā .. 53 ..
16.19.d:
सप्तमोऽयं महादेवि वर्ततेऽमृतसंभवः ..
दक्षशापेन यो देवि संक्षीणो दृश्यतेऽधुना .. 53 ..
16.19.m: This seventh one, born from nectar, is present now, O great goddess, / who is seen now wasted away due to Dakṣa's curse, O goddess.

16.19.s:
atha dvitīye saṃprāpte parārddhe caiva vedhasaḥ ..
tasya triṃśattime kalpe pitṛ kalpeti viśrute .. 54 ..
16.19.d:
अथ द्वितीये संप्राप्ते परार्द्धे चैव वेधसः ..
तस्य त्रिंशत्तिमे कल्पे पितृ कल्पेति विश्रुते .. 54 ..
16.19.m: Now, when the second half of the life of Vedhas had arrived, / in his thirtieth kalpa known as the Pitṛkalpa,

16.19.s:
svāyaṃbhuveṃ'tare prāpte tasyādau tvaṃ satī kila ..
tasminkāle mahādevi yobhūddakṣaḥ pitā tava .. 55 ..
16.19.d:
स्वायंभुवेंऽतरे प्राप्ते तस्यादौ त्वं सती किल ..
तस्मिन्काले महादेवि योभूद्दक्षः पिता तव .. 55 ..
16.19.m: when the Svāyambhuva interval had arrived, you were indeed Satī at its beginning. / At that time, O great goddess, he who was Dakṣa was your father.

16.19.s:
prāṇātprajāpaterjanma tasya dakṣasya kīrtitam ..
asminmanvantare devi dakṣaḥ prācetaso'bhavat .. 56 ..
16.19.d:
प्राणात्प्रजापतेर्जन्म तस्य दक्षस्य कीर्तितम् ..
अस्मिन्मन्वन्तरे देवि दक्षः प्राचेतसोऽभवत् .. 56 ..
16.19.m: The birth of that Dakṣa is proclaimed to be from the breath of Prajāpati. / In this Manvantara, O goddess, Dakṣa was born of Pracatas.

16.19.s:
aṃguṣṭhāddakṣiṇāddakṣo bhaviṣyatyadhunā priye ..
yugeyuge bhavantyete sarve dakṣādayo dvijāḥ .. 57 ..
16.19.d:
अंगुष्ठाद्दक्षिणाद्दक्षो भविष्यत्यधुना प्रिये ..
युगेयुगे भवन्त्येते सर्वे दक्षादयो द्विजाः .. 57 ..
16.19.m: Now, my dear, Dakṣa will be born from the right thumb. / In every yuga, all these twice-born ones such as Dakṣa come into being,

16.19.s:
punaścaiva vinaśyanti vidvāṃstatra na muhyati ..
tasyāpamānāttvaṃ devi dehaṃ tatyaktha vai purā .. 58 ..
16.19.d:
पुनश्चैव विनश्यन्ति विद्वांस्तत्र न मुह्यति ..
तस्यापमानात्त्वं देवि देहं तत्यक्थ वै पुरा .. 58 ..
16.19.m: and then they perish again; a wise person is not bewildered by this. / Because of insult from him, O goddess, you abandoned your body in the past.

16.19.s:
tāvadviyukto'haṃ devi tvayā mukto'bhavaṃ purā ..
yāvadvarāhakalpasya cākṣuṣasyāntaraṃ priye .. 59 ..
16.19.d:
तावद्वियुक्तोऽहं देवि त्वया मुक्तोऽभवं पुरा ..
यावद्वराहकल्पस्य चाक्षुषस्यान्तरं प्रिये .. 59 ..
16.19.m: For so long was I separated from you, abandoned by you in the past, O goddess, / until the Cākṣuṣa interval of the Varāhakalpa, my dear.

16.19.s:
ekaviṃśo manuścāyaṃ kalpe vārāhasaṃjñake ..
kalpekalpe mahādevi bhavennāmāntaraṃ tava .. 7.1.19.60 ..
16.19.d:
एकविंशो मनुश्चायं कल्पे वाराहसंज्ञके ..
कल्पेकल्पे महादेवि भवेन्नामान्तरं तव .. 7.1.19.60 ..
16.19.m: And this Manu is the twenty-first in the kalpa named Vārāha. / In kalpa after kalpa, O great goddess, your name would be different.

16.19.s:
asminkalpe tu vārāhe himavattapasārjjite ..
saṃbhūtā pārvatī devi cākṣuṣasyāṃtare gate .. 61 ..
16.19.d:
अस्मिन्कल्पे तु वाराहे हिमवत्तपसार्ज्जिते ..
संभूता पार्वती देवि चाक्षुषस्यांतरे गते .. 61 ..
16.19.m: In this Vārāha kalpa, however, gained through the austerity of Himavat, / you were born as the goddess Pārvatī when the Cākṣuṣa interval had passed.

16.19.s:
brahmaṇo dinamekaṃ tu ṣaṇmāsena tavāvadhiḥ ..
tvaṃ viyuktā mayā sārddhaṃ dakṣakopena bhāmini .. 62 ..
16.19.d:
ब्रह्मणो दिनमेकं तु षण्मासेन तवावधिः ..
त्वं वियुक्ता मया सार्द्धं दक्षकोपेन भामिनि .. 62 ..
16.19.m: One day of Brahmā, for the span of six months, was the limit for you; / you were separated from me, O spirited lady, through Dakṣa's anger.

16.19.s:
tava krodhena ye śaptā ṛṣayo vai mayā purā ..
te'pi devi tvayā sārddhaṃ jātā vaivasvateṃtare .. 63 ..
16.19.d:
तव क्रोधेन ये शप्ता ऋषयो वै मया पुरा ..
तेऽपि देवि त्वया सार्द्धं जाता वैवस्वतेंतरे .. 63 ..
16.19.m: The seers who were cursed by me in the past on account of your wrath, / they too, O goddess, were born along with you in the Vaivasvata interval:

16.19.s:
bhṛguraṃgirā marīcistu pulastyaḥ pulahaḥ kratuḥ ..
atriścaiva vasiṣṭhaśca aṣṭau te brahmaṇaḥ sutāḥ .. 64 ..
16.19.d:
भृगुरंगिरा मरीचिस्तु पुलस्त्यः पुलहः क्रतुः ..
अत्रिश्चैव वसिष्ठश्च अष्टौ ते ब्रह्मणः सुताः .. 64 ..
16.19.m: Bhṛgu, Aṅgiras, Marīci, Pulastya, Pulaha, Kratu, / Atri, and Vasiṣṭha—those eight sons of Brahmā.

16.19.s:
dakṣasya yajñe te śaptāḥ pūrvaṃ svāyaṃbhuventare ..
jātā devi punaste vai kalpesmiṃścākṣuṣe gate .. 65 ..
16.19.d:
दक्षस्य यज्ञे ते शप्ताः पूर्वं स्वायंभुवेन्तरे ..
जाता देवि पुनस्ते वै कल्पेस्मिंश्चाक्षुषे गते .. 65 ..
16.19.m: They were cursed previously in Dakṣa's sacrifice during the Svāyambhuva interval; / they were born again, O goddess, in this kalpa when the Cākṣuṣa [interval] had passed.

16.19.s:
devasya mahato yajñe vāruṇīṃ bibhratastanum ..
brahmaṇo juhvataḥ śukramagnau pūrvaṃ prajepsayā .. 66 ..
16.19.d:
देवस्य महतो यज्ञे वारुणीं बिभ्रतस्तनुम् ..
ब्रह्मणो जुह्वतः शुक्रमग्नौ पूर्वं प्रजेप्सया .. 66 ..
16.19.m: At the sacrifice of the Great God, who was bearing a Vāruṇī body, / as Brahmā previously poured semen into the fire desiring offspring,

16.19.s:
ṛṣayo jajñire pūrvaṃ sūryabiṃbasamaprabhāḥ ..
pitustava samīpaṃ te varaṇāya tava priye ..
prasthāpitā mayā pūrvaṃ tattvaṃ jānāsi suvrate .. 67 ..
16.19.d:
ऋषयो जज्ञिरे पूर्वं सूर्यबिंबसमप्रभाः ..
पितुस्तव समीपं ते वरणाय तव प्रिये ..
प्रस्थापिता मया पूर्वं तत्त्वं जानासि सुव्रते .. 67 ..
16.19.m: the seers were born formerly, possessing radiance equal to the sun's orb. / They were sent by me in the past to your father to ask for your hand, my dear; / you know the truth of that, O lady of noble vows.

16.19.s:
atha kiṃ bahunoktena vacmi te praśnamuttamam ..
dvitīye tu parārddhe'sminvarttamāne ca vedhasaḥ .. 68 ..
16.19.d:
अथ किं बहुनोक्तेन वच्मि ते प्रश्नमुत्तमम् ..
द्वितीये तु परार्द्धेऽस्मिन्वर्त्तमाने च वेधसः .. 68 ..
16.19.m: Now, what is the use of speaking much? I will answer your excellent question. / In this present second half of the life of Vedhas,

16.19.s:
śvetakalpātsamārabhya yāvadvārāhagocaram ..
samatītāśca ye candrāstāñchṛṇuṣva varānane .. 69 ..
16.19.d:
श्वेतकल्पात्समारभ्य यावद्वाराहगोचरम् ..
समतीताश्च ये चन्द्रास्ताञ्छृणुष्व वरानने .. 69 ..
16.19.m: beginning from the Śvetakalpa down to the range of the Vārāha, / listen, O fair-faced lady, to those moons that have passed away:

16.19.s:
catuḥśatāni deveśi ṣaḍviṃśatyadhikāni tu ..
gatāni śītaraśmīnāṃ saptaviṃśo'dhunā priye .. 7.1.19.70 ..
16.19.d:
चतुःशतानि देवेशि षड्विंशत्यधिकानि तु ..
गतानि शीतरश्मीनां सप्तविंशोऽधुना प्रिये .. 7.1.19.70 ..
16.19.m: Four hundred and twenty-six cool-rayed ones have passed away, / O ruler of the gods; the twenty-seventh is now [present], my dear,

16.19.s:
vaivasvateṃ'tare prāpte yaścāyaṃ vartate'dhunā ..
