tretāyuge tu daśame dattātreyapuraḥsaraḥ .. 71 ..
16.19.d:
वैवस्वतेंऽतरे प्राप्ते यश्चायं वर्ततेऽधुना ..
त्रेतायुगे तु दशमे दत्तात्रेयपुरःसरः .. 71 ..
16.19.m: which exists right now when the Vaivasvata interval has arrived. / In the tenth Tretāyuga, accompanied by Dattātreya,

16.19.s:
saṃjāto rohiṇīnātho yo'dhunā varttate priye ..
tasyotpattiprasaṃgena viṣṇormānuṣasaṃbhavān .. 72 ..
16.19.d:
संजातो रोहिणीनाथो योऽधुना वर्त्तते प्रिये ..
तस्योत्पत्तिप्रसंगेन विष्णोर्मानुषसंभवान् .. 72 ..
16.19.m: the lord of Rohiṇī was born, who exists right now, my dear. / In connection with his origin, [I shall speak of] the human incarnations of Viṣṇu.

16.19.s:
dehāvatārānvakṣyāmi prāraṃbhātprathamānpriye ..
pañcamaḥ paṃcadaśyāṃ sa tretāyāṃ tu babhūva ha .. 73 ..
16.19.d:
देहावतारान्वक्ष्यामि प्रारंभात्प्रथमान्प्रिये ..
पञ्चमः पंचदश्यां स त्रेतायां तु बभूव ह .. 73 ..
16.19.m: I will tell of his bodily descents from the very beginning, my beloved. / The fifth occurred in the fifteenth Tretāyuga:

16.19.s:
māṃdhātā cakravarttitve tasyotathyapuraḥsaraḥ ..
ekonaviṃśatretāyāṃ sarvakṣatrāṃtako'bhavat .. 74 ..
16.19.d:
मांधाता चक्रवर्त्तित्वे तस्योतथ्यपुरःसरः ..
एकोनविंशत्रेतायां सर्वक्षत्रांतकोऽभवत् .. 74 ..
16.19.m: Māndhātṛ, who held universal empire, preceded by Utathya. / In the nineteenth Tretāyuga, the destroyer of all kṣatriyas arose—

16.19.s:
jāmadagnyastathā ṣaṣṭho viśvāmitrapuraḥsaraḥ ..
caturviṃśe yuge rāmo vasiṣṭhena purodhasā .. 75 ..
16.19.d:
जामदग्न्यस्तथा षष्ठो विश्वामित्रपुरःसरः ..
चतुर्विंशे युगे रामो वसिष्ठेन पुरोधसा .. 75 ..
16.19.m: the descendant of Jamadagni, the sixth, preceded by Viśvāmitra. / In the twenty-fourth age, Rāma [arose], with Vasiṣṭha as his priest;

16.19.s:
saptamo rāvaṇasyārthe jajñe daśarathātmajaḥ ..
aṣṭame dvāpare viṣṇuraṣṭāviṃśe parāśarāt .. 76 ..
16.19.d:
सप्तमो रावणस्यार्थे जज्ञे दशरथात्मजः ..
अष्टमे द्वापरे विष्णुरष्टाविंशे पराशरात् .. 76 ..
16.19.m: the seventh, born as the son of Daśaratha for the destruction of Rāvaṇa. / In the twenty-eighth Dvāpara, Viṣṇu was born as the eighth from Parāśara;

16.19.s:
vedavyāsastato jajñe jātūkarṇyapuraḥsaraḥ ..
tatraiva navamo viṣṇuraditeḥ kaśyapātmajaḥ .. 77 ..
16.19.d:
वेदव्यासस्ततो जज्ञे जातूकर्ण्यपुरःसरः ..
तत्रैव नवमो विष्णुरदितेः कश्यपात्मजः .. 77 ..
16.19.m: then was born Vedavyāsa, preceded by Jātūkarṇya. / There too Viṣṇu was born as the ninth, son of Kaśyapa from Aditi,

16.19.s:
devakyāṃ vasudevāttu brahmagargapuraḥsaraḥ ..
ekaviṃśatamasyāsya dvāparasyāṃśasaṃkṣaye ..
naṣṭe dharme tadā jajñe viṣṇurvṛṣṇikule svayam .. 78 ..
16.19.d:
देवक्यां वसुदेवात्तु ब्रह्मगर्गपुरःसरः ..
एकविंशतमस्यास्य द्वापरस्यांशसंक्षये ..
नष्टे धर्मे तदा जज्ञे विष्णुर्वृष्णिकुले स्वयम् .. 78 ..
16.19.m: from Vasudeva upon Devakī, preceded by the divine Garga. / In this twenty-first Dvāpara, at the end of its fraction, / when dharma was destroyed, then Viṣṇu himself was born in the Vṛṣṇi lineage

16.19.s:
kartuṃ dharmavyavasthānamasurāṇāṃ praṇāśanaḥ ..
pūrvajanmani viṣṇuḥ sa pramatirnāma vīryavān .. 79 ..
16.19.d:
कर्तुं धर्मव्यवस्थानमसुराणां प्रणाशनः ..
पूर्वजन्मनि विष्णुः स प्रमतिर्नाम वीर्यवान् .. 79 ..
16.19.m: to establish the system of dharma, destroyer of the asuras. / In a previous birth, that heroic Viṣṇu was named Pramati;

16.19.s:
gotreṇa vai caṃdramasaḥ saṃdhyāmiśre bhaviṣyati ..
kalkirviṣṇuyaśānāma pārāśaryapratāpavān .. 7.1.19.80 ..
16.19.d:
गोत्रेण वै चंद्रमसः संध्यामिश्रे भविष्यति ..
कल्किर्विष्णुयशानाम पाराशर्यप्रतापवान् .. 7.1.19.80 ..
16.19.m: by lineage of Candramas, he will appear at the junction of the ages— / Kalki, known as Viṣṇuyaśas, mighty like the son of Parāśara,

16.19.s:
daśamo bhāvyasaṃbhūto yājñavalkyapuraḥsaraḥ ..
anukarṣaśca vai senāṃ hastyaśvarathasaṃkulām .. 81 ...
16.19.d:
दशमो भाव्यसंभूतो याज्ञवल्क्यपुरःसरः ..
अनुकर्षश्च वै सेनां हस्त्यश्वरथसंकुलाम् .. 81 ...
16.19.m: the tenth, who is to come, preceded by Yājñavalkya. / Leading an army crowded with elephants, horses, and chariots,

16.19.s:
pragṛhītāyudhairviprairbhṛśaṃ śatasahasraśaḥ ..
niḥśeṣāñchūdrarājñastāṃstadā sa tu kariṣyati .. 82 ..
16.19.d:
प्रगृहीतायुधैर्विप्रैर्भृशं शतसहस्रशः ..
निःशेषाञ्छूद्रराज्ञस्तांस्तदा स तु करिष्यति .. 82 ..
16.19.m: with brahmins wielding weapons by hundreds of thousands, / he will then completely destroy those Śūdra kings,

16.19.s:
pākhaṃḍānmlecchajātīṃśca dasyūṃścaiva sahasraśaḥ ..
nātyarthaṃ dhārmikā ye ca brahmabrahmadviṣaḥ kvacit .. 83 ..
16.19.d:
पाखंडान्म्लेच्छजातींश्च दस्यूंश्चैव सहस्रशः ..
नात्यर्थं धार्मिका ये च ब्रह्मब्रह्मद्विषः क्वचित् .. 83 ..
16.19.m: and heretics, mleccha tribes, and bandits by thousands, / and those who are not particularly righteous, and wherever there are haters of the Veda and brahmins.

16.19.s:
pravṛttacakro balavāñcchūrāṇāmaṃtako balī ..
adṛśyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ pṛthivīṃ vicariṣyati .. 84 ...
16.19.d:
प्रवृत्तचक्रो बलवाञ्च्छूराणामंतको बली ..
अदृश्यः सर्वभूतानां पृथिवीं विचरिष्यति .. 84 ...
16.19.m: His discus set in motion, powerful, a terminator of the valiant, mighty, / invisible to all beings, he will traverse the earth.

16.19.s:
mānavasya tu soṃ'śena devasya bhuvi vai prabhuḥ..
kṣapayitvā tu tānsarvānbhāvinārthena noditān ..
gaṃgāyamunayormadhye niṣṭhāṃ prāpsyati sānugaḥ .. 85 ...
16.19.d:
मानवस्य तु सोंऽशेन देवस्य भुवि वै प्रभुः..
क्षपयित्वा तु तान्सर्वान्भाविनार्थेन नोदितान् ..
गंगायमुनयोर्मध्ये निष्ठां प्राप्स्यति सानुगः .. 85 ...
16.19.m: As the lord on earth with a portion of the divine Manu, / having destroyed all of them driven by what is destined to occur, / he will attain his end between the Gaṅgā and the Yamunā along with his followers.

16.19.s:
tato vyatīte kalkau tu sāmātye sahasainike ..
nṛpeṣvapi ca naṣṭeṣu tadātvapraharāḥ prajāḥ .. 86 ..
16.19.d:
ततो व्यतीते कल्कौ तु सामात्ये सहसैनिके ..
नृपेष्वपि च नष्टेषु तदात्वप्रहराः प्रजाः .. 86 ..
16.19.m: Then, when Kalki has departed together with his ministers and army, / and kings have vanished, the subjects will at that time strike one another.

16.19.s:
rakṣaṇe vinivṛtte ca hatvā cānyonyamāhave ..
parasparahatāstāśca nirākraṃdāḥ suduḥkhitāḥ .. 87 ..
16.19.d:
रक्षणे विनिवृत्ते च हत्वा चान्योन्यमाहवे ..
परस्परहतास्ताश्च निराक्रंदाः सुदुःखिताः .. 87 ..
16.19.m: When protection has ceased, they will kill each other in battle; / slaughtered by one another, they will be utterly helpless and deeply wretched.

16.19.s:
kṣīṇe kaliyuge cāsmindaśavarṣasahasrake ..
sa saṃdhyāṃśe tu niḥśeṣe kṛtaṃ vai pratipatsyati .. 88..
16.19.d:
क्षीणे कलियुगे चास्मिन्दशवर्षसहस्रके ..
स संध्यांशे तु निःशेषे कृतं वै प्रतिपत्स्यति .. 88..
16.19.m: And when this Kaliyuga is exhausted in ten thousand years, / and its twilight fraction is completely spent, the Kṛtayuga will arrive.

16.19.s:
yadā caṃdraśca sūryaśca tathā tiṣyabṛhaspatī ..
ekarāśau sameṣyaṃti prapatsyati tadā kṛtam .. 89 ..
16.19.d:
यदा चंद्रश्च सूर्यश्च तथा तिष्यबृहस्पती ..
एकराशौ समेष्यंति प्रपत्स्यति तदा कृतम् .. 89 ..
16.19.m: When the moon, the sun, Tiṣya, and Bṛhaspati / all enter into the same zodiacal sign, then the Kṛtayuga will begin.

16.19.s:
abhijinnāma nakṣatraṃ jayaṃtīnāma śarvarī..
muhūrto vijayo nāma yatra jāto janārddanaḥ .. 7.1.19.90 ..
16.19.d:
अभिजिन्नाम नक्षत्रं जयंतीनाम शर्वरी..
मुहूर्तो विजयो नाम यत्र जातो जनार्द्दनः .. 7.1.19.90 ..
16.19.m: The lunar mansion was Abhijit, the night was Jayantī, / and the muhūrta was Vijaya when Janārdana was born.

16.19.s:
.. devyuvāca .. ..
noktaṃ yathāvadakhilaṃ bhṛguśāpaviceṣṭitam..
pūrvāvatārānme brūhi noktapūrvānmaheśvara..91..
16.19.d:
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
नोक्तं यथावदखिलं भृगुशापविचेष्टितम्..
पूर्वावतारान्मे ब्रूहि नोक्तपूर्वान्महेश्वर..91..
16.19.m: The goddess said: / The entire course of events caused by the curse of Bhṛgu has not been fully related. / Tell me of his former descents that have not been told before, O Maheśvara.

16.19.s:
īśvara uvāca..
yadā tu pṛthivī vyāptā dānavairbalavattaraiḥ..
tataḥ prabhṛti śāpena bhṛgunaimittikena ha.. 92..
16.19.d:
ईश्वर उवाच..
यदा तु पृथिवी व्याप्ता दानवैर्बलवत्तरैः..
ततः प्रभृति शापेन भृगुनैमित्तिकेन ह.. 92..
16.19.m: Īśvara said: / When the earth was overrun by very powerful dānavas, / from that time onward, by the curse occasioned by Bhṛgu,

16.19.s:
jajñe punaḥpunarviṣṇuḥ karttuṃ dharmavyavasthitim..
dharmānnārāyaṇaḥ sādhyaḥ saṃbhūtaścākṣuṣeṃtare..93..
16.19.d:
जज्ञे पुनःपुनर्विष्णुः कर्त्तुं धर्मव्यवस्थितिम्..
धर्मान्नारायणः साध्यः संभूतश्चाक्षुषेंतरे..93..
16.19.m: Viṣṇu was born again and again to establish the order of dharma. / From Dharma, Nārāyaṇa was born as a Sādhya in the Cākṣuṣa Manvantara;

16.19.s:
yajñaṃ pravartayāmāsa sa ca vaivasvateṃ'tare ..
prādurbhāve tadā tasya brahmā cāsītpurohitaḥ..94..
16.19.d:
यज्ञं प्रवर्तयामास स च वैवस्वतेंऽतरे ..
प्रादुर्भावे तदा तस्य ब्रह्मा चासीत्पुरोहितः..94..
16.19.m: and he established the sacrifice in the Vaivasvata Manvantara. / During that manifestation of his, Brahmā was his priest.

16.19.s:
caturthyāṃ tu yugākhyāyāmāpanneṣu sureṣviha..
saṃbhūtaḥ sa samudrāttu hiraṇyakaśiporvadhe..95..
16.19.d:
चतुर्थ्यां तु युगाख्यायामापन्नेषु सुरेष्विह..
संभूतः स समुद्रात्तु हिरण्यकशिपोर्वधे..95..
16.19.m: In the fourth yuga named, when the gods here had fallen into distress, / he arose from the ocean for the slaying of Hiraṇyakaśipu.

16.19.s:
dvitīyo narasiṃho'bhūdrudrastasya puraḥsaraḥ..
lokeṣu balisaṃstheṣu tretāyāṃ saptame yuge..96..
16.19.d:
द्वितीयो नरसिंहोऽभूद्रुद्रस्तस्य पुरःसरः..
लोकेषु बलिसंस्थेषु त्रेतायां सप्तमे युगे..96..
16.19.m: The second was Narasiṃha, who had Rudra as his forerunner. / When the worlds were controlled by Bali in the seventh yuga of the Tretā,

16.19.s:
daityaistrailokya ākrāṃte tṛtīyo vāmanobhavat..
saṃkṣipyātmānamaṃgeṣu bṛhaspatipuraḥsaraḥ .. 97 ..
16.19.d:
दैत्यैस्त्रैलोक्य आक्रांते तृतीयो वामनोभवत्..
संक्षिप्यात्मानमंगेषु बृहस्पतिपुरःसरः .. 97 ..
16.19.m: and the three worlds were overrun by the daityas, the third became Vāmana; / shrinking his body in his limbs, he was preceded by Bṛhaspati.

16.19.s:
tretāyuge tu daśame dattātreyo babhūva ha ..
naṣṭe dharme caturthāṃśe mārkaṃḍeyapuraḥsaraḥ ..
ete divyāvatārā vai mānuṣye kathitāḥ purā .. 98 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye śrīviṣṇvavatāravarṇanaṃnāmaikonaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ .. 19 .. cha ..
16.19.d:
त्रेतायुगे तु दशमे दत्तात्रेयो बभूव ह ..
नष्टे धर्मे चतुर्थांशे मार्कंडेयपुरःसरः ..
एते दिव्यावतारा वै मानुष्ये कथिताः पुरा .. 98 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये श्रीविष्ण्ववतारवर्णनंनामैकोनविंशोऽध्यायः .. 19 .. छ ..
16.19.m:
In the tenth Tretāyuga, Dattātreya indeed arose, / when a fourth of dharma was lost, preceded by Mārkaṇḍeya. / These divine descents among humans have been declared formerly.
Thus ends the nineteenth chapter, named 'Description of the Descents of Śrī Viṣṇu', in the first section on the Māhātmya of Prabhāsakṣetra, in the seventh Prabhāsakhaṇḍa of the glorious Skandapurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand verses.
